We are growing. And we are looking for talented people.

At Decskill, we believe that technological excellence is driven by human talent.

We are an IT consulting company with more than 10 years of consolidated experience in the market, focused on building long-term relationships with both our clients and our people. Today, we are a community of over 800 professionals, working from Lisbon, Porto, and Madrid, contributing to impactful technology initiatives.

As part of the Astek Group, we combine a strong local culture with a global presence, being active in around 23 countries across 4 continents. This allows us to offer an international context, diverse challenges, and long-term career opportunities, while staying close to our teams.


We would like to meet a Data Scientist for a project in Lisbon.


Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to data science and machine learning projects, supporting the full development lifecycle from data exploration to model deployment.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify patterns, trends, correlations, and insights from complex datasets.
  • Prepare, clean, transform, and process data using Python, SQL, and relevant data processing libraries.
  • Develop, train, and implement machine learning models to address business challenges and analytical requirements.
  • Apply statistical methods and data science techniques to support modelling, experimentation, and predictive analytics.
  • Evaluate model performance using appropriate metrics, validation techniques, and statistical approaches.
  • Develop data visualizations and analytical reports to communicate findings and support data-driven decision-making.
  • Implement and optimize machine learning solutions using industry-standard Python frameworks and libraries.
  • Support the deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of machine learning models in cloud environments.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders across multiple data science initiatives.
  • Explore and apply emerging technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Generative AI.
  • Contribute to the development and execution of scalable data science workflows using cloud platforms and distributed computing environments.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 5–10 years of professional experience in Data Science and Machine Learning projects.
  • Proven experience delivering end-to-end Data Science / Machine Learning initiatives, covering data understanding, preparation, modelling, evaluation, and deployment (mandatory).
  • Strong knowledge of data science concepts and methodologies, particularly Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), machine learning modelling, and model evaluation.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python and industry-standard Data Science / ML frameworks, such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, Keras, OpenCV, and Pandas (mandatory).
  • Proven experience in data preparation, transformation, and processing using SQL, Pandas, or similar technologies (mandatory).
  • Professional experience working with cloud environments, preferably AWS (mandatory).
  • Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Generative AI technologies is highly preferred.
  • Experience with Databricks is a plus.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and analytical findings to business and technical stakeholders.
  • Fluent in English (B2+ – mandatory, both spoken and written).


Are you looking for an environment that values curiosity and commitment? Here, your contribution has real impact and individual growth is taken seriously.


Find with us the right opportunity to grow!


What you can expect from us

  • Long-term projects with national and international context
  • Opportunities to grow technically and professionally
  • A people-first culture, focused on transparency and trust
  • Teams that value ownership, collaboration and stability


Join us

Send us your CV in English to marta.fonseca@decskill.com with reference “MF / DataScientist”.

Your next challenge might start here.



At Decskill, we are committed to equal opportunities and non-discrimination. We promote a culture of diversity and inclusion, where recruitment and career progression are based solely on talent, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, race, nationality, or any other form of discrimination incompatible with human dignity.

Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

About The Role

As part of the Bureau of Technology, you’ll design, build, and scale AI-driven solutions to improve our marketplace. You’ll join the Pricing & Quality team (a mix of data scientists and backend engineers) focused on curating offers to give customers the best value for money.

Your focus: implement models and algorithms to optimize fees and pricing.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive pricing intelligence: design and implement Machine Learning models and optimization algorithms that directly fuel a comprehensive suite of pricing levers
  • Own projects end to end: from problem definition and metrics design, through data extraction and model implementation, to presenting results to business and product stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with data scientists and backend engineers to translate models into production-ready features
  • Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of fee strategies or model changes.
  • Leverage statistical analyses to uncover actionable insights and inform critical tech, business and product decisions
  • Communicate your work clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

About You

  • At least 5 years of industry experience as a data scientist and Master’s (or PhD ) in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Economics or Engineering
  • Impact-driven: You’ve contributed to data science projects that made a real impact on live, customer-facing products — not just in theory, but in production.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: you are able to make decisions and propose directions even when the problem is not fully defined or the data is imperfect
  • Strong grasp of machine learning and statistical concepts and know how to choose the right model for the problem and make it work in a production environment.
  • Practical expertise in experimentation design and analysis.
  • Proficient in Python and SQL, and familiarity with software engineering principles around testing, code reviews, and deployment
  • Clear communicator: You are comfortable explaining complex ideas and results to diverse audiences, including senior management.
  • Experience in pricing, B2C marketplaces or revenue management is a strong plus.

Recruitment process

  • Call with one of our Tech recruiter (1h)
  • Technical screening (30 min)
  • Technical Interview (1h15)
  • Stakeholder interview (1h)
  • Meet your manager (30min)
  • Back Market Values fit interview (45 min)

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

Benefits

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

  • A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.
  • Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.
  • Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

Semrush is a brand visibility platform, empowering marketers to command their online presence and create measurable impact. We unify SEO authority and AI visibility, so brands are found, cited, and chosen everywhere search happens. That’s how Semrush gained the trust of over 28 million users—from scaling startups to Fortune 500 companies.

Here, you own the way you work, but we move as one unbeatable team.

We don’t just lead the market, we’re busy creating the world where Semrush is an unfair advantage for every marketer.

We move fast in ways to help you grow. Here, you have room to experiment, keep what works, and learn quickly from what doesn’t.

Ready to share our ambition and make an impact? Then, this role may be for you.

About The Role

  • Work on new directions and solutions for the market
  • Look for ways to improve existing algorithms
  • Introduce and experiment with new data source
  • Collaborate with data engineers and product teams

About You

Move together. Raise the bar. Learn fast—grow faster. That’s the default. And here’s what else is needed to succeed in this role:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of experience as a DS / MLE
  • Strong understanding of the principles of machine learning algorithms, probability theory, statistics, linear algebra
  • High proficiency in Python and ML stack
  • Hands-on experience working with LLMs
  • Knowledge of SQL

Not Required, But a Plus

  • Experience deploying and maintaining LLM-based solutions in production
  • Practical knowledge of RAG and building AI agents
  • Experience with GitLab CI
  • Experience with GCP and Vertex AI
  • Experience in developing ETL processes with Airflow
  • Experience in deploying ML systems with batch/real-time processing and monitoring (Grafana, Prometheus, Alertmanager)
  • Reproducible research.

Soft Skills

  • Strong sense of delivery ownership, balancing execution speed with engineering standards and quality requirements
  • Proven ability to ship reliable, maintainable code under tight timelines without compromising technical quality
  • Track record of driving alignment and close collaboration across cross-functional teams

About The Team

We are a data science team responsible for supporting teams working in the SEO and AI SEO domains. We create internal services using machine learning, based on which other teams implement new features. Our team includes 1 Data Science Manager, 4 Data Scientists, and 2 ML Engineers and we are looking for an additional Senior Data Scientist to join our team.

Our Stack

  • Google Cloud Platform
  • Data Storage: ClickHouse
  • Language: Python
  • Tools: Airflow, k8s, Docker, Catboost, Pandas
  • LLM APIs: OpenAI, Google, Anthropic

Examples Of Our Projects

  • A degree in economics, statistics, computer science or a related field

What Phare offers
You get a permanent, full-time contract; work from home anywhere in Germany; 30 days of holiday plus public holidays; an employer contribution to a company pension (bAV); a yearly budget for courses, certifications and books; your laptop and home desk setup; and flexible hours around a few shared core hours.

Phare Consulting Group is a consulting firm in Miami. Companies come to us before a big decision, such as a price change, a new market or an investment, and we check whether the numbers behind it hold up. Our team in Germany works with clients there.

CHI SIAMO

ADENTIS Italia è un gruppo europeo di consulenza ingegneristica e operativa facente parte del Gruppo MoOngy.

Presente in 14 paesi europei con oltre 9.000 dipendenti, abbiamo aperto, da quattro anni, la prima sede italiana a Milano e, vista la continua crescita, stiamo rafforzando e ampliando il nostro team con persone che condividano gli stessi valori della nostra società: AMBIZIONE, DINAMISMO e VOGLIA DI METTERSI IN GIOCO, il tutto in una realtà in continua evoluzione, nella quale le relazioni umane sono sempre al primo posto.


Ruolo: Data Analyst – Business Intelligence & Reporting

Luogo: Milano

Modalità: Ibrida (3gg in presenza)


IL TUO RUOLO

Per un'importante progettualità siamo alla ricerca di un Data Analyst – Business Intelligence & Reporting che si occupi di analisi quantitative, sviluppo e automazione della reportistica e realizzazione di dashboard a supporto delle decisioni strategiche del business.

La risorsa collaborerà con team di Business e Digital (IT), contribuendo alla valorizzazione dei dati e alla produzione di insight utili ai processi decisionali.


Attività:

  • Svolgere analisi quantitative per identificare trend, fenomeni di mercato e opportunità di business.
  • Sviluppare e automatizzare report e dashboard per il monitoraggio dei principali KPI.
  • Realizzare analisi strategiche e Data Driven Insights a supporto delle decisioni aziendali.
  • Garantire l'aggiornamento periodico delle analisi e della reportistica, adattandole alle esigenze dei clienti interni.
  • Predisporre visualizzazioni e presentazioni dei dati per i SAL periodici.
  • Raccogliere e analizzare i requisiti di business, traducendoli in soluzioni tecniche e analitiche.
  • Collaborare con i referenti di progetto per sviluppare nuovi strumenti di reporting e proporre approfondimenti.


Requisiti:

  • Python e R: esperienza nell'analisi, elaborazione e automazione dei dati.
  • SQL e Google BigQuery: capacità di interrogazione, estrazione e manipolazione di dataset.
  • Power BI: esperienza nella realizzazione di report, dashboard e visualizzazioni interattive.
  • Data Analysis & Data Visualization: solide capacità analitiche e di rappresentazione dei dati.
  • Reporting Automation: esperienza nell'automazione e nell'aggiornamento periodico della reportistica.
  • Capacità di interpretare i dati e tradurli in insight strategici per il business.
  • Ottime capacità comunicative e di presentazione dei risultati.
  • Capacità di interfacciarsi con stakeholder Business e IT a diversi livelli organizzativi.
  • Disponibilità a lavorare in presenza a Milano 2/3 giorni a settimana.


Nice to have:

  • Esperienza nella definizione e nel monitoraggio di KPI di business.
  • Conoscenza di DAX e Power Query.
  • Esperienza nell'analisi di trend e fenomeni di mercato.
  • Familiarità con processi di ETL e Data Quality.
  • Esperienza nella raccolta requisiti e nella gestione di stakeholder interni.


Cosa offriamo?

  • Contratto a tempo indeterminato.
  • Formazione continua su hard e soft skills.
  • Follow-up costante con HR e Business Manager.
  • Un percorso di crescita chiaro e strutturato in un ambiente innovativo, dinamico e internazionale.


La retribuzione annua lorda per questo ruolo è compresa tra 22.000 EUR e 26.000 EUR.

La posizione è inquadrata nell'ambito del CCNL del Commercio e Terziario applicato dalla nostra società.


Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in base alle competenze tecniche, all'esperienza specifica nel ruolo e agli esiti del processo di selezione, secondo criteri oggettivi e predefiniti. Job Description

Find your calling at Mercy!

The Senior Data Analyst plays a pivotal role in driving data-informed decision-making across the Ministry by partnering with key stakeholders to address complex business challenges. Leveraging advanced analytics tools, statistical methods, and deep business acumen, this role transforms data into actionable insights that inform strategic initiatives and operational improvements. The Senior Data Analyst is responsible for gathering and translating business requirements into scalable data solutions, uncovering trends and opportunities through rigorous analysis, and delivering impactful visualizations and reports. As a champion of data governance, this individual ensures the accuracy, integrity, and ethical use of data, serving as a trusted steward in promoting best practices and maintaining compliance with enterprise data policies.

Position Details

Minimum Qualifications:

Education: Degree(s) in data analytics, statistics, mathematics, computer science, technology or related field experience.

Experience: Two (2) years of relevant technical or business work experience or knowledge in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related technical/analytical field, with a proven ability to deliver actionable insights that influence strategic decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

Certification: Epic/Clarity Certifications and/or equivalent Healthcare experience.

Skills, Knowledge, Abilities

  • Demonstrated proficiency in SQL and/or Python for data extraction, transformation, and analysis, along with expertise in industry-standard data visualization tools.
  • Strong analytical thinking and advanced problem-solving capabilities, with experience handling medium to large datasets, including data cleansing, transformation, and integration.
  • Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in cross-functional teams, demonstrating sound judgment and ownership over assigned projects.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data quality, accuracy, and integrity.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, concise insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Why Mercy?

From day one, Mercy offers outstanding benefits - including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, tuition support, and matched retirement plans for team members working 32+ hours per pay period.

Join a caring, collaborative team where your voice matters. At Mercy, you'll help shape the future of healthcare through innovation, technology, and compassion. As we grow, you'll grow with us.

Buscamos incorporar Data Analysts orientados al análisis y visualización de datos, capaz de conectar las necesidades de negocio con soluciones que permitan obtener valor del dato y hacer seguimiento de los resultados.

Responsabilidades del rol

  • Data Analytics, trabajando en el análisis de datos, la segmentación de clientes, la visualización a través de Power BI y la obtención de valor del dato.
  • Data Translator, para la traducción de las necesidades de negocio en soluciones de datos que permitan llevar el seguimiento y evaluar el éxito comercial.
  • Elaboración de análisis estadísticos y reporting para la entrega de resultados a las áreas de negocio.
  • Generación de variables e indicadores necesarios para el seguimiento de negocio.
  • Aplicación de técnicas estadísticas para la realización de análisis.
  • Explicación de resultados para el entendimiento de negocio y justificación de los eventos que hayan sucedido a partir de los datos.
  • Creación de cuadros de mando e informes.

Requisitos mínimos

  • +4 años de experiencia en análisis, tratamiento y visualización de datos.
  • Capacidad de interlocución con usuarios de negocio.

Qui sommes nous ?

Fondé en France, Talan est aujourd’hui un groupe international qui accompagne ses clients dans leur transformation Data & IA, de bout en bout, en combinant conseil en management et expertise technologique.

Avec plus de 6000 collaborateurs sur 5 continents, nous accélérons les transformations de nos clients à travers des partenariats de long terme, en créant un impact mesurable et durable.

Notre proposition de valeur repose sur un écosystème d’innovation structuré : 2 500 experts Data & IA, des solutions propriétaires construites sur des modèles avancés et un laboratoire de recherche appliquée, de développement expérimental et d’innovation.

Nous traduisons l’innovation technologique en avantage concurrentiel depuis plus de 20 ans dans des secteurs stratégiques : banques et services financiers, énergie, transport et mobilité, luxe et distribution, santé.

Porté par sa promesse de Positive Innovation, Talan s’impose comme un acteur de référence pour répondre à la complexité croissante des environnements économiques, technologiques et réglementaires.

www.talan.com

Et Talan Sud Est ?

Talan Sud-Est est présent depuis 2007 à Lyon et compte environ 350 collaborateurs répartis entre Aix-Marseille et Lyon. En plein développement, les équipes s'agrandissent !



Nous continuons de développer aujourd'hui nos activités auprès de grands comptes et d’ETI, principalement dans les secteurs de l’Energie et de l’Environnement, du Transport et de la Logistique, de l’Industrie, de la Distribution, de la Santé et des Services Publiques.



L’expertise, la bonne humeur, le collectif et de l’esprit d’entreprendre, constituent notre ADN.



Description du poste

L’équipe Cloud 4 Data, forte de 70 collaborateurs, joue un rôle clé à la fois dans les projets de transformation digitale de nos clients, mais également dans l'évolution croissante de la région Talan Sud Est.

Ce pôle ambitionne de continuer à se développer sur les expertises suivantes : analyse de la donnée, data engineering, data gouvernance, architecture, conseil, etc...

Qu'est-ce que nous vous proposons ?

En tant que Data Analyst, vous interviendrez sur des projets variés avec une forte proximité avec les équipes métiers. Vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

  • Échanger directement avec les métiers afin de comprendre leurs enjeux, recueillir leurs besoins et les traduire en problématiques Data concrètes.
  • Analyser, transformer et valoriser les données pour produire des analyses fiables et exploitables.
  • Concevoir, développer et maintenir des dashboards et reportings avec des outils de Data Visualisation tels que Power BI, Tableau ou Qlik Sense.
  • Définir et suivre les KPIs pertinents pour accompagner les métiers dans leur prise de décision.
  • Réaliser des analyses exploratoires afin d’identifier des tendances, anomalies ou opportunités.
  • Interroger, croiser et manipuler des données complexes grâce à une maîtrise avancée de SQL.
  • Utiliser Python pour le traitement, l’analyse et l’automatisation des données.
  • Veiller à la qualité et à la cohérence des données utilisées.
  • Restituer vos analyses de manière claire et pédagogique auprès d’interlocuteurs techniques et métiers.

Qualifications

Vous êtes la personne idéale si…

En possession d'un diplôme de niveau bac+5 (diplôme d'ingénieur ou Master technique), vous possédez au moins 4 années d’expérience dans le domaine de la data. Vous avez déjà travaillé en société de services et êtes en capacité d'intervenir sur tout le cycle de vie des projets (conception, solutions, mise en production).

Vous maîtrisez les solutions/outils suivants :

  • SQL
  • Python
  • Au moins un des outils de datavisualisation suivant : Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, Qlik Cloud

Nous recherchons un profil capable d’être à l’interface entre la Data et les métiers. Au-delà de la production de dashboards, vous savez comprendre les enjeux business, challenger les besoins et transformer les données en éléments concrets d’aide à la décision.

Ce descriptif vous plait ? Lancez-vous : nous avons hâte d’en apprendre plus sur vous, vous présenter nos références projets et Talan plus en détails !



Ce que Talan Lyon vous propose au quotidien :

  • Des locaux modernes situés à proximité du parc de la Tête d'Or
  • La possibilité de télétravailler (prime d’équipement de 100 €)
  • Mutuelle prise en charge à hauteur de 80% minimum
  • Des titres-restaurant
  • Primes de cooptation de 500 à 4000€
  • Actionnariat salarié
  • Great Place to Work depuis 10 ans
  • Retour de congé maternité possible à 4/5ème sans perte de salaire pendant 6 mois
  • Permanence handicap (consultant dédié aux collaborateurs en situation de handicap et aux proches aidants)
  • Offre de formation complète sur site et à distance, programme de mentoring pour les femmes
  • Mobilité en France et à l’étranger
  • Top 1% des entreprises évaluées par Ecovadis dans le domaine social, environnemental et éthique
  • Activité sportive hebdomadaire au sein des locaux encadré par un coach)
  • Encouragement à l’intrapreneuriat avec accompagnement de nos directeurs



Processus de recrutement :

L’équipe recrutement s’engage à vous proposer un processus de recrutement rapide et fluide avec à minima un entretien en présentiel dans nos locaux :

  • Un premier échange de 30 à 45 minutes en visio ou par téléphone avec le recruteur pour vous présenter le poste et comprendre votre projet professionnel
  • Un entretien technique
  • Un entretien managérial

Talan est une entreprise responsable, attachée à la diversité. Des aménagements de poste peuvent être organisés pour tenir compte des personnes en situation de handicap.

At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.

Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.

Data Analyst at BairesDev

What We Are Looking For

  • Extensive experience with data visualization and storytelling with data.
  • Advanced proficiency in English.

Nice To Have

  • 1+ year of experience with Python, R, or another programming language.

Join a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive and make a significant impact!

Apply now!

The Sleep Company is India’s fastest-growing D2C sleep and comfort brand, built on the foundation of patented Smart GRID technology. Good to Have

  • Python for data cleaning, analysis and automation.
  • Experience with Shopify, marketplace or CRM data.
  • Exposure to A/B testing or forecasting.

WHO WE ARE 

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.

About the team 

The Data Cloud Acceleration team identifies gaps and opportunities across clients and business units, then moves quickly to deliver practical new capabilities. We often develop and deploy the first version of a model, workflow, dataset, or application in days or weeks, learn from real usage, and improve it iteratively. 

We are business-minded technologists who care more about impact than technical novelty. We use sophisticated methods when the problem requires them and simpler approaches when they will deliver a better result faster. Our work should be predictable, demoable, trusted, reusable, measured, and amplified by AI. 

 

About the role 

The Senior Data Scientist will build models, analyses, and supporting ML components that improve business decisions, intelligence products, and client outcomes. You will independently own defined deliverables—from understanding the requirement and preparing the data through modeling, validation, documentation, and delivery. 

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will work across varied revenue and intelligence initiatives, often in partnership with a Lead Data Scientist, application engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders. The right candidate can move quickly without sacrificing trustworthiness and knows how to balance statistical rigor with the practical needs of the business. 

 

What you’ll do

  • Own model and analysis deliverables. Take a defined business problem and independently deliver a reliable model, analysis component, scoring workflow, or supporting dataset.  

  • Translate business questions into analytical approaches. Ask clarifying questions, understand how the output will be used, and recommend an approach that fits the decision, timeline, and available data.  

  • Build and test models quickly. Develop practical solutions using statistical methods, machine learning, deep learning, or existing models and services where appropriate.  

  • Prepare trustworthy data. Profile, cleanse, join, and validate noisy datasets while checking completeness, freshness, distributions, nulls, duplicates, and match rates.  

  • Create repeatable scoring workflows. Move useful work beyond the notebook by building reusable Python components, batch-scoring processes, APIs, or lightweight services.  

  • Evaluate results responsibly. Establish baselines, select appropriate metrics, perform statistical reasonableness checks, reconcile unexpected results, and clearly document limitations.  

  • Support intelligence products and applications. Work with application and data teams to define the right data ingredients, test hypotheses, and integrate model outputs into usable experiences.  

  • Add operational discipline. Include validation, monitoring, failure handling, refresh expectations, documentation, and a clear usage path in delivered work.  

  • Use AI to improve your own productivity. Apply tools such as Claude, Codex, and similar assistants to accelerate coding, testing, research, debugging, and documentation while independently verifying the results.  

  • Communicate progress early and clearly. Make milestones, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and issues visible rather than waiting until delivery.  

 

What ownership looks like at this level

You are expected to own the deliverable. That means: 

  • Working independently on a well-defined model, workflow, dataset, or component  

  • Producing reliable and repeatable outputs rather than one-time analyses  

  • Adding appropriate validation and basic monitoring  

  • Documenting assumptions, methodology, limitations, and usage  

  • Demonstrating the output and explaining how it supports the business  

  • Raising risks and ambiguity early  

  • Leaving the work in a condition that another team member can operate or extend  

 

You will receive guidance on broader product direction, methodology, and complex stakeholder decisions, but you should not require step-by-step direction to complete the work. 

 

Experience that can set you up for success

These are useful indicators rather than absolute requirements: 

  • Experience applying statistical analysis and machine learning to real business problems  

  • Strong Python skills and familiarity with libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, or TensorFlow  

  • Strong SQL skills and experience analyzing large datasets  

  • Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Athena, Hive, BigQuery, or similar technologies  

  • Experience developing classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, recommendation, optimization, or anomaly-detection solutions  

  • Familiarity with model evaluation, experimental design, feature engineering, and statistical validation  

  • Experience creating repeatable batch-scoring workflows or exposing model outputs through APIs or services  

  • Familiarity with orchestration and automation tools such as Airflow, AWS Glue, Prefect, or similar platforms  

  • Experience using version control, testing, and reproducible development practices  

  • Ability to explain analytical results and trade-offs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders  

  • Meaningful use of GenAI tools to improve the speed and quality of day-to-day work  

 

You’ll thrive here if you 

  • Are pragmatic. You select the simplest credible approach that can deliver useful business impact.  

  • Move quickly with discipline. You can produce an initial version rapidly while still validating the fundamentals.  

  • Care about trust. You check the data, question surprising results, and make limitations visible.  

  • Work well with ambiguity. You can turn an incomplete request into a clear set of questions, assumptions, and next steps.  

  • Think beyond the notebook. You consider how a model will be refreshed, accessed, demonstrated, monitored, and reused.  

  • Understand the business context. You evaluate technical decisions through the lens of client outcomes, revenue, cost, adoption, and decision quality.  

  • Are curious and low-ego. You are comfortable learning from others, revising an approach, and using an existing solution when it is better than building a new one.  

 

Early indicators of success 

Within the first several months, a successful candidate will have: 

  • Independently delivered a model, analysis workflow, or scoring component used in an active business or intelligence initiative  

  • Added repeatable validation and documentation to their deliverables  

  • Converted at least one exploratory analysis or prototype into a reusable workflow  

  • Demonstrated clear understanding of how their work supports a client, product, revenue, or operational outcome  

  • Used AI-assisted development to improve delivery speed without compromising accuracy or trust  

  • Earned confidence from data science, application, and business partners through reliable execution and clear communication 

 

BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage

 

PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA

Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.  

We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here:  https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a-look-into-zetas-ergs/

Bristol or London

About Us

Hoare Lea is a human-centric and planet-conscious engineering consultancy. We offer intelligent and sustainable solutions to complex design challenges for the built environment throughout the UK and further afield.

We provide a wide range of engineering and consultancy services, including acoustics, air quality, building services (MEP), fire, lighting, security and sustainability to name but a few. Together, our highly skilled teams use technical expertise and problem-solving skills to bring buildings to life. We ensure that whatever the building, its design is outstanding, and its operations meet the needs of the communities it serves.

We are as committed to providing an environment where everyone can realise their unique potential. So, in joining Hoare Lea, you will experience a business that enriches your knowledge, supports your wellbeing, and welcomes your individuality. You’ll have the opportunity to participate in our 9-day fortnight scheme, thriving community groups, varied social and networking events, and extensive professional and technical development schemes. We also offer an extensive benefits package, including private medical cover, an electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme, stock options, and 25 days of annual leave (increasing with service), alongside flexible and hybrid working.

Whatever your ambitions or circumstances, our aim is to enable everyone to develop their knowledge, give their best, and enjoy what they do.

About The Role

Our multi-disciplinary software, product, and data team serves as a central hub of digital expertise and innovation, supporting projects across the company. We work collaboratively with engineers, consultants and other specialists to use data and technology to solve real-world problems and improve the services we provide to our clients.

We have an opportunity for a Data Analyst/Scientist or Senior Data Analyst/Scientist to play a key role in using data, analytics, statistical methods and data science to generate insight, support decision-making and improve our engineering services.

This is a broad analytical role. You will work across the full lifecycle of a problem: understanding stakeholder needs, exploring and assessing data, identifying appropriate analytical approaches, communicating findings and, where appropriate, developing statistical or machine-learning models or client-ready insights/tools. This is a role for someone who enjoys variety and has a critical eye for finding the right solution for the problem. Sometimes this may be exploratory analysis, a dashboard or a set of clearly defined metrics; in other cases, it may involve forecasting, statistical modelling, machine learning or building/working with AI.

It's an exciting time to join our Digital team. Working alongside a range of specialist engineers and consultants, you will be joining a collaborative, knowledgeable, highly engaged team, and offer a supportive, flexible, and high-performing work culture. In a time where building and energy resilience is ever more important, we are driving forward innovation to make an impact with data and technology.

You will have the opportunity to engage in a variety of high-impact projects, working on challenging problems for some of the UK’s most notable organisations, including the NHS and Oxford University. Our team has recently worked on creating data science-led for managing estates in hospitals, building energy forecasting models, and harnessing data on building performance to create better designed buildings of the future.

In this key and varied role, you can expect to:

  • Work with engineers, consultants, product teams and other stakeholders to understand their needs and translate sometimes ambiguous questions into well-defined analytical problems.
  • Develop and implement data-driven solutions to solve real-world business problems across the company.
  • Use SQL, Python and other analytical tools to investigate datasets, identify trends and relationships, test hypotheses and generate actionable insights.
  • Apply appropriate statistical techniques, forecasting methods, ML and AI approaches where they add value to the problem being solved.
  • Collaborate with the product and software engineering teams to turn analytical work into reusable tools, workflows and data-driven products where appropriate.
  • Develop reproducible and maintainable analytical code, following best practices, including version control, testing, and peer reviews.
  • Contribute to the development of analytical and data science capability across the business by sharing approaches, reusable methods and good practice

About You

To be successful in this role you’ll need:

Essential Skills

  • Experience applying data and analysis to real-world business, engineering or operational problems.
  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to take an initially ambiguous question and determine an appropriate analytical approach.
  • Ability to work on projects independently and own deliverables.
  • Strong proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, visualisation and data science (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn).
  • Proficiency in data querying languages (e.g., SQL). Solid understanding of software engineering best practices (version control, unit testing, code review, etc.).
  • Strong experience with data visualisation frameworks (e.g., PowerBI, Streamlit).
  • Experience applying machine learning and AI, including generative AI, to real-world problems where it provides clear benefit.
  • Familiarity with statistical concepts and their application in data analysis.
  • Solid communication skills, capable of effectively engaging with and presenting findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Understanding of data governance, privacy, responsible AI and other relevant standards.

Desirable Skills

  • Knowledge of the engineering industry and its challenges.
  • Experience with one of the major machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch).
  • Knowledge of mathematical optimisation methods, such as linear, integer or constraint optimisation, and associated tools (e.g. OR-Tools).
  • Experience with MS Fabric or equivalent data warehousing solution.
  • Experience working in a cloud computing environment.
  • Familiarity with containerisation and deployment technologies (e.g., Docker, CI/CD pipelines).

For candidates joining at Senior level, we would additionally expect you to lead more complex or ambiguous analytical projects, shape analytical approaches and overarching priorities, work independently with senior stakeholders, review and support the work of others, and help raise analytical standards across the team.

How To Apply

To apply simply complete a CV profile and submit your application.

If shortlisted, one of our recruitment team will be in touch to arrange an introductory call (about 30 minutes) to discuss the role and your experience in more detail. From there, successful candidates will be invited to attend a panel interview, either via Microsoft Teams or in person at one of our offices. We aim to provide feedback at each stage of the process.

Adjustments and accommodations

If there are adjustments or accommodations that we can put in place to help you participate and give your best at any stage of the recruitment process (whether relating to disability, neurodivergence or anything else) please let us know.

Data privacy

We have updated our terms and conditions for candidates, click here to find out more.

Recruitment agencies

We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners who assist us when required. We do not acknowledge speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.

À PROPOS DE NOUS

Nous sommes l’un des plus importants investisseurs pour des régimes de pensions au Canada, avec un actif net sous gestion de 320,6 milliards de dollars au 31 mars 2026.

Nous investissons des fonds pour les régimes de pensions de la fonction publique, des Forces canadiennes, de la Gendarmerie royale du Canada et de la Force de réserve. Le siège social d’Investissements PSP est situé à Ottawa et son bureau principal d’affaires est situé à Montréal. Elle compte également des bureaux à New York, à Londres et à Hong Kong.

La réalisation et la gestion de placements complexes de portée mondiale exigent que nous travaillions dans l’esprit d’« Un seul PSP » afin de pouvoir saisir de précieuses occasions, en étroite collaboration avec certaines des plus grandes entreprises à l’échelle mondiale. Chez Investissements PSP, vous vous joindrez à une équipe motivée et à des professionnels engagés, qui s’efforcent de faire croître notre organisation comme jamais auparavant.

À PSP, trois valeurs guident notre quotidien : Incarner la mission en alignant notre façon de travailler sur les besoins et les attentes des personnes que nous servons; Exceller ensemble en unissant nos efforts pour obtenir des résultats exceptionnels; et Être responsables en démontrant nos intentions par nos actions.

Et si votre nouveau chapitre commençait ici?

VOTRE RÔLE

En tant que scientifique de données, Science de données et intelligence artificielle, vous jouerez un rôle concret dans la mise à profit de la science des données au service de la génération d'alpha pour PSP. Pour ce faire, vous devrez :

  • Travailler au sein d’une équipe de dix personnes, Sciences de l’Alpha, dont le mandat est de soutenir les décisions d'investissement par l’utilisation de l'IA à l'échelle du fonds de pension et de ses entités associées
  • Acquérir, construire, nettoyer et maintenir les jeux de données qui alimentent les analyses et les outils de l’équipe, notamment des données de marché, des données alternatives (géolocalisation, achalandage, données satellites, prix) et des données des sociétés en portefeuille
  • Concevoir et développer des pipelines d'extraction et d’exploitation de données permettant de transformer des sources brutes, souvent peu structurées, incluant des documents, dépôts réglementaires et flux de fournisseurs, en ensembles de données prêts à l'analyse
  • Réaliser des analyses pratiques et de la modélisation statistique / apprentissage automatique afin de tirer des enseignements qui aident les équipes d’investissement à mettre à l'épreuve, remettre en question ou valider leurs thèses d'investissement
  • Collaborer avec des membres expérimentés de l'équipe, techniques et non-techniques, pour transformer des analyses ponctuelles en tableaux de bord, visualisations et outils réutilisables destinés aux équipes d’investissement de l'ensemble des classes d'actifs de PSP
  • Acquérir une bonne connaissance des secteurs et des ensembles de données sous votre responsabilité, et développer le jugement nécessaire pour cerner les questions et les analyses les plus pertinentes à la prise de décision des équipes d’investissement
  • Préparer des documents clairs et bien structurés qui racontent une histoire convaincante à partir des données, tant pour un public technique que non technique
  • Appuyer les membres expérimentés de l'équipe dans la présentation des résultats directement aux équipes d’investissement et, le cas échéant, à la direction des sociétés en portefeuille
  • Contribuer à la trousse à outils de l'équipe, y compris ses outils basés sur des grands modèles de langage (LLM), et les utiliser selon la pertinence pour les projets sur lesquels vous travaillez
  • Assumer la responsabilité d'analyses et de projets distincts de bout en bout, de la collecte des données jusqu'au livrable final

CE DONT VOUS AUREZ BESOIN

  • Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en science des données, en informatique, en statistique, en génie, en mathématiques appliquées ou dans tout autre domaine quantitatif équivalent, obtenu d'une université reconnue
  • Deux à trois (2-3) ans d'expérience en science des données, en ingénierie des données ou en analyse quantitative, idéalement dans le secteur des services financiers, de l'investissement ou dans un autre environnement à forte intensité analytique
  • Excellente maîtrise pratique de Python et SQL pour l'extraction, l'ingestion, la préparation, l'analyse et la modélisation des données
  • Expérience dans l'extraction et la structuration de données provenant de sources variées (documents, dépôts réglementaires, API, flux de fournisseurs), un atout important
  • Expérience avec des plateformes de données infonuagiques / lakehouse (par exemple, Databricks, Snowflake), un atout
  • Expérience pratique dans l'application de techniques statistiques ou d'apprentissage automatique à des ensembles de données réels, souvent peu structurés
  • Expérience dans la création de tableaux de bord ou de visualisations (par exemple, Power BI, Tableau ou des bibliothèques de visualisation en Python)
  • Expérience avec des ensembles de données alternatives ou non conventionnelles (par exemple, géolocalisation, achalandage, données satellites ou données de prix), un atout
  • Une exposition préalable à l'investissement et aux transactions dans les marchés publics, l'immobilier ou les ressources naturelles, un atout
  • Débrouillard(e) et créatif(ve), avec une capacité démontrée à travailler dans un environnement au rythme rapide où les priorités changent fréquemment
  • Excellentes habiletés de communication, tant à l'écrit qu'à l'oral
  • Maîtrise de l'anglais et du français (ou volonté d'apprendre) (interactions fréquentes en anglais avec les employés de PSP basés dans nos bureaux à Hong Kong, Londres et New York, et des interactions en français avec les employés de nos bureaux locaux de Montréal et d'Ottawa)

Nous offrons une expérience sur mesure à nos employés et un ensemble* de rémunération globale et d’avantages sociaux concurrentiel, conçus pour attirer et retenir des talents diversifiés dans le monde entier, récompenser le rendement et renforcer les stratégies et les priorités de l’entreprise. Au-delà du salaire et de l’admissibilité à la rémunération incitative, vous avez accès à :

  • Un investissement dans le développement de carrière
  • Des régimes d'assurance collective complets
  • Des régimes de pension compétitifs
  • Un accès illimité aux services de soins de santé virtuels et programmes de mieux-être
  • Politique de congé parental rémunéré inclusive pour tous les genres : jusqu’à 26 semaines pour les principaux donneurs de soins, 5 semaines pour les partenaires

Discovery Health

Senior Data Scientist

About Discovery

Discovery’s core purpose is to make people healthier and to enhance and protect their lives. We seek out and invest in exceptional individuals who understand and support our core purpose, and whose own values align with those of Discovery. Our fast-paced and dynamic environment enables smart, selfdriven people to be their best. As global thought leaders, Discovery is passionate about innovating in order to not only achieve financial success, but to ignite positive and meaningful change within our society.

About (Data Science Lab)

The Group DS Lab is growing and positions are available. The lab applies predictive analytics, machine learning, big data and operations research skills, to run and to support key projects for the Group and for the individual Discovery business units. We work across clinical, wellness, financial, sales, operational, people and behavioural theme areas, using modern analytics tools on terabytes of structured and unstructured data within a big data architecture. We are also mandated to find opportunities to use new data sets and in areas not typically accustomed to using data science.

Key Purpose

The Data Science Lab Is a Highly Specialised And Expanding Team That Tackles Challenges In The Health, Life, And Short-term Insurance Businesses, As Well Projects That Cut Across The Whole Of The Discovery Group. We Are Looking For Individuals With 2-5 Years Of Experience, For Projects Related To:

  • risk management through behavioural science and intervention (next best action) design
  • combining traditional data (eg: wearable device, web & app logs, health & life insurance claims) with novel data sources in new ways
  • assisting with experimental design for product, rewards, marketing, communications, engagement etc
  • advising partner markets on how to customise and deploy locally built models

They will have the opportunity to work with cutting edge technology and advanced techniques to see their models used in real business applications. The innovative work environment means there are opportunities to shape new projects with a focus on helping insurance customers to lead healthier lives.

Areas of responsibility may include but not limited to

  • Identify and build appropriate models to predict risk, sales and savings
  • Present data insights and model findings in a way that provides actionable insights for business stakeholders and senior executives
  • Mining and visualising large structured and unstructured datasets throughout the businesses to inform product design, risk management, customer interaction strategies, etc.
  • Following model implementations through to business adoption
  • Monitoring model performance and using feedback for improvement
  • Improving processes and data collections where opportunities arise
  • Running scientific experiments to evaluate different models in a reproducible way
  • Produce analytical work that is customer, business and staff focused

Personal Attributes and Skills

  • A creative and enthusiastic attitude to unearthing valuable insights and generating value for Discovery clients
  • Ability to balance multiple priorities and to step back and see how analytics work fits into the wider business context
  • Results driven, curious and able to work autonomously or within teams
  • Good time and task management skills
  • Ability to communicate results of analyses in a clear and effective manner
  • Aligned to Discovery values and core purpose

Education and Experience

  • Master’s or PhD degree in either Data Science, Actuarial Science, Statistics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics or Engineering fields.
  • Ability to formulate a clear problem statement, develop a plan for tackling it, and clearly communicate findings verbally, visually, and in writing
  • Demonstrable working experience in an analytics position, where the focus was on building and implementing machine learning models to solve business problems
  • Experience accessing and analysing data using language/tools/databases such as Python, R, SQL, etc.
  • Experience using Gradient Boosting Machines, Random Forests, Neural Networks or similar algorithms.
  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Office tools.

Advantageous:

  • Some experience in working with big disparate sets of data and exposure to big data tools
  • The ideal candidate will possess a deep interest in the healthcare industry, particularly in leveraging behavioral science to promote disease management and prevention. Additionally, they should demonstrate a strong understanding of strategic risk management principles and their application across the healthcare value chain.

EMPLOYMENT EQUITY

Summary

As a Sr Financial Planning & Analysis Analyst, working in collaboration with and in support of the firm’s strategic initiatives, you will analyze current and past trends in key performance indicators including all areas of expenses and capital expenditures. You will monitor performance indicators, highlighting trends and analyzing causes of unexpected variances. You will develop financial models and analyses to support strategic initiatives. You will analyze complex financial information and reports to provide accurate and timely financial recommendations to management for decision making purposes.

Location

This position can sit in our New York, Baltimore, Reston, or Short Hills office and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

  • Utilizing experience and judgement, analyzes material aspects of $500m expense and capital expenditure program for administrative teams (i.e., CIO, CFO, COO, etc.).
  • Works directly with FP&A Manager – Expenses to consolidate results. Explains variances to budget and prior year results.
  • Develops budgets and forecasts for the groups, including bottoms up expense drivers and detailed documentation of assumptions.
  • Independently develops and produces reporting to support monthly close and annual planning processes based on previous experience.
  • Performs ad-hoc analysis leveraging data analytic skills as needed for new initiatives, cost anomalies and to identify cost savings opportunities.
  • Prepares and loads required journal entry adjustments to the company’s budget and actuals as required.
  • Proactively leads processes to identify cost savings opportunities across the organization.
  • Collaborates with other areas of FP&A including revenue and production planning.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Desired Skills   

Strong analytical skills required as well as the ability to present complex financial data in a clear and concise manner. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment. Proficient with software packages such as Excel, Word, PowerPoint and ERP.

Minimum Education   

  • Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or similar field.

Minimum Years Of Experience  

  • 5 years of experience in a law firm, professional services firm or blue-chip organization with a focus on expense management and/or financial planning.

Essential Job Expectations

All DLA Piper employees are expected to demonstrate excellence in how we serve our clients and develop our people, upholding our firm values as part of our culture. Specific expectations include:

  • Communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with clients, lawyers, business professionals, and external audiences.
  • Produce high-quality work and respond to correspondence in an efficient, timely, and professional manner.
  • Meet deadlines, manage competing priorities, and commit to meeting high standards.
  • Comply with firm policies and procedures.
  • Maintain confidences as required in a law firm environment.

Physical Demands

Sedentary work: This is primarily sedentary work, requiring occasional exertion of up to 10 pounds of force to lift, carry, push, pull, or move objects. The role involves sitting for extended periods, with occasional walking and standing, and occasional travel, both domestic and international.

Work Environment   

The individual selected for this position may have the opportunity for a hybrid work arrangement comprised of remote and in-office work, the requirement for which will be determined in coordination with the hiring manager or supervisor and may be modified in the firm’s discretion in the future.

Disclaimer

The job duties, requirements, and expectations for this position may be modified at the Firm’s discretion at any time. This job description does not change the at-will nature of employment.

Applicants must apply directly online instead of sending application materials via email.

À propos du poste

Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) propulse le voyage pour certaines des plus grandes marques du monde grâce à nos API, nos produits en marque blanche et notre offre fintech, et chaque jeu de données que nous détenons raconte une histoire que nos partenaires ont besoin de voir racontée clairement, régulièrement et rapidement. À titre de scientifique de données principal(e) au sein d’HTS, vous serez responsable de la relation analytique avec un portefeuille de partenaires et vous bâtirez les mécanismes qui répondent une première fois à leurs questions sur la santé de l’inventaire, la compétitivité des prix et la performance, puis y répondent chaque semaine. Vous serez évalué(e) moins sur la sophistication de vos modèles que sur la capacité des personnes avec qui vous travaillez, chez Hopper comme dans les équipes commerciales de nos partenaires, à prendre de meilleures décisions grâce à vous.

À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien

  • Assumer la responsabilité de la relation analytique avec un portefeuille de partenaires HTS, en travaillant aux côtés des équipes Partner Success et Commercial pour comprendre leurs besoins, y répondre et présenter les résultats directement à leurs équipes
  • Concevoir et standardiser des rapports récurrents sur la santé de l’inventaire, la compétitivité des prix et la performance des locataires, qui s’adaptent aux hôtels, aux vols, aux locations de maisons et aux voitures sans devoir être reconstruits chaque fois
  • Utiliser les assistants et agents d’intelligence artificielle ainsi que les outils de génération de code comme collaborateurs du quotidien afin d’automatiser les parties répétitives de l’analyse et de la production de rapports, et aider l’ensemble de l’équipe à adopter les mêmes pratiques
  • Cadrer et mener des analyses exploratoires qui approfondissent notre compréhension du comportement des partenaires et des voyageurs, et traduire vos constats en recommandations claires pour les responsables produit, ingénierie et affaires
  • Appliquer l’apprentissage automatique et les méthodes statistiques à de vastes ensembles de données désordonnés lorsqu’ils font une réelle différence, et reconnaître quand une mesure simple et bien expliquée constitue la meilleure réponse
  • Créer des tableaux de bord et des rapports en libre-service dans BigQuery, Looker, Tableau, Amplitude et Google Sheets, avec le souci de vous rendre inutile pour les questions de routine
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes produit et ingénierie afin que les données que nous recueillons soutiennent les questions que nos partenaires poseront ensuite

Le ou la candidat(e) idéal(e) possède

  • Un diplôme en mathématiques, statistiques, informatique, génie, économie ou dans une autre discipline quantitative, ou une expérience pratique équivalente
  • D’excellentes compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes, avec un historique démontré de réponses à des questions complexes à l’aide des données, dans plus d’un domaine ou d’une gamme de produits
  • Une capacité démontrée à transformer un travail technique complexe en récits simples et crédibles pour des auditoires non techniques et de direction, y compris des partenaires externes
  • De l’aisance en contact avec les partenaires, pour présenter des conclusions, répondre à des questions difficiles en direct et établir un lien de confiance avec les interlocuteurs commerciaux
  • De solides compétences en SQL et de l’expérience avec les entrepôts de données modernes comme BigQuery, ainsi qu’une maîtrise de Python et Pandas ou de R pour la préparation et l’analyse de données à grande échelle
  • Un usage quotidien et pratique des outils fondés sur les grands modèles de langage, comme Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor ou Copilot, pour écrire du code, du SQL, des analyses et de la documentation, et un point de vue sur leurs forces et leurs limites
  • De l’expérience dans la conception ou le déploiement de flux de travail automatisés et agentiques, des pipelines planifiés à la génération de rapports par grands modèles de langage en passant par les bibliothèques d’invites ou de compétences, qui transforment des analyses ponctuelles en produits réutilisables
  • De l’expérience en forage de données, en apprentissage automatique et en modélisation statistique, et le jugement nécessaire pour savoir quand y recourir
  • De l’expérience avec les outils de rapports d’affaires et d’expérimentation comme Tableau, Looker ou Amplitude
  • Un fort penchant pour la simplification, la standardisation et la livraison plutôt que le perfectionnement
  • De l’expérience dans l’industrie du voyage en hébergement, en transport aérien, en location de vacances ou en location de voitures, ou au sein d’une place de marché, d’une plateforme B2B ou d’une entreprise de distribution par API, est un atout
  • De l’expérience avec les données géographiques en recherche, en filtrage ou en recommandation, ou auprès de clients externes dans un rôle de conseil, de solutions ou d’analytique client, est un atout

Avantages sociaux

  • Une entreprise en démarrage bien financée et éprouvée, avec de grandes ambitions, un salaire compétitif et les avantages d’un régime d’actions pré-IPO
  • Hopper couvre 100 % des primes du régime d’assurance collective
  • Hopper offre une couverture vie, invalidité de courte durée et invalidité de longue durée
  • Un compte de dépenses santé qui couvre les frais médicaux et dentaires admissibles
  • Tous les employés et leurs personnes à charge ont accès aux services de télémédecine de Dialogue, en tout temps, où que vous soyez
  • Tous les employés ont accès à un régime REER avec retenues automatiques avant impôt à chaque paie
  • Renseignez-vous sur notre congé parental très généreux, bien au-delà des normes de l’industrie
  • Vacances illimitées
  • Allocation de voyage Carrot Cash
  • Accès à un espace de cotravail sur demande via FlexDesk, et une allocation pour le télétravail
  • Une culture entrepreneuriale où repousser les limites et prendre des risques fait partie du quotidien
  • Communication ouverte avec la direction et les leaders de l’entreprise
  • Des équipes petites et dynamiques, un impact considérable

À propos d’Hopper

Chez Hopper, nous bâtissons la principale plateforme technologique de voyage au monde, et nous y parvenons en résolvant de vrais problèmes pour de vrais voyageurs partout sur la planète. Nos plateformes de réservation grand public Hopper et HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), notre division B2B, travaillent ensemble pour offrir aux voyageurs ce que l’industrie n’a jamais offert de façon fiable : de la transparence, de la flexibilité et de véritables économies sur chaque voyage. Nous combinons d’immenses volumes de données et l’intelligence artificielle à des produits fintech exclusifs pour y arriver, pas simplement un autre moteur de réservation, mais une façon fondamentalement meilleure de planifier et de vivre le voyage, pour nos clients comme pour nos partenaires.

Et nous continuons de croître rapidement! L’application Hopper a été téléchargée plus de 120 millions de fois, et 70 % de nos utilisateurs font partie de la génération Z et des milléniaux, les voyageurs de la prochaine génération. Aujourd’hui, notre plus grande occasion consiste à propulser la fintech, le commerce et la fidélisation en voyage pour certaines des plus grandes marques de l’industrie. Notre premier partenariat HTS, avec Capital One, a contribué au lancement d’un portail de voyage dédié aux titulaires de cartes d’une grande marque financière, et nous avons depuis étendu notre présence auprès de certains des plus grands noms du voyage et de la finance, dont Air Canada, Uber, Banque Royale du Canada (RBC) et Nubank, en propulsant aussi bien une simple intégration fintech qu’un portail de fidélisation de voyage complet de bout en bout.

Voilà notre trajectoire : nous avons commencé comme une petite application perturbatrice dans l’univers du voyage, et nous sommes aujourd’hui le moteur qui propulse le fonctionnement des technologies de voyage.

Voici Ce Que Cela Représente Concrètement

  • Des milliards de dollars de voyages et de produits fintech de voyage transitent chaque année par Hopper et HTS.
  • Nos produits fintech, dont Annulation pour n’importe quelle raison et Assistance en cas de perturbation pour n’importe quelle raison, affichent une satisfaction client exceptionnellement élevée parce que les conditions sont claires et les résolutions instantanées, sans poser de questions.
  • Près de 30 % des clients de l’application ajoutent un produit fintech à leur réservation, et ces clients sont 1,6 fois plus susceptibles de réserver de nouveau avec nous.
  • HTS représente désormais plus de 90 % de l’entreprise, preuve de la rapidité avec laquelle le B2B a pris de l’ampleur.
  • Grâce à HTS, tout fournisseur de services de voyage (compagnies aériennes, hôtels, banques, agences de voyages) peut intégrer les solutions fintech, de commerce et d’intelligence artificielle de l’entreprise à ses propres canaux, qu’il s’agisse d’une simple intégration ou d’un portail de voyage complet de bout en bout.

Prenez votre envol avec nous!

About The Role

Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) powers travel for some of the world's largest brands through our APIs, white label products and fintech, and every dataset we hold tells a story our partners need told clearly, repeatedly and fast. As a Senior Data Scientist on HTS you will own the analytical relationship with a portfolio of partners and build the machinery that answers their questions about supply health, pricing competitiveness and performance once, then answers them every week. You will be judged less on the sophistication of your models than on whether the people you work with, inside Hopper and across partner commercial teams, make better decisions because of you.

What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like

  • Own the analytical relationship with a portfolio of HTS partners, working alongside Partner Success and Commercial to understand what they need, deliver it, and present it directly to their teams
  • Design and templatize repeatable reporting on supply health, pricing competitiveness and tenant performance that scales across hotels, flights, homes and cars without being rebuilt each time
  • Use AI assistants, agents and code generation tools as everyday collaborators to automate the repetitive parts of analysis and reporting, and help the broader team adopt the same practices
  • Frame and run exploratory analyses that deepen our understanding of partner and traveler behavior, and translate what you find into clear recommendations for product, engineering and business leaders
  • Apply machine learning and statistical methods to large, messy datasets where they move the needle, and recognize when a simple, well explained metric is the better answer
  • Build dashboards and self serve reporting in BigQuery, Looker, Tableau, Amplitude and Google Sheets, with an eye toward making yourself unnecessary for routine questions
  • Partner closely with product and engineering so the data we collect supports the questions our partners will ask next

An ideal candidate has

  • A degree in Math, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics or another quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience
  • Extremely strong analytical and problem solving skills, with a track record of answering hard questions with data across more than one domain or product line
  • A proven ability to turn complex technical work into simple, credible narratives for non technical and executive audiences, including external partners
  • Comfort being partner facing, presenting findings, fielding tough questions live and building trust with commercial counterparts
  • Deep SQL skills and experience with modern data warehouses such as BigQuery, plus fluency in Python and Pandas or R for large scale data preparation and analysis
  • Hands on, daily use of LLM based tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Copilot for writing code, SQL, analysis and documentation, and a point of view on where they help and where they fall short
  • Experience building or deploying automated and agentic workflows, from scheduled pipelines to LLM driven report generation and prompt or skill libraries, that turn one off analyses into repeatable products
  • Experience with data mining, machine learning and statistical modeling, and the judgment to know when to reach for them
  • Experience with business reporting and experimentation tools such as Tableau, Looker or Amplitude
  • A strong bias toward simplifying, templatizing and shipping over polishing
  • Travel industry experience in lodging, air, vacation rentals or car rental, or in a marketplace, B2B platform or API distribution business, is a plus
  • Experience with geographic data in search, filtering or recommendation, or working with external customers in a consulting, solutions or customer analytics capacity, is a plus

Perks And Benefits Of Working With Us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages
  • Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for group insurance plan
  • Hopper offers life, short term and long term disability coverage
  • HSA that covers eligible medical and dental expenses
  • All employees and dependents have access to Dialogue's telemedicine services, anytime, anywhere
  • All employees have access to an RRSP plan with automatic pre-tax withdrawals per pay
  • Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend
  • Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business
  • Open communication with management and company leadership
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact

About Hopper

At Hopper, we're building the leading travel technology platform in the world, and we're doing it by solving real problems for real travelers globally. Our Hopper consumer booking platforms and HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), our B2B business, work together to give travelers something the industry has never reliably offered: transparency, flexibility, and real savings on every trip. We combine massive amounts of data and AI with proprietary fintech products to make that happen, not just another booking engine, but a fundamentally better way to plan and experience travel for our customers and our partners. We're proof that better-for-the-customer and better-for-the-business can be one in the same

And we're continuing to grow fast! The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times, with 70% of our users being Gen Z and Millennials, next-generation travelers. Today, our biggest opportunity is powering travel fintech, commerce, and loyalty for some of the biggest brands in the industry. Our first HTS partnership with Capital One helped launch a dedicated travel portal for a major financial brand's cardholders, and we've since expanded across some of the biggest names in travel and banking, including Air Canada, Uber, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), and Nubank, powering everything from a single fintech integration to a full end-to-end travel loyalty portal.

That's our trajectory: we started as a small, disruptive app within the travel space, and now we're the engine under the hood powering how Travel Tech works.

What That Looks Like In Practice

  • Billions of dollars in travel and travel fintech move through Hopper and HTS every year.
  • Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Disruption Assistance for Any Reason, post exceptionally strong customer satisfaction because the terms are clear and resolutions are instant, no questions asked.
  • Nearly 30% of app customers add a fintech product to their booking, and those customers are 1.6x more likely to book with us again.
  • HTS now drives more than 90% of the business, proof of how fast B2B has scaled.
  • Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies) can plug the company's fintech, commerce and AI solutions into their own channels, whether that's a single integration or a full end-to-end travel portal.

Come take off with us!
