Who we are

DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum-safe future at www.digicert.com

Job summary

We are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst – GTM FP&A to join our Finance organization. This role will report directly to the VP of FP&A and will play a key role in supporting the company’s GTM planning, reporting, forecasting, and financial modeling.

The ideal candidate has strong financial modeling and analytical skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to translate complex SaaS performance data into clear and concise reporting for senior leadership.

This role will have significant exposure to ARR, bookings, revenue, billings, churn, renewals, expansions, contractions, and retention metrics, with a particular focus on building and maintaining reporting models and executive-level reporting decks.

The position will be based in India and will work closely with Finance leadership in both India and the U.S. The role will also have a dotted-line relationship with the Director of Finance – India. 

 

What you will do

SaaS Topline Reporting & Analysis

Own and maintain recurring reporting for key SaaS topline metrics, including:

    • ARR
    • Bookings
    • Billings
    • Revenue
    • Dollar-based Gross Retention (GRR)
    • Dollar-based Net Retention (NRR)
    • Churn
    • Contraction
    • Expansion
    • New business
  • Analyze monthly and quarterly performance against budget, forecast, and prior periods.
  • Identify key drivers and variances within the SaaS topline and clearly communicate findings to Finance leadership.
  • Maintain detailed customer and cohort-level analyses to support understanding of topline performance.
  • Ensure accuracy and consistency of topline data across reporting models and management reporting.
Financial Modeling & Forecasting
  • Build, maintain, and enhance financial models supporting SaaS topline forecasting and planning.
  • Develop detailed models for ARR movements, customer retention, churn, contraction, expansion, and new business.
  • Support monthly forecasting and annual planning processes.
  • Perform scenario analysis and sensitivity analysis to evaluate different topline assumptions and business outcomes.
  • Develop analytical models to help Finance leadership understand trends, risks, and opportunities within the SaaS business.
  • Improve and automate existing models and reporting processes where appropriate.
Management Reporting & Executive Presentations
  • Prepare recurring reporting packages and executive-level presentations for Finance and senior leadership.
  • Build and maintain reporting decks highlighting topline performance, key trends, and variance drivers.
  • Translate detailed financial and operational data into clear, concise insights for senior audiences.
  • Support preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual business reviews.
  • Ensure reporting materials are accurate, timely, and presented in a clear and executive-friendly format.

What you will have

  • 3+ years of experience in FP&A, financial analysis, corporate finance, or a similar analytical role.
  • Strong experience with financial modeling, forecasting, and management reporting.
  • Experience working in a SaaS or recurring-revenue business is strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS financial and operating metrics, including ARR, retention, churn, expansion, and contraction.
  • Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills with the ability to build complex financial models.
  • Strong PowerPoint / presentation skills and experience creating executive-level reporting decks.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to work with large datasets and translate detailed analysis into clear business insights.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver accurate work within tight deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience with financial planning systems, BI tools, Salesforce, NetSuite, or similar systems is a plus.
What We're Looking For
  • Strong financial modeling skills with a focus on building scalable, accurate models.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a high level of ownership over reporting accuracy.
  • Someone who enjoys working with data and can quickly identify trends, anomalies, and key drivers.
  • Strong ability to create clear, polished reporting decks for senior leadership.
  • A self-starter who can operate independently while knowing when to escalate issues.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environment.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain financial concepts clearly. 
  • A mindset focused on continuously improving models, reporting, and processes.
Reporting Structure

This position will report directly to the VP of FP&A and will be based in India.

The role will also have a dotted-line reporting relationship to the Director of Finance – India, providing additional alignment with the broader India Finance organization.

Key Success Measures

Success in this role will include:

  • Accurate and timely SaaS topline reporting.
  • High-quality financial models that support forecasting and planning.
  • Clear and insightful executive reporting decks.
  • Strong understanding and analysis of ARR and retention movements.

 

Benefits

  • Generous time off policies
  • Top shelf benefits
  • Education, wellness and lifestyle support

 

To protect candidate information and maintain a secure hiring process, all applications must be submitted through our careers portal. Resumes or CVs sent directly via email will not be reviewed or considered.

Join our global team of experts

At Diconium, you will work on projects that connect software, data, AI, and human expertise to create digital products, services, and operating models that deliver measurable business impact. Together with 2,500 experts across our international teams, you will help build, run, and scale intelligence across the full value chain.

In everything we do, we prioritize people and genuine human connections, ensuring a supportive and inclusive work environment. Our hybrid workplace also provides a high degree of flexibility.

Get to know our data crew – beyond the job description

applydata represents Diconium’s data crew: pioneers in the practical magic of data. On the applydata blog, our data and AI experts share real project insights, personal perspectives, videos, and stories from our data studios – plus highlights from our meetups and upcoming events. Explore applydata and meet the people behind our data work.

Join our data crew as Senior Data Scientist (all genders) at our data studio Berlin.

What You Can Expect

  • Development and implementation of machine learning algorithms and models to address our clients’ business challenges.
  • Extraction of valuable insights from large and unstructured data sources.
  • Creation and leadership in the development of AI/ML-driven solutions for predictive analytics, recommendation systems, and process automation.
  • Collaboration with cross-functional teams to understand our clients’ business objectives and translate them into effective ML/AI solutions.
  • Evaluation of model performance and continuous improvement of accuracy and efficiency through iterative optimization.
  • Communication of findings and insights clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Assumption of functional leadership responsibilities and support of other data scientists in their professional development.

What You Bring Along

Must-haves

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in data science with proven hands-on experience in applied machine learning, AI and statistical modeling.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, including experience with relevant libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, scikit-learn, NLTK), as well as a good command of SQL.
  • Great understanding of statistical methods and machine learning algorithms.
  • Experience leading projects or taking on functional leadership responsibilities.
  • Experience communicating with and managing stakeholders, ideally in the IT services industry or a consulting environment.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in fast-paced environments, with excellent communication skills and the ability to clearly present complex technical concepts.
  • Full professional proficiency in German and English (C1 level minimum)

 

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with big data technologies and cloud platforms.
  • Experience with data processing in Spark and Databricks, or similar technologies
  • Experience with data visualization, dashboarding tools or simple frontends for visualization (Streamlit, Dash, Tableau, PowerBI).
  • Knowledge of deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, Keras).
  • Previous experience with ML operations and deploying ML/AI models into production environments.
  • Experience with generative AI and agentic systems.

What We Have To Offer

Discover new skills and improve your strengths, adapt your working day to your personal lifestyle, celebrate community, sustainability and diversity. And sweeten your working life with awesome perks and benefits!

Professional & Personal Growth: Develop yourself both professionally and personally through training programs, free language courses, competence centers and an active tech community.

Flexible Work-Life Balance: Benefit from hybrid work, workation, flexible hours, parental support and sabbaticals.

Embrace Diversity & Sustainability: Engage in our Sustainability Hub, diverse communities, Diversity Taskforce and after-work activities.

Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy public transport tickets, job bikes, access to exclusive Volkswagen employee conditions when leasing or purchasing a vehicle, health offers, supplementary insurances, a pension plan and various discounts.

What We Value

At Diconium, we value and recognize the unique perspectives and experiences of each individual. With this in mind, we welcome and cherish every single application equally. At the same time, we stand up against any type of discrimination and harassment based on gender, age, skin color, religion, sexual orientation, origin, disability, gender identity and other protected characteristics.

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out.

Your contact person is

Maren, maren.hennig@diconium.com

job_description_raw_html:
Calling all AI and machine learning experts! We have a fantastic opportunity to join our team in Hong Kong.

Artificial intelligence is shaping the future of insurance. Our latest lab is located in the Hong Kong Science and Technology Park to turn this vision into a reality. As Canada's largest home, auto and business insurer, we're here to cultivate the next generation of technology and talent. Together, we're helping our customers protect what matters to them most through the power of data science, machine learning and AI.

Life in the Lab

Technology is only as good as the people behind it. Every day at work, you’ll inspire and be inspired by the brilliant minds of our greater lab team: actuaries, data scientists, machine learning experts, geomathematicians, meteorologists, software engineers and designers.

Together, you will tackle challenging problems and have the freedom to imagine, research, create, test, and bring innovative solutions to life that will have a profound impact on our business and the needs of our customers.

As our company grows, your career will grow with it. There will always be an opportunity for you to develop your leadership skills, strengthen your expertise or take your work in a new direction. Whether it’s leading a new, exciting project or moving into a different A.I. product team in Canada or Hong Kong, your career will always be on the move.

The Intact Lab, headquartered in Montreal, Canada, is a fast-growing digital innovation hub backed by Intact Financial Corporation (TSX: IFC, HK$110 billion in market cap), Canada's largest home, auto, and business insurance company.

Intact Lab Hong Kong is our first AI R&D centre outside of Canada. This expansion into the Asia Pacific region marks an exciting new chapter in our journey, positioning us within one of the world's most vibrant technology ecosystems.

Artificial intelligence is radically transforming the insurance industry, and Intact is leading the charge. Our Hong Kong hub is a fast-growing, agile team bringing world-class AI innovation to the region.

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our mission: to become the best insurance AI shop in the world.

Life in the Lab

In our Lab, you’ll have the freedom to imagine, research, and build. You won't just be writing code; you'll be solving complex, real-world problems alongside a highly diverse team of world-class experts—including data scientists, machine learning experts, actuaries, meteorologists, software engineers, and designers. As our company grows, so will your career. Whether you want to lead a new project, dive deeper into research, or explore roles across our global offices in Hong Kong and Canada, your career trajectory is limitless.

What You’ll Do Here

  • Use advanced machine learning and statistics to build pioneering solutions for tangible customer and business problems.
  • Play a key role in influencing the AI roadmap for the largest property and casualty insurer in Canada.
  • Transform complex data into meaningful conclusions and deploy predictive models using our modern tech stack
  • Enjoy the freedom to explore and integrate new technologies into our solutions.
  • Share your expertise, mentor interns and fellow engineers, and champion a data-driven culture across the organization.
  • Achieve all of this while maintaining a healthy, genuine work-life balance.

What You Bring To The Table

  • A Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline (Math, Science, Engineering, Statistics, AI, Computer Science). An MSc or PhD is a strong asset.
  • Proven track record in predictive modeling, machine learning, and advanced statistics to solve business challenges.
  • Strong programming skills in Scikit-learn, Xgboost, Pytorch, Tensorflow, LightGBM, Pandas, Numpy.
  • Unlimited curiosity, a passion for challenging the status quo, and the ability to tackle vaguely defined problems with a creative approach.
  • Excellent communication, time management, and organizational skills.

What We Offer

Working here means you'll be empowered to be and do your best every day. Here is some of what you can expect as a permanent member of our team:

  • A financial rewards program that recognizes your success
  • A dynamic workplace learning ecosystem complete with learning journeys, interactive online content, and inspiring programs
  • An extensive flex pension and benefits package, with access to virtual healthcare
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • An annual wellness account that promotes an active and healthy lifestyle
  • Access to tools and resources to support physical and mental health, embracing change and connecting with colleagues
  • Inclusive employee-led networks to educate, inspire, amplify voices, build relationships and provide development opportunities
  • Inspiring leaders and colleagues who will lift you up and help you grow
  • A Community Impact program, because what you care about is a part of what makes you different. And how you contribute to your community should be just as unique

We are an equal opportunity employer

At Intact, we value diversity and strive to create an inclusive, accessible workplace where all individuals feel valued, respected, and heard.

If we can provide a specific adjustment to make the recruitment process more accessible for you, please let us know when we reach out about a job opportunity. We’ll work with you to meet your needs.

Nuneaton | Full-time | Permanent | Hybrid

You'll be based from our Nuneaton office, with a minimum of 2 days a week in the office and occasional travel to other Holland & Barrett locations.

Intro

You know how to do the reporting. You understand month-end. You're comfortable in Excel.

Now you want a role where you can get closer to the business.

As a Finance Analyst in our Analyst team team, you'll work with Finance Business Partners and commercial teams to understand what's really driving performance - not just report what happened.

Your initial focus is likely to include Supplier Funding, Supplier P&L and Range Reviews, so you'll get exposure to some genuinely commercial conversations from the start.

And because this sits within our wider Finance Analyst team, there's room for that exposure to broaden as you develop.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Analyse performance against budget, forecast and prior year and get underneath the reasons why.
  • Turn financial and trading data into useful insight for the people making decisions.
  • Support weekly and monthly reporting and the month-end close.
  • Get involved in budgeting, forecasting and scenario modelling.
  • Produce analysis for commercial decisions, investment cases and wider business activity.
  • Work closely with Finance Business Partners and non-Finance teams.
  • Spot opportunities to make reporting and processes simpler and more effective.

What You'll Bring

You'll have experience in a Finance Analyst, Management Accountant or similar role, with a good grounding in accounting and month-end.

You'll be confident using Excel, including Pivot Tables, SUMIFS and lookups.

But the bit we're really interested in is what you do after you've built the spreadsheet.

Can you see what matters? Ask the right questions? Explain the story behind the numbers to someone outside Finance?

If so, you'll probably enjoy this role.

Retail or Commercial Finance experience would be useful, as would Power BI, SQL or working towards CIMA, ACCA or ACA. They're advantages rather than a checklist.

Benefits

Holidays

  • 33 days, including bank holidays
  • Holiday purchase scheme

Health & Wellbeing

  • 24/7 Virtual GP access
  • Private medical insurance – single cover (after 12 months' service)
  • Annual free at-home health testing kit (after 6 months' service)
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Programme and a network of Mental Health First Aiders whenever you need support

Financial Wellbeing

  • Workplace pension with employer contribution
  • Life assurance (2x salary, after 6 months' service)

Reward

  • £50 Colleague product allowance on Holland & Barrett products (after 6 months' service)

Lifestyle & Everyday Benefits

  • Access to cashback and discounts from a wide range of retailers
  • 25% colleague discount, available in store and online
  • Free Wellhub membership, with discounted access to gyms, studios and premium wellbeing apps
  • Cycle to Work scheme

If you want to get closer to the commercial decisions behind the numbers, this could be the role for you.

Bring your finance experience, your curiosity and your ability to turn numbers into something people can use.

About Holland & Barrett

At Holland & Barrett, we exist to make health and wellness a way of life for everyone, adding quality years to life.

We've been trusted for more than 150 years, but we're still changing — how we work, how we use data and technology, and how we make wellness simpler and more accessible.

Inclusion & accessibility statement

We want everyone to feel welcome at Holland & Barrett.

We value different experiences, backgrounds and perspectives, and we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement listed.

If you need any adjustments or additional support during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Holland and Barrett is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diverse perspectives and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all colleagues. We understand that when our colleagues are listened to, respected and valued for who they are, we build an organisation with belonging at its heart – making health and wellness a way of life for everyone.

Holland & Barrett does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Please do not forward resumes to our job alias, employees, or any other company location. Holland & Barrett is not and will not be responsible for any fees if a candidate submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless otherwise agreed with respect to specific open position(s).

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Senior Data Analyst

The opportunity

As our Data Analyst, you will join a team of multidisciplinary professionals in a role that focuses on collecting, combining, and exploring data to create insights that support our clients with their decision-making processes. As part of our team, you will build solutions that utilise our clients’ data to enable insights within the accounting, finance, governance, and regulatory space and pursue automation in the process to create efficiencies.

This role can be performed from any of our EY offices across Australia. Our roles can potentially be adjusted to work flexibly with reduced hours. Please speak with us about potential options.

Your Key Responsibilities

Everything you’ll do will come back to providing exceptional analytics for our clients. Colleagues and clients from diverse backgrounds will look to you for answers, so you will be a key contact when it comes to designing, building, and understanding complex data analytics.

As you build your knowledge and experience, you’ll become a credible advisor, influencing clients and engagement teams on resolutions that will impact future analytics solutions, delivery, and processes.

You will:

  • Consistently deliver exceptional client service solutions to allow our clients to gain greater insight into their data and the value that data analytics can bring to an organisation.
  • Transform how we deliver our services to the client; exploring new ways of doing business and using technology to improve effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Be an active problem solver performing advanced financial analysis and reporting in complex business areas, while building technical competence.
  • Develop business acumen and a comfort level in designing solutions that address client inquiries and emerging issues, including industry practices, and new technologies.

Skills And Attributes For Success

  • Demonstrated experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data transformation, data visualisation, or a related analytics-focused role.
  • Experience working with large, complex and diverse data sources, including the ability to identify data quality issues, anomalies and trends, and transform data into meaningful business insights.
  • Experience developing analytics and data transformation solutions using technologies such as SQL, Python, Alteryx and Power BI (including DAX), and related analytics and data technologies.
  • Experience working within modern data and analytics platforms, including technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Azure data services, or equivalent cloud-based analytics environments.
  • Experience designing and delivering dashboards, reports and visualisations using leading data visualisation platforms such as Power BI, Tableau or Looker.
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to challenge existing approaches and develop practical, value-driven solutions.
  • Ability to understand business objectives and translate stakeholder requirements into scalable analytics and reporting solutions.
  • Experience working within professional services, financial services, banking, retail, government, or other data-intensive industries, with exposure to solution development and analytics delivery.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to present findings, recommendations and insights to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior client stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams, prioritise competing demands and communicate project status, risks and capacity effectively.

Ideally, you’ll also have the skills and attributes below but don’t worry if you don’t tick all the boxes. We’re interested in your aptitude, attitude and willingness to learn.

  • Tertiary education qualification(s) in Business, IT or STEM related disciplines.
  • Developing data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes and analytical solutions using modern data platforms such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, or similar technologies.
  • Building intelligent automation, AI-enabled solutions, machine learning models, AI agents or robotic process automation (RPA) solutions.
  • Applying programming and scripting languages to automate data preparation, transformation, analysis and reporting activities.
  • Exploring and applying emerging technologies, including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI agents, to improve business processes and decision-making.

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. We’re proud to be recognised as the #1 WORK180 Endorsed Employer in the Top 101 Employers for Women 2026.

  • Career development: At EY, your career is yours to shape! We’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences ey.com/au/careerdevelopment
  • Flexible work arrangements: Our flexible work policies empower you to balance your professional and personal life, fostering a culture of trust and autonomy.
  • A comprehensive benefits package: From a yearly wellness incentive, to access to additional 8 weeks of flex leave per year, and family-friendly policies, including up to 26 weeks of gender-neutral paid parental leave, we cater to your diverse needs to help you thrive both personally and professionally www.ey.com/au/benefits    
  • Salary: We offer a competitive salary which is open to negotiation pending on skills and experience.

Acknowledgement of Country

EY acknowledges the Traditional Owners and Custodians of the lands on which EY offices are located around Australia. We pay our respects to their cultures, and to their Elders — past, present, and emerging.

Inclusiveness is core to who we are and how we work together, driving value for our people and for our business. We encourage applications from people of all ages, nationalities, abilities, cultures, sexual orientations, and gender identities and are committed to providing an equitable and barrier free recruitment experience for all.

About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

Voodoo Ad-Network is an autonomous product of around 30 people that carries the ambitious mission of providing ad network services. One goal is to leverage Voodoo’s first-party data to improve Voodoo’s monetisation. Moreover, the product is growing through new ventures like opening up to external inventory, reaching the external-advertisers market and social-network monetisation through BeReal’s recent acquisition. Thanks to promising results, our ambition is now to scale up the team to support growth.

The Ad Experience team owns the end-to-end quality of the ads delivered by our network, from ad rendering to data collection. It has a strong focus on viewability, tracker integrity and the diagnostic signals that feed our Machine Learning models. It’s composed of mostly senior Software Engineers, Mobile Developers, QA Engineers and Full Stack Engineers who iterate together to detect issues quickly, improve the user-side ad experience and protect the quality of the data flowing back into the product.

Role

We’re looking for an Experienced Data Analyst to join our Engineering & Data team. In this role, you will:

  • Work on end-to-end data projects with the Ad Experience squad to improve ad delivery quality, reduce ad-load and rendering failures, and maintain a high data quality.
  • Monitor SDK diagnostic events and build alerting, anomaly detection and root-cause analyses on top of the Ad Experience datasets.
  • Build data collection and transformation pipelines, and actionable dashboards.
  • Analyze large, complex data sets with billions of events representing the behaviour of mobile game players and of our ad network to investigate ad-quality regressions, attribution discrepancies and SDK rollouts.
  • Design solutions from scratch, iterate quickly, create POCs, and deploy to production rapidly.
  • Occasionally leverage Python skills and Statistics skills to support A/B tests on ad-experience changes

Profile

  • You possess substantial experience in analytical roles, ideally within a web or mobile company or the tech or ad tech industry.
  • You are highly skilled in SQL and have a proven track record of building production-ready pipelines that handle large and complex data sets.
  • You have solid experience in ETL development.
  • You have solid experience with DBT.
  • You have practical experience with Tableau or another standard dashboard platform, and can create dashboards that are shared company-wide, facilitating data-driven decision-making across departments.
  • Advanced knowledge of statistical tools and models will be considered a significant advantage.
  • Development skills, particularly in Python, will be considered a significant advantage
  • You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and are able to balance the tradeoff between time-consuming development and rapid results.
  • You have a solid problem solving mindset as well as a great track record demonstrating ownership and ability to come up with innovative ideas.
  • A BA/B.Sc degree in Statistics, Math, Engineering, Economy, or other quantitative fields is mandatory for this role.

Our Stack

  • DBT; Tableau; SQL; Athena; Spark; Python

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Swile Lunch voucher
  • Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)
  • Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family
  • Wellness activities in our Paris office
  • Remote Fridays

Teecom hoạt động trong lĩnh vực thương mại điện tử xuyên biên giới, kinh doanh sản phẩm tiêu dùng tại Mỹ và châu Âu qua Amazon, Etsy, TikTok Shop và Shopify.

Bạn sẽ phụ trách nhu cầu phân tích của nhóm kinh doanh hoặc Performance Marketing được phân công. Quản lý trực tiếp điều phối ưu tiên và nguồn lực, phối hợp cùng Data Engineering và các bộ phận liên quan.

  • Tốt nghiệp đại học ngành Khoa học dữ liệu, Thống kê, Công nghệ thông tin, Kinh tế, Phân tích kinh doanh hoặc ngành liên quan.
  • Có 1–3 năm kinh nghiệm Data Analyst, BI Analyst, Product Analyst, Marketing Analyst hoặc công việc tương đương.
  • Thành thạo SQL và Python, có kinh nghiệm xây dựng dashboard bằng Power BI.
  • Có nền tảng thống kê, hiểu phương pháp phân tích và dữ liệu chuỗi thời gian; biết kiểm chứng kết quả trước khi kết luận.
  • Hiểu KPI và các chỉ số kinh doanh, e-commerce hoặc marketing; có khả năng chuyển kết quả phân tích thành đề xuất thực tế.
  • Có kinh nghiệm làm việc trực tiếp với stakeholder, trình bày rõ ràng cho người không chuyên về dữ liệu.
  • Chủ động đặt câu hỏi, cẩn thận với số liệu, có trách nhiệm với đầu ra và biết ưu tiên công việc.

✨ ĐIỂM CỘNG

  • Kinh nghiệm phân tích trong e-commerce, digital marketing hoặc mô hình kinh doanh đa kênh.
  • Đã ứng dụng forecasting, scenario planning, hypothesis testing hoặc machine learning trong dự án thực tế.

Lancée en 2021 avec l’ambition de devenir l’insurtech européenne de référence sur le risque cyber, Stoïk est soutenue par certains des investisseurs les plus renommés au monde et a co-construit son produit d’assurance avec des assureurs et des réassureurs de premier plan, tels que Tokio Marine HCC et Swiss Re.

Notre modèle va au-delà de l’assurance cyber : nous associons la couverture à nos propres outils de sécurité, à une surveillance 24h/24 et à une équipe interne de réponse à incident qui traite plus de 150 incidents par mois. Notre mission : être le CISO de l’Europe.

Le poste

Nous recherchons un ou une Data Analyst pour rejoindre notre équipe data. Le cœur du poste consiste à créer et à maintenir les graphiques, les chiffres et les rapports qui décrivent l’activité de l’entreprise.

En tant que startup en forte croissance, Stoïk ajuste en permanence sa stratégie commerciale au rythme du lancement de nouveaux produits et de l’ouverture de nouveaux marchés. Les nouvelles fonctionnalités de notre logiciel ont besoin d’indicateurs pour être évaluées. L’analyse de données est donc nécessaire aussi bien pour mesurer le succès du plan en cours que pour préparer le suivant.

Parce qu’elle commercialise des contrats d’assurance, l’entreprise doit suivre son portefeuille afin d’ajuster sa souscription. L’assurance est un produit atypique : le prix facturé est connu d’avance, mais pas le coût pour l’assureur. Un reporting détaillé est donc indispensable pour suivre d’un côté les primes, de l’autre les sinistres.

Acteur de la cybersécurité, Stoïk collecte par ailleurs une grande quantité de données via ses scanners d’infrastructure et de vulnérabilités. Pour prévenir les incidents et réagir vite, ces données doivent être exploitées afin, par exemple, d’alerter les assurés concernés dès la publication d’une nouvelle faille critique.

Principales missions

Échanger avec les autres équipes, en particulier les équipes produit, opérations, finance et customer success, pour identifier les indicateurs qu’elles ont besoin de suivre. Cela suppose de comprendre nos processus produit, commerciaux et assurantiels.

Écrire les transformations nécessaires au calcul de ces indicateurs à partir de nos données brutes. La fiabilité est primordiale. Ces calculs tournant régulièrement, les autres membres de l’équipe data vous aideront à traiter les enjeux d’optimisation.

Choisir, pour chaque grandeur, les chiffres et les visualisations les plus adaptés. Une donnée n’est éclairante que si elle est présentée avec clarté, et un graphique compréhensible d’un seul coup d’œil fait toute la différence.

Travailler sur les droits d’accès aux données, afin que chacun dispose des informations dont il a besoin tout en limitant l’exposition inutile aux données sensibles.

Accompagner les utilisateurs avancés pour qu’ils construisent leurs propres tableaux de bord en s’appuyant sur le travail de l’équipe data.

Profil recherché

Sur le plan technique, nous recherchons un ou une Data Analyst avec :

Une solide maîtrise du SQL (indispensable). Une expérience de PostgreSQL en particulier est un plus, puisque c’est là que s’effectue l’essentiel de nos transformations de données.

Une pratique de la construction de graphiques et de visualisations avec des outils comme Metabase, Tableau, Power BI ou équivalent. Au-delà de la maîtrise d’un logiciel précis, nous cherchons une bonne compréhension de la manière de présenter des chiffres.

L’envie d’automatiser une partie de son propre travail à l’aide d’outils d’IA.

Une expérience préalable des outils d’analytics produit web, comme PostHog, est un plus.

Un premier entretien de découverte

Un test technique à réaliser chez vous

Un second entretien pour échanger sur les résultats du test

Un échange avec les fondateurs

job_description: Senior Data Scientist Role Overview The Senior Data Scientist is a senior technical role combining deep expertise in statistics, mathematics and data preparation with strong capability in machine learning and hands-on programming. The role leads complex analyses, develops scalable solutions and ensures work is rigorous, reproducible and aligned with business needs. Working across departments, the Senior Data Scientist communicates findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders, influences technical decisions and helps colleagues develop their skills. The role demonstrates ownership, sound business judgement, effective execution and resilience, while promoting innovation, continuous learning and responsible use of data. Key Responsibilities Play a key role in data science projects from problem definition through analysis, modelling, implementation and evaluation. Define appropriate statistical, mathematical and machine learning approaches for complex business problems. Lead data exploration, cleaning, transformation and feature engineering to create reliable analytical datasets. Design, implement and optimise machine learning models, with appropriate validation and performance monitoring. Develop maintainable, production-ready Python code using sound software engineering practices. Present findings, limitations and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Collaborate with business, product, engineering and other teams to deliver practical, high-impact solutions. Take ownership of delivery, proactively managing risks, dependencies and changing priorities. Mentor junior data scientists through technical guidance, feedback and knowledge sharing. Evaluate new research, industry developments and methodologies, applying them where they add value. Use cloud-based machine learning services to develop scalable solutions. Required Skills and Experience Technical Skills Deep knowledge of statistics and mathematics, with experience designing rigorous analyses, testing assumptions and interpreting complex results. Strong data-wrangling and cleaning skills, including working with large or imperfect datasets, resolving quality issues and developing reproducible data pipelines. Strong machine learning experience, including model selection, feature engineering, validation, optimisation and performance monitoring. Proficiency in Python and relevant machine learning frameworks, with experience writing clear, tested and maintainable code. Ability to build domain knowledge quickly, assess relevant research critically and apply appropriate methods to business problems. Experience developing scalable data science solutions using GCP or comparable cloud platforms. Ways of Working Takes ownership of project quality, delivery and business impact. Collaborates effectively across technical and business teams and communicates complex ideas clearly. Applies sound business judgement when prioritising work and balancing accuracy, value, cost and delivery time. Executes effectively in ambiguous environments and remains resilient when priorities change or experiments do not succeed. Maintains a continuous-learning mindset and shares knowledge across the team. Mentors junior data scientists and provides constructive technical guidance. Experience and Qualifications Master’s degree or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field, or a bachelor’s degree with significant equivalent experience. Significant experience delivering data science projects from problem definition through implementation and evaluation. Demonstrated proficiency in Python, machine learning frameworks and statistical analysis. Experience communicating recommendations to senior technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience mentoring or technically guiding other data scientists.Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don’t think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other any other dimension of diversity.

Vollzeit

Willkommen bei XXXLdigital, wo digitale Innovation echte Wirkung zeigt. Als digitale Organisationseinheit der XXXL-Gruppe widmen wir uns allen Facetten des E-Commerce und stationärem Handel. About The Role

Responsibilities

 Financial Analysis & Reporting

  • Prepare monthly financial reports, variance analysis, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess the business unit's performance against budget, forecast, and prior periods.
  • Analyze product, customer, and market segment profitability to identify opportunities for revenue growth, cost optimization, and margin improvement.
  • Provide ad-hoc financial analysis and decision support to business unit leaders to evaluate strategic initiatives, investment opportunities, and operational improvements.

Budget Management & Cost Control

  • Monitor and track actual performance against budget and forecast, identifying variances and working with business partners to understand root causes and implement corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and implement cost control initiatives, efficiency improvements, and process enhancements to drive profitability and operational excellence.
  • Support the development of business cases and ROI analysis for capital expenditures, new product launches, and other strategic investments.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in financial analysis, planning, and reporting, preferably in a business unit support or FP&A role.
  • Strong proficiency in financial modeling, forecasting techniques, and data analysis tools (for example, Excel, PowerPoint, Netsuite, Power BI).
  • Solid understanding of accounting principles, financial metrics, and performance measurement concepts.
  • Excellent analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex data into actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex financial and operational data into clear, concise insights and recommendations for non-financial audiences with confidence and sound business judgement.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build trusted relationships across functions, levels, and geographies, and effectively influence business decisions.
  • Comfortable partnering closely with executives and business stakeholders both in person and across global time zones.
  • Experience leveraging AI-enabled and advanced analytics tools to improve financial analysis, forecasting, reporting, process efficiency, and business decision-making.

Consilio’s True North Values

  • Client Experience | Listen for the “why”. Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
  • Collaboration | Treat everyone with respect. Welcome diverse views. Partner across geography, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
  • Innovation | Always be curious (ABC). Challenge the status quo. Experiment and fail forward. Build for the future.
  • Grit | Focus on what matters. Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner. Deliver results you’re proud of.

Turn data into decisions for millions of members

You don’t want to just build models.

You want your insights to be used, trusted, and acted upon.

You want to see decisions being made because of what you built.

At Basic-Fit, your data solutions support millions of members across Europe. Operations, marketing, finance and more will use what you build to make better decisions and to make our member interactions more relevant.

This Is What Your Role Looks Like

You’ll join the Data Platform Team and work side by side with the business to turn their questions into data-driven solutions. You’ll be involved in the entire lifecycle of a solution: from ideation and proof of concept to rollout and post-launch performance tracking.

In a Typical Week, You Might

  • explore our data together with stakeholders and translate business questions into data science solutions
  • design, develop and deploy predictive models on our Databricks platform, across a variety of domains such as operations, marketing and finance
  • set up experiments and A/B tests to measure the real impact of your solutions
  • explore how AI, LLMs and agents can create new value and improve how we work
  • present your results to stakeholders in a way that supports better decision making
  • collaborate with Data Platform Engineers, Analysts and BI Developers to bring solutions into production
  • increase data literacy and demystify data science across the business

Good ideas don’t stay in slide decks here - they get built.

The team you’ll work with

You’ll be part of a multidisciplinary Data Platform Team with:

  • Data Platform Engineers
  • Analysts
  • BI Developers
  • Data Scientists

Together, you support almost every department at Basic-Fit, enabling teams to act on reliable, well-governed data.

Who Are You?

Skills

You’re an analytical thinker who can separate the signal from the noise, spot trends and turn insights into concrete actions. A self-starter with strong team and problem-solving skills. You don’t need to tick every box. You will thrive here if most of this sounds familiar:

  • Bachelor or Master degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Econometrics or a related field
  • 3+ years of relevant work experience in data science
  • Strong knowledge of machine learning algorithms, frameworks and packages, and experience taking models from idea to production
  • Experience developing models across different domains (e.g. operations, marketing, finance), and the flexibility to quickly get up to speed in a new business area
  • Strong skills in Python and SQL, and hands-on experience with Databricks and Spark (PySpark) for large-scale data
  • Proven experience with MLOps practices, such as experiment tracking, model deployment and monitoring (e.g. MLflow)
  • Solid knowledge of statistics: hypothesis testing, experimentation, regression, etc.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, able to explain complex results to non-technical audiences
  • Experience with AI, such as working with LLMs and building agents, is a plus

How We Work Together

The Data Platform Product Owner is responsible for stakeholder engagement, hiring decisions, and the longer-term roadmap. Once priorities are set, you and the PO work closely together to break the roadmap down into manageable steps and drive delivery. You’ll work directly with Data Engineers, BI Developers, Data Scientists, and Data Analysts, being both a technical anchor and a delivery driver for the team.

What We Offer You

At Basic-Fit, it’s not just about work, it’s about your growth. As a Data Scientist, you’ll have the freedom to make an impact and develop yourself in a dynamic environment.

What You Can Expect From Us

  • Learning & Development: Unlimited access to GoodHabitz and LinkedIn Learning.
  • Career Growth: Plenty of opportunities for professional and personal development.
  • Work Culture: An informal, international, and down-to-earth environment. We value working together, so we work 4 days in the office, 1 day from home.
  • Innovation: Your ideas contribute to strategic projects.
  • Salary: A monthly gross salary between €3.500 and €5.300 based on 40 hours, depending on your experience and background.
  • Perks & Benefits: Travel allowance, bike plan, health insurance discounts, remote work allowance.
  • Fitness: Access to our gym at HQ.

About Basic-Fit

Basic-Fit is Europe's leader in the value-for-money fitness market, with more than 4.7 million members across 1,650+ clubs in 6 countries. We are continuously growing and improving. If you're looking for a place where you can make an impact while having fun at work, you've come to the right place!

What Makes Us Unique?

  • Work with Impact: What you do makes a difference. We don’t just work for our members, partners, and teams—we work with them.
  • Collaboration: Everyone works together to achieve goals and celebrate success.
  • Diversity & Inclusion: We welcome everyone into our workplace.

🎯 Apply Now!

Ready for your next adventure? Click the Apply button, and we’ll get in touch with you as soon as possible.

Questions? Feel free to contact Yara at yara.vanbodegom@basic-fit.com.

Who We Are:

ACAMS is the global leader in certification, training, and intelligence for anti-financial crime (AFC) professionals. ACAMS sets the standard for how organizations prevent, detect, and respond to money laundering, fraud and sanctions evasion. Trusted by 70% of the world's leading banks, as well as governmental and law enforcement agencies, and FinTechs, the organization has 120,000+ members across 200+ countries and territories. Its 65+ chapters and annual conferences connect AFC professionals across every major financial center. Learn more at acams.org.

Opportunity at a Glance

As a Senior Financial Analyst at ACAMS, you will play a crucial role in the financial planning and analysis of our business. Your main responsibility will be to analyze financial data and provide recommendations to management on how to improve the company's financial performance. You will work closely with cross-functional teams such as sales, marketing, product, and operations to gather insights and develop forecasts that will drive business growth. This position offers an exciting opportunity for a talented individual with a strong analytical mindset and a passion for financial excellence.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct in-depth financial analysis, including forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, to support strategic decision-making across all business functions.
  • Assist in annual budget preparation and regularly monitor budget adherence, identifying areas for cost optimization.
  • Develop comprehensive financial models for budgeting, forecasts, and scenario analysis to provide management with actionable insights into future financial performance.
  • Regularly evaluate and report on financial performance and key performance indicators (KPIs), identifying areas for cost optimization and profit enhancement.
  • Analyze market trends, industry benchmarks, and the competitive landscape to provide strategic recommendations for optimizing financial performance and business growth.
  • Assess and model investment opportunities, including potential mergers and acquisitions, ensuring strategic alignment and financial viability.
  • Identify financial risks and recommend strategies for risk mitigation to safeguard the company's financial stability.
  • Prepare and present clear and concise financial reports to senior management, offering insights into financial trends, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify financial risks and recommend mitigation strategies, ensuring long-term financial stability and drive financial best practices across the organization.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 - 7 years finance and /or accounting experience (e.g., FP&A, accounting, corporate finance).
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Accounting, Finance, or related field; an MBA in Finance, CPA, or CFA certification is strongly preferred.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial modeling; experience with financial tools like SmartView, NetSuite, Power Query, and Power Pivot is highly desirable. Advanced Microsoft PowerPoint skills and experience developing high-quality work product.
  • Exceptional ability to analyze complex data and communicate insights effectively to senior leadership, influencing business decisions.
  • Strong problem-solving, organizational, and critical-thinking skills with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Commitment to company values and business ethics.
  • This is a hybrid role (3 days in office) / must live in reasonable vicinity to DC office location.

EEO

We are proud to be an EEO employer M/F/D/V. At ACAMS, we welcome everyone and have a strong commitment towards diversity and inclusion. We encourage our Colleagues to be their true authentic selves and support laws that prohibit discrimination everywhere we do business. We also maintain a drug-free workplace.

General Description:

The Senior Financial Analyst plays a key role in financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, performance analysis, and decision support across the organization. This position partners closely with Finance and cross-functional business leaders to translate financial and operational data into meaningful insights that support informed decision-making and improved business performance.

The ideal candidate combines strong financial and analytical capabilities with business acumen, intellectual curiosity, and effective communication skills. This role requires someone who can move beyond reporting the numbers to understand what is driving performance, why it matters, and what actions should be considered

  • Financial Planning and Analysis: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and maintain comprehensive financial models, forecasts, and budgets. Conduct variance analysis and provide insightful recommendations to optimize financial performance.
  • Reporting and Presentations: Prepare and present accurate financial reports, dashboards, and presentations to senior management, highlighting key insights, trends, and areas of improvement. Communicate complex financial information in a clear and concise manner.
  • Strategic Decision Support: Partner with business leaders to provide financial guidance and support for strategic initiatives, investment decisions, and business planning. Analyze potential opportunities and risks, and offer actionable recommendations.
  • Forecasting and Budgeting: Lead the forecasting and budgeting processes, ensuring alignment with company goals and objectives. Evaluate historical data, industry trends, and economic factors to develop accurate financial projections.
  • Performance Analysis: Analyze financial and operational performance metrics, identifying areas of improvement and driving cost optimization initiatives. Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide actionable insights to enhance business performance.
  • Financial Modeling: Build complex financial models to support various scenarios and business cases, including pricing analysis, cost projections, and capital investment evaluations. Develop financial models to assess the impact of different strategies and initiatives.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with various departments, including Finance, Operations, Sales, and Marketing, to gather necessary data, validate assumptions, and ensure accurate financial reporting. Foster strong relationships and be a trusted partner to key stakeholders.
  • Process Improvement: Continuously identify opportunities to streamline financial processes, enhance data integrity, and improve efficiency. Implement best practices and contribute to the development of financial systems and tools.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • Master's degree, preferred

Experience:

  • Proven experience (5+ years) as an FP&A Analyst or in a similar finance role.

  • Strong financial modeling skills, with expertise in building complex financial models and conducting sensitivity analysis.

Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to join our Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team. You will create and utilize data-driven analysis that holds the senior leaders of the business accountable to delivering budget targets. This candidate possesses effective communication skills, is self-motivated, is highly organized to meet deadlines, can extract insights from large and multiple data sets, can develop and maintain complex excel models and is passionate about growing the P&L.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Establishing solid business partnerships with leaders across the business
  • Preparing presentations for the Senior Management team
  • Preparing, improving and streamlining the budgeting, forecasting and long term planning process
  • Performing deep analysis and scorecard against budget/forecast monthly and quarterly
  • Responsible for the delivery of accurate and timely month-end variance and management reporting
  • Providing analytical support and financial guidance to help with various business decisions. This includes developing new analyses and improving reports and metrics to better support senior leadership’s decision-making process

And a little bit of…

  • Working on ad hoc projects as assigned; such as assessment of new business activities or change of process
  • Assisting with special requests from the executive team
  • Contributing as part of the wider team to achieve organizational objectives even if this means doing things that aren’t strictly within the scope of your role.

What You Need To Bring

We're looking for a candidate who has experience with the following:

  • 3-5 years in progressive financial analysis experience
  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Accounting or Finance
  • Expert knowledge in Excel
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with financial modeling
  • Proven track record in business partner or corporate FP&A role
  • Highly detail oriented and organized
  • Strong and effective verbal and written communication to interact with all levels of management
  • Demonstrated success working in a deadline driven and multi-task, fast-paced environment
  • Ability to multitask and work quickly while being able to adapt to a rapidly evolving environment

Even Better If You Have, But Not Necessary

  • Experience with Pigment planning tool
  • Knowledge/experience working in a customer support organization

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

Be a changemaker

You’ll Enjoy

  • A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work
  • A culture that celebrates performance
  • The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard
  • Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

  • Flexible paid time off and remote work policies
  • Equity options, because this is your company too
  • Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters
  • Training opportunities to grow your skills and career
  • Health and wellness credit so you feel your best
  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community
  • Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams
  • Computer purchase program to get your personal Macbook
  • Enhanced parental leave to support growing families
  • Etc…

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities

Please note that we ask applicants to disclose any criminal convictions, and we conduct criminal record checks as part of our hiring process for this role.

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who We Are

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Company Description

VERSANT (Nasdaq: VSNT) is an industry-changing media and entertainment business and home to trusted brands that shape culture, inform audiences, and build lasting connections. It operates across four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf, and sports and genre entertainment. These markets are served through a powerful portfolio of iconic and innovative brands, including CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network, Golf Channel, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Versant's sports division USA Sports, along with complementary digital assets including Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow and GolfPass.

Job Description

The Opportunity

Versant is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to join our Finance team supporting Fandango and its portfolio of businesses. Reporting to the Director of Finance, this role will play a critical part in financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, and strategic decision support across domestic and international operations.

This position is ideal for a finance professional who thrives in a dynamic environment, enjoys translating complex data into actionable business insights, and is motivated by influencing decisions that drive growth and operational excellence.

Why This Role Matters

The Senior Financial Analyst will help business leaders understand performance drivers, identify opportunities for growth, and make informed strategic decisions. Through rigorous financial analysis, forecasting, and executive-level reporting, this role directly contributes to the company's ability to achieve its financial and operational objectives.

Work Environment

This is a hybrid position based in Orlando, FL with an expectation of working from the office a minimum of three days per week.

What You'll Do

  • Support financial planning and analysis activities, including budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, and cash management across domestic and international business operations.
  • Develop, refine, and monitor key business performance indicators (KPIs), delivering data-driven insights and recommendations that influence strategic decision-making.
  • Build and maintain financial models, dashboards, and reporting tools that provide visibility into business performance and growth opportunities.
  • Partner with Finance leadership and business stakeholders to support annual operating plans, long-range strategic planning, and financial goal setting.
  • Prepare executive- and leadership-level presentations, analyses, and reporting materials that clearly communicate financial performance and business trends.
  • Evaluate strategic initiatives and partnership opportunities through financial analysis and scenario modeling.
  • Maintain and optimize financial planning systems, databases, and reporting structures to improve efficiency and accuracy.
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships across finance, operations, and business leadership teams to support organizational priorities.

Qualifications

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of progressive experience in finance, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), accounting, consulting, corporate development, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience developing financial models, analyzing business performance, and preparing executive-level reporting and presentations.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Hyperion Essbase, SAP, or similar financial planning and reporting systems.
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders and business leaders to drive financial and operational outcomes.
  • Experience supporting media, digital, technology, entertainment, or consumer-facing businesses.

How We Do It At Versant

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

  • Trust by delivering accurate financial analysis, exercising sound judgment, and maintaining the highest standards of integrity.
  • Teamwork by building strong relationships and collaborating effectively across Finance, Operations, and business teams.
  • Transparency by communicating insights clearly, proactively sharing information, and supporting data-informed decision-making.
  • Agility by adapting quickly to changing priorities, navigating ambiguity, and balancing multiple business needs.
  • Entrepreneurial Spirit by identifying opportunities for improvement, driving efficiencies, and bringing innovative solutions that create value for the business.

Why You'll Love It Here

  • Opportunity to contribute to a portfolio of industry-leading media, entertainment, sports, and digital brands.
  • Exposure to senior leadership and strategic business initiatives that shape company performance.
  • Collaborative culture focused on growth, innovation, and continuous learning.
  • Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, retirement savings, paid time off, and other employee programs and resources.
  • Hybrid work environment based in Orlando, FL with regular in-person collaboration opportunities.

Additional Information

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with a VERSANT Media employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. VERSANT Media's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Venture outside the ordinary - TMX Careers

The TMX group of companies includes leading global exchanges such as the Toronto Stock Exchange, Montreal Exchange, and numerous innovative organizations enhancing capital markets. United as a global team, we’re connecting cross-functionally, traversing industries and geographies, moving opportunity into action, advancing global economic growth, and propelling progress. Through a rich exchange of ideas, meaningful collaboration, and a nimble operating model, we're powering some of the nation's most critical systems, fueling capital formation and innovation, bringing increased opportunity to business visionaries, product ingenuity to consumers, and career exploration to our team.

Ready to be part of the action?

The Senior Financial Analyst serves as a vital Finance Business Partner to Capital Formation business leaders, driving impactful financial planning, analysis, and strategic decision support. In this role, you will collaborate cross-functionally to deliver actionable, data-driven insights, oversee project financial management, safeguard financial data integrity, and support core accounting functions in close alignment with Controllership.

This role is hybrid (2-3 days in office) - based in Toronto, ON.

Key Accountabilities:

Finance Business Partnership & Strategic Decision Support

  • Deliver Actionable Insights: Conduct in-depth analyses of financial results, underlying business drivers, and operational KPIs to provide clear, outcome-oriented recommendations to leadership.
  • Drive Financial Planning Processes: Partner closely with business teams across quarterly forecasting, annual budgeting, and multi-year strategic planning by defining timelines, managing key deliverables, and developing robust revenue and expense models.
  • Lead Strategic Modeling & Business Cases: Provide strategic decision support through dynamic financial modeling, business case development for strategic initiatives, and post-implementation reviews against baseline performance targets.
  • Target Achievement: Collaborate with budget owners and stakeholders across assigned portfolios to monitor performance and ensure financial targets are achieved.

Project Financial Management & Oversight

  • Project Financial Oversight: Oversee project financials across assigned portfolios, monitoring actual spend against approved budgets and delivering comprehensive root-cause analysis on material variances.
  • Capitalization & Governance: Partner with IT, PMO, Business Unit sponsors, and Controllership to ensure completeness and accuracy of monthly project actuals. Evaluate expenditures to determine appropriate capitalization treatment under IFRS and corporate policy, authoring formal accounting memos supporting capitalization decisions.
  • Dynamic Portfolio Planning: Lead the full project planning cycle, managing annual budgets and rolling monthly forecasts while proactively identifying financial risks and opportunities to keep projects on track.

Management Deliverables & Process Innovation

  • Executive Reporting & Visual Dashboards: Deliver monthly management reporting packages, transforming complex financial results and operational metrics into interactive executive dashboards and clear visual narratives.
  • Automation & Modernization: Leverage modern tools, data analytics techniques, and AI-enabled workflows to automate recurring reporting deliverables, drive process efficiencies, and elevate output quality across the finance function.
  • Supplementary Analysis: Prepare targeted schedules, ad-hoc models, and specialized analytics as requested by business teams.

Accounting Collaboration & Controls

  • Close Process Support: Collaborate with the Controllership team on month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities, including journal entry preparation, GL account reviews, and reconciliations across both the balance sheet and income statement.
  • Transaction Integrity: Work across finance teams to maintain accurate general ledger accounting, supporting proper revenue recognition and expense accruals in accordance with relevant accounting standards.

Must Have(s)

  • Education & Credentials: University degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field; a recognized professional accounting designation (CPA) is strongly preferred.
  • Experience: 3–5 years of progressive experience in financial planning and analysis (FP&A).
  • Project Finance: Demonstrated track record in project financial management, business case development, and initiative tracking.
  • Technical & Analytical Expertise: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (complex financial model building, pivot tables) and Google Workspace / Microsoft 365 environments.
  • Modern Tools & Automation: Hands-on experience leveraging modern technologies, data analytics tools, and AI to automate workflows and optimize core finance processes.
  • Core Accounting Knowledge: Solid understanding of accounting principles (IFRS), financial reporting standards, internal controls, and variance analysis best practices.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with proven ability to partner effectively across diverse, multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Critical Thinking: Proven problem-solving ability, adept at challenging assumptions, performing root-cause analysis, and formulating strategic solutions under tight timelines.

Nice to Have(s)

  • Hands-on experience with Workday.
  • Experience building dashboards or reports in Amazon QuickSight or comparable BI visualization tools.

Connection - With site hubs in some of the world’s most multicultural cities, we leverage our size and structure to create rich connections and belonging while experiencing powerful global impact through our work.

Impact - More than a platform, we use our talents to power mission-critical systems that drive global economic advancement, innovation, and growth. As well, our employee-led Team Impact spreads social good via our giving strategy.

Growth - From a growth mindset in our work, to expansion in our business, TMX is home to action-takers energized by the achievement of ambitious growth.

  • Coletar, processar e analisar dados de diversas fontes para gerar insights estratégicos;

  • Identificar padrões, tendências e anomalias nos dados utilizando ferramentas analíticas;
  • Realizar limpeza e validação de dados para garantir qualidade e confiabilidade das informações;
  • Colaborar com diferentes áreas da empresa para compreender necessidades analíticas e apresentar soluções;
  • Documentar metodologias, processos e resultados das análises realizadas;
  • Apresentar achados e recomendações em linguagem clara para públicos técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Contribuir para a otimização de processos através de análises de dados.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:


  • Prática em Power BI e experiência na construção de dashboards;
  • Vivência com SQL para realização de consultas em banco de dados;
  • Experiência na utilização de n8n, Copilot Studio e/ou ferramentas de pipeline para criação de agentes;
  • Prática com DAX, linguagem M e Excel na análise e tratamento de dados;
  • Vivência em modelagem dimensional para estruturação e otimização de ambientes analíticos.


O QUE PODE POTENCIALIZAR SUA CANDIDATURA:


  • Conhecimento em IA generativa;
  • Conhecimento em engenharia de prompt;
  • Noções de programação em Python ou R;
  • Experiência na área Comercial ou com Experiência do Cliente;
  • Conhecimento dos produtos comercializados pela Senior;
  • Inglês ou espanhol intermediário;
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em CRM;
  • Vivências na construção de soluções para o time comercial;
  • Certificação em Power BI (PL-300) e/ou certificações relacionadas à plataforma Microsoft de Dados e Analytics.

  • Convênio Médico e Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • PPLR - Participação nos lucros e resultados;
  • Cartão Wiipo com benefícios flexíveis;

Brief Description

Senior Data Scientist

Harbor Health

This is a FULLY REMOTE position

Position Overview

Harbor Health runs both a health plan and a medical group, so data science here sits where cost, risk and care meet. We are hiring Senior Data Scientists to own whole problem areas, not slices of someone else's project: you define the questions that matter, build the analysis or model, put it in front of the people who act on it, and stay with it until the result is in use.

Right now those problem areas are risk adjustment and claims: how sick our members really are, and what is driving the cost of their care. Neither is solved yet, and both move real money. We hire for this profile on an ongoing basis, and the same kind of person will be needed in other parts of the business over time.

Position Duties & Responsibilities

  • Take a vague question from actuarial, finance, operations or clinical leaders, work out the decision behind it, and turn it into a defined problem, a plan and a recommendation, without waiting to be steered.
  • Build the data your work depends on: tables, pipelines and definitions in SQL, Python and dbt, working alongside analytics engineering.
  • Answer the question with the method that fits, from a careful analysis to a forecast or a predictive model, and validate the result before anyone relies on it.
  • Put the result in front of the people who act on it, as a dashboard, a work list for operations or a recommendation for leadership.
  • Own what you ship: its accuracy, its documentation, and whether it gets used and moves a number you can size.
  • Work directly with stakeholders and explain tradeoffs in plain language to technical and non-technical people.
  • Use AI in your daily work, efficiently and responsibly, and share what works with the team.

Desired Professional Skills & Experience

  • A drive toward complex problems. You choose the ones with messy data, disputed definitions and no playbook, and you stay with them until the business has an answer it can act on.

  • Cross-functional partnership. You work directly with stakeholders in business, product and tech, and drive the work to a successful outcome independently.
  • Typically 5+ years of hands-on data science, applied statistics or quantitative modeling, with strong SQL and Python. We work in Snowflake and dbt; experience on any modern cloud data platform transfers.
  • Sound statistical judgment: you know which method fits the problem and how wrong the answer could be.
  • The ability to size what your work changes: a cost, a rate, a capture rate.
  • A bachelor's degree in a quantitative field or equivalent experience. An advanced degree is a plus.

Preferred

Relevant healthcare experience is preferred, not required. Any of these helps:

  • Health plan, provider or value-based care analytics, with claims, eligibility or clinical data.
  • Risk adjustment (HHS-HCC, CMS-HCC, RAF, EDGE, RADV), medical economics (PMPM, utilization, cost trend) or actuarial-adjacent work.

If you come from outside healthcare, for example insurance risk, credit or econometrics, and have solved comparable problems, we want to hear from you.

At Harbor Health, we're transforming healthcare in Texas through collaboration and innovation.
