Data Scientist – Generative AI & Machine Learning

Wealth Management


About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist to join our Wealth Management team, applying machine learning, Generative AI and agentic AI solutions to drive business outcomes.

You will work closely with business stakeholders to develop AI-driven solutions, generate actionable insights from financial data, enhance client investment decisions and optimise business processes.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI, machine learning and Generative AI across Wealth Management.
  • Develop and deploy machine learning and statistical models to support business optimisation, targeted marketing and sales.
  • Apply Generative AI and agentic systems to improve business processes and client outcomes.
  • Analyse financial data from multiple sources to deliver actionable insights for Financial Advisors and clients.
  • Build data visualisations and dashboards using Power BI.
  • Support data-driven investment insights and client decision-making.
  • Maintain model performance documentation, validation and governance.
  • Independently manage projects and engage with key stakeholders.


Essential Skills & Experience

  • Undergraduate or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics or a related STEM discipline.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python, R and/or SQL for data manipulation, modelling and analytics.
  • Proven experience developing Power BI dashboards and reports (mandatory).
  • Knowledge of machine learning techniques, including classification, clustering and optimisation.
  • Understanding of Natural Language Processing (NLP), deep learning and Generative AI.
  • Experience working with databases and analytical technologies.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to independently manage projects and communicate complex findings effectively.
  • Previous experience within the financial services or Wealth Management industry.


Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Generative AI applications and agentic AI systems.
  • Experience with database technologies such as PostgreSQL, Greenplum or Hadoop.
  • Familiarity with Tableau and other business intelligence tools.
  • Experience with model deployment, performance monitoring and model governance.
  • Understanding of financial products, investment decisions and client-focused analytics.

job_description_raw_html:
Lendi Group is transforming the way Australians find, buy and own property. As the company behind Lendi — Australiaʼs original and #1 digital mortgage brand — and the iconic Aussie franchise network, we combine technology, distribution and deep property expertise to support customers across their entire property journey.



Powered by our proprietary AI platform and a national network of 1,300 brokers and 220 retail stores, Lendi Group now manages a $107B+ loan book and continues to set the pace in the industry, recently recognised as Aggregator of the Year.

Through our integrated Find–Buy–Own ecosystem and industry-leading Agentic platform, weʼre redefining how property decisions are made — delivering greater confidence, speed and simplicity for customers.

This role sits at the centre of that next phase of growth.

To learn more about life at Lendi Group check out our blog: https://www.lendi.com.au/inspire/category/life-at-lendi/

  • Innovation at Our Core – We challenge the status quo and push boundaries to create better solutions, with a goal of becoming AI-native by June 2026.
  • Work with the Best – Collaborate with some of the brightest minds in fintech, financial services, and strategy.
  • Make an Impact – Contribute to meaningful projects that shape our business and the future of property finance.
  • Grow & Evolve – Develop your skills and advance your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment.

About the role

Lendi Group is building data and AI capabilities that help customers make better decisions across home lending and related property services.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will turn complex customer and business problems into practical, production-ready machine-learning solutions. You will work across propensity modelling, personalisation, growth, retention and other applied data-science use cases, using techniques such as classification, regression, experimentation and predictive analytics.

This is a hands-on role covering the full lifecycle: framing the problem, understanding the data, developing features and models, deploying solutions, monitoring performance and improving them over time. You will work closely with data engineers, product managers, analysts, software engineers and business stakeholders to deliver measurable outcomes.

Generative and agentic AI will form part of the team’s evolving toolkit, where it is the right solution to the problem. The core of the role is strong applied machine learning and sound data-science judgement.



Job Description

  • Translate customer and business problems into clear analytical and machine-learning objectives.
  • Work with large datasets, event data and feature stores to identify useful signals and build predictive features.
  • Develop, evaluate and improve models for use cases such as propensity, personalisation, growth and retention.
  • Apply appropriate techniques across classification, regression, experimentation, forecasting and other applied data-science problems.
  • Take models through the full product lifecycle, including deployment, automation, monitoring, retraining and ongoing maintenance.
  • Help improve data quality, feature pipelines, model monitoring, drift detection and ML Ops practices.
  • Work with product managers and business stakeholders to define success measures and translate model outputs into action.
  • Explain technical approaches, assumptions and results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborate with data, software and AI engineering teams to review solutions, improve coding standards and share knowledge.
  • Contribute to technical documentation, design discussions and delivery planning.
  • Work with external partners or vendors where required to deliver the right solution.

Qualifications

  • Commercial experience as a Data Scientist, Applied Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer or in a closely related role.
  • Strong Python skills and experience writing maintainable, tested and production-quality code.
  • Strong foundations in probability, statistics, model evaluation and machine-learning fundamentals.
  • Practical experience with classification, regression, feature engineering and experimentation.
  • Experience developing, deploying and maintaining machine-learning models in a cloud environment such as Databricks, AWS SageMaker, Azure ML or an equivalent platform.
  • An understanding of data pipelines, feature stores, data quality, model monitoring, drift and retraining.
  • Experience working across the full model lifecycle, from problem definition through to production and ongoing improvement.
  • The ability to work effectively with product managers, engineers, analysts and senior business stakeholders.
  • A collaborative approach to code reviews, documentation, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
  • Good judgement about when to use a simple, explainable approach and when a more advanced technique is justified.

It would be useful if you also have

  • Experience with generative AI, large language models or agentic AI applications.
  • Experience with recommendation systems, personalisation or customer propensity modelling.
  • Experience with natural language processing, time-series forecasting or financial modelling.
  • Experience with MLflow, Git-based CI/CD, dbt or related data and ML engineering practices.
  • Experience with R or Scala.
  • Experience presenting data and model outputs using tools such as Streamlit, Power BI or Tableau.

Additional Information

Lendi Group teams operate across Australia and the Philippines. Bringing together diverse expertise, innovative technology and a customer-first approach, our teams work seamlessly to simplify the property journey, helping Australians find, buy and own property with confidence.

We support our people in a variety of ways, but a few of the benefits that our people rave about include:

  • A vibrant, relaxed, yet professional culture.
  • Hybrid working arrangement designed to support work-life balance, while fostering meaningful connection and collaboration.
  • A holistic wellbeing programs offering 24/7 support, including medical, mental health, and financial wellbeing services to enable our workforce to thrive at home and work.
  • Generous paid Parental Leave: we celebrate our growing Lendi Group family with 18-26 weeks leave for primary carers and up to 4 weeks for secondary carers.
  • An additional week’s Loyalty Leave each year after reaching 3 years’ service.
  • Wellness initiatives with a strong focus on psychological safety.

We’re committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive community at Lendi Group. We believe that a team reflecting the world around us leads to greater innovation, stronger collaboration, and a more engaging workplace.

Our culture is guided by our 3 core values: We Are Stronger United; Act Like You Own It; and Keep Home Loans Human. Our values are part of our core DNA that helps Lendi Group to attract, engage and evolve the right talent and build best-in-class products.

This is an opportunity to shape the future of a fast-growing, purpose-driven company that’s transforming the homeownership journey.

Ready to contribute to Lendi Group’s next chapter? Apply now and be part of something big!

This role is central to strengthening data quality, ensuring timely insights for senior leadership, and maintaining reporting accuracy that meets the expectations for executive consumption.

In addition to core reporting responsibilities, the analyst will assist with opportunity review during non‑peak reporting periods.

The ideal candidate brings strong analytical capability, impeccable attention to detail, and an excellent understanding of CRM/Sales systems, with proven experience in reporting for senior audiences.

This role will be based in the Noida/ Bengaluru office.

Responsibilities

Executive Reporting & Analytics

  • Develop, maintain, and deliver executive-level dashboards and reports with zero‑defect accuracy, supporting US leadership’s strategic decision‑making.
  • Analyze large, complex datasets to identify trends, exceptions, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Validate weekly and monthly reporting inputs to ensure completeness and correctness, addressing the gaps previously observed in team reporting.
  • Collaborate with SGT leaders to clarify reporting requirements and ensure output meets expectations.


Data Quality, Governance & System Support

  • Conduct data audits, cleanse datasets, and troubleshoot discrepancies across system.
  • Partner with technical teams to recommend improvements to data flows and business processes.
  • Support review of missing or incorrect data fields in opportunities and take corrective actions aligned with Horizon standards.
  • Assist with structural data requirements for new software tools and maintain accurate data models.


Opportunity Review

  • Provide supplemental support for opportunity review during workload surges, ensuring SGT remains current on weekly pipelines as directed by leadership.
  • Prioritize core reporting tasks before accepting additional intake—reflecting leadership’s requirement that reporting accuracy must not be compromised by backlog work.


Collaboration & Stakeholder Communication

  • Work closely with Horizon Sales Administrators and PMs.
  • Proactively communicate blockers or data issues and recommend solutions for continuous improvement.
  • Work with management to prioritize business and information needs and propose solutions and strategies to business challenges
  • Analyze and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets using statistical techniques and provide ongoing reports
  • Acquire data from primary or secondary data sources and undertake pre-processing of structured and unstructured data
  • “Clean” data by reviewing performance indicators to locate and correct code problems
  • Create and implement databases, data collection systems, data analytics, and other strategies that optimize statistical efficiency and quality
  • Analyse structural requirements and advise data architecture for new software and applications development by collaborating with engineering and product development teams
  • Locate and define new process improvement opportunities and identify valuable data sources to automate collection processes
  • Where essential, propose migration of data from legacy systems to new solutions
  • Design conceptual and logical data models and flowcharts. Present information using data visualization techniques
  • Build predictive models and machine-learning algorithms


Qualifications

Key Competencies / Skills / Qualifications

Masters in Computer Science/Statistics/Maths/Information Technology

  • Relevant domain certifications
  • Proven work experience of 4-7 years as a Data Analyst or similar role
  • Technical expertise regarding data models, database design development, data mining, and segmentation techniques
  • Strong experience with SQL, Python/R, Excel, and enterprise BI tools (Tableau, Power BI).
  • Solid understanding of Sales CRM systems, preferably Horizon or other enterprise CRM environments.
  • Ability to analyze large datasets, identify anomalies, and provide actionable insights.
  • Strong communication skills to present findings clearly to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage competing tasks without compromising data accuracy or deadlines.


BGV:

  • Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.

With approximately 4,000 talented people across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than 73,000 globally, in 550 offices across 40 countries, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.

At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones: Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.

 www.wsp.com

  • Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future.
  • A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.
  • A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues.


Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.

Working with Us

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

🧑 💻 Pourquoi ce rôle est clé ?

En tant que Data Analyst Senior, vous occuperez un rôle stratégique au niveau de la data, de la business intelligence et de l'intelligence artificielle. Votre mission principale sera de transformer la donnée en leviers d'action concrets pour les équipes métiers, en consolidant le pilotage analytique et en intégrant des solutions d'IA pour affiner la prise de décision.


🎯 Vos missions au quotidien :

Pilotage de la performance :

  • Assurer un rôle de pilotage data et analytique complet, en définissant et en suivant les indicateurs de performance clés (KPI) pour le business.


Définition de stratégies :

  • Contribuer activement à la définition des stratégies, notamment en matière de merchandising et de négociation, en fournissant des analyses et des recommandations basées sur les données.


Optimisation de l'écosystème de reporting :

  • Gérer et rationaliser l'ensemble des tableaux de bord existants. L'objectif est de réduire le nombre de dashboards pour aboutir à une constellation d'outils plus efficaces et pertinents.


Développement d'outils analytiques :

  • Concevoir et mettre en place des outils de reporting stratégiques, tels qu'un Revenue Performance Dashboard, pour offrir une vision claire et consolidée de la performance financière.


Analyse avancée assistée par l'IA :

  • Mener des analyses complexes et des raisonnements "au cas d'usage" en exploitant des technologies d'Intelligence Artificielle. Utiliser l'IA comme un levier pour explorer les données et formuler des hypothèses d'action.


🧩 Stack technique :

  • Langages : Python, SQL
  • Bases de données : BigQuery
  • Outils de Business Intelligence & Visualisation : Looker, Tableau
  • Formats de données : CSV, JSON, Avro
  • Outils de gestion projet : Jira, Confluence

  • 8 ans d'expérience en tant que Data Analyst.
  • Diplômé d'un master ou d'une école d'ingénieur avec une spécialisation en Data Analyse, intelligence artificielle ou data science.
  • Aisance relationnelle, esprit collaboratif et appétence pour l'amélioration continue.

✔️ Une structure à taille humaine : favorisant l’échange, l’autonomie et l’innovation, où votre impact est direct et visible.

New Permanent Opportunity for a Security Cleared Data Analyst

  • Must have active SC Clearance
  • Mid to Senior levels available
  • Up to £60k DoE plus package
  • Hybrid working – bases in Bristol, London, Manchester or Swansea


Who are we?

Our client is a leading technology consultancy delivering complex digital and data transformation programmes across the UK public sector.

Their teams work with clients to make better use of their data, delivering analytical solutions and insights that support better decision-making across a range of critical services.


What will the Data Analyst be doing?

You’ll be responsible for analysing data and turning complex datasets into clear, actionable insights, working closely with clients and technical teams to solve challenging business problems.

The role will involve data analysis, statistical techniques, data visualisation and communicating findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Key responsibilities include:

  • Analysing and interpreting complex datasets to identify trends, relationships and actionable insights
  • Applying statistical techniques including hypothesis testing, regression and clustering
  • Carrying out data mining, profiling and exploratory analysis across varied datasets
  • Cleaning, standardising and transforming data to improve its quality and usability
  • Performing data linkage and integrating information from multiple sources
  • Developing data models and selecting appropriate analytical approaches to answer business questions
  • Creating clear and effective data visualisations to communicate findings
  • Translating analytical results into meaningful recommendations for clients and stakeholders
  • Applying appropriate data governance, security and quality practices throughout analytical work
  • Working with clients to understand requirements and communicate complex findings to non-technical audiences


Key Skills and Requirements

  • Commercial experience working in a Data Analysis role
  • Strong analytical and statistical skills with experience interpreting complex datasets
  • Experience with statistical techniques such as regression, hypothesis testing and clustering
  • Strong SQL skills and experience using Python for data analysis would be advantageous
  • Experience with data cleansing, standardisation, profiling and validation
  • Understanding of data modelling, data integration and data linkage
  • Experience creating data visualisations and communicating insights effectively
  • Understanding of data governance, security and data quality principles
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly with non-technical audiences
  • Experience contributing to analytical approaches and supporting wider project delivery would be advantageous


To be Considered:

Please either apply online or email me directly at dillon.lewis@searchability.com. For further information, please call 0161 416 6800 or 07842002378. I can make myself available outside normal working hours, from 7am until 10pm. If unavailable, please leave a message and either myself or one of my colleagues will respond.


By applying for this role, you give express consent for us to process and submit (subject to required skills) your application to our client in conjunction with this vacancy only.

Feel free to connect with me on LinkedIn by searching for Dillon Lewis.

About Us

Great Place To Work is the global authority on workplace culture. Our mission is to help every place become a Great Place To Work for all. We give leaders and organizations the recognition and tools to create a consistently and overwhelmingly positive employee experience, fostering cultures that are proven to drive business, improve lives, and better society.

Our recognition is the most coveted and respected in the world for elevating employer brands to attract the right people. Our proprietary methodology and platform enable organizations to capture truly, analyze, and understand the experience of all employees. Our groundbreaking research empowers organizations to build cultures that retain talent and unlock the potential of every employee. Our coaches, content, and community connect the boldest leaders, ideas, and innovations in employee experience. Since 1992, our Certification, Best Workplaces Lists, and global benchmarks have become the industry standard, built on data from more than 100 million employees in 150 countries around the world. Visit our website at https://greatplacetowork.me/.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Data Management & Advanced Analysis

  • Data Collection & Preparation: Collate, clean, filter, and organize large datasets from various sources such as databases, spreadsheets, and external APIs. Use existing R scripts and support coding, analyzing, and collating survey data.
  • Data Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough validation and consistency checks, resolving discrepancies to maintain high data integrity.
  • Statistical Analysis: Perform exploratory, descriptive, inferential, and multivariate statistical analyses. Apply appropriate tests to establish the significance of results and provide evidence-based conclusions.

Visualization, Reporting & Presentation

  • Develop clear, impactful dashboards, charts, and reports using Tableau, Power BI, or Excel, presenting complex data in a simplified, compelling way.
  • Prepare and deliver presentations that effectively communicate data insights, trends, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Prepare regular and ad-hoc reports tailored to diverse stakeholders, ensuring outputs are both insightful and accessible.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Culture Coaches, Customer Success, Marketing, Sales, and the Lists team to ensure data quality supports business needs and enhances products.
  • Assist senior team members on strategic or ad-hoc projects, delivering data-driven support that influences key decisions.

Research & Continuous Improvement

  • Research and identify emerging data trends relevant to workplace culture, exploring new ways Great Place to Work can analyze and present data for impact.
  • Recommend enhancements to data analysis methods, tools, and workflows to drive efficiency and insight.

Problem-Solving & Optimization

  • Use data creatively to help solve business challenges. Translate complex problems into analytical tasks, identify patterns, and propose actionable solutions.

Data Privacy & Compliance

  • Maintain strict confidentiality and handle data responsibly, ensuring compliance with data privacy regulations and internal governance standards.

Professional Growth

  • Stay current with industry trends, tools, and techniques in data analytics, visualization, and machine learning. Continually develop expertise in statistical analysis and advanced data methods.

Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Sociology, or Quantitative Psychology.
  • Experience: Minimum 5 years in a dedicated data analysis role, with demonstrated experience in:
    • Cleaning, transforming, and merging large datasets from multiple sources.
    • Conducting descriptive, inferential, and multivariate statistical analyses.
    • Developing advanced dashboards and visualizations.
    • Presenting complex data and insights clearly in both written reports and live presentations.
Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in statistical analysis tools such as R, Python, SPSS, or STATA.
  • Strong SQL skills for querying and managing relational databases.
  • Advanced Excel, including pivot tables and complex formulas.
  • Skilled in data visualization platforms like Tableau or Power BI.

Core Competencies

  • Analytical Mindset: Ability to distill complex datasets into clear, actionable insights.
  • Attention to Detail: Commitment to data accuracy, validation, and high standards.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written skills to present complex findings in a simple, impactful manner, including confident delivery of presentations.
  • Collaboration: Effective team player who works well with remote and cross-functional teams.
  • Organization & Time Management: Capable of managing multiple priorities and meeting tight deadlines.
  • Adaptability: Quickly learns new tools and adjusts to evolving business needs.
  • Solution-Focused: Uses data creatively to identify opportunities and solve problems.

The scope of this role may grow or evolve over time in alignment with the organization’s strategic priorities and business needs.

✅ Location Note:

This is a fully remote role based in Egypt, requiring strong virtual collaboration with regional and international teams. Standard business hours apply, with flexibility to support cross-time zone meetings as needed.

Join us in shaping the future of work in Egypt and empowering organizations to create great workplaces For All™.

Job Description:

1. Melakukan pengumpulan, pengolahan, dan analisis data bisnis untuk mendukung evaluasi kinerja serta pengambilan keputusan strategis perusahaan.

2. Melakukan analisis terhadap pencapaian target bisnis, produktivitas, pertumbuhan portofolio, dan indikator kinerja utama (Key Performance Indicators/KPI).

3. Mengidentifikasi tren, pola, peluang, serta potensi permasalahan bisnis berdasarkan hasil analisis data.

4. Menyusun laporan analisis kinerja bisnis secara berkala maupun insidental sebagai bahan evaluasi dan pertimbangan manajemen.

5. Mengembangkan dashboard dan visualisasi data untuk memantau perkembangan serta pencapaian kinerja bisnis.

6. Melakukan analisis terhadap efektivitas strategi dan program bisnis serta memberikan rekomendasi perbaikan berbasis data.

7. Melakukan monitoring terhadap perkembangan kinerja bisnis dan mengidentifikasi potensi risiko maupun area yang memerlukan peningkatan.

8. Berkoordinasi dengan unit kerja terkait dalam pemenuhan kebutuhan data, penyusunan laporan, dan pendalaman hasil analisis bisnis.

9. Mengembangkan metode analisis dan pengolahan data guna meningkatkan efektivitas monitoring serta kualitas pelaporan bisnis.


Kualifikasi:

1. Pendidikan minimal S1 dari jurusan Statistika, Matematika, Ilmu Komputer, Sistem Informasi, Teknik Informatika, Ekonomi, Manajemen, atau bidang lain yang relevan.

2. Memiliki kemampuan berpikir analitis, strategis, kritis, dan terbuka terhadap ide maupun perspektif baru (open-minded).

3. Adaptif, inovatif, proaktif, serta mampu mengidentifikasi permasalahan dan memberikan solusi berbasis data.

4. Memiliki kemampuan dalam pengolahan data, analisis statistik, interpretasi data, serta penyusunan laporan analisis.

5. Menguasai bahasa pemrograman dan tools pengolahan data, seperti Python, R, SQL, Microsoft Excel, atau tools sejenis.

6. Mampu menggunakan tools visualisasi data seperti Tableau, Power BI, atau tools sejenis.

7. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi data yang baik (data storytelling), termasuk menyajikan hasil analisis dan insight secara informatif serta mudah dipahami.

8. Memiliki integritas, ketelitian, dan tanggung jawab yang tinggi dalam mengelola data.

9. Mampu bekerja secara multitasking, mengelola waktu dan skala prioritas, serta melakukan monitoring pekerjaan dengan baik.

10. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan presentasi yang baik serta percaya diri dalam menyampaikan ide, gagasan, dan hasil analisis di depan umum.

Location: Hybrid, Lisbon

At BCA, we’re altogether, more. More than just your average vehicle remarketing company. More than just any other place to work. We’re Europe's largest vehicle remarketing business, the backbone of the automotive supply chain.

Translate the results into practical solutions that can be embedded into business processes, such as Power BI reports or other decision-support tools

My client based in Dublin is seeking a Data Analyst to join an established and expanding data team. This is a perm role. The position will focus on using data to answer key business questions, improve performance and support better commercial and operational decisions. You'll work with a broad range of datasets and collaborate with teams across data, technology and the wider business.


The role offers plenty of scope to go beyond standard reporting, with an emphasis on investigating data, spotting patterns and providing recommendations that can make a measurable difference. You'll take ownership of analytical requirements from initial investigation through to presenting findings and recommendations.


Key responsibilities will include:

  • Interrogate and analyse large, complex datasets to answer business questions and uncover useful insights.
  • Identify patterns, emerging trends, potential risks and opportunities for performance improvement.
  • Develop analysis that supports commercial, operational and strategic decision-making.
  • Work alongside Data Engineers to understand data availability, quality and structure.
  • Collaborate with reporting and visualisation specialists to improve dashboards and management information.
  • Add context and interpretation to reporting, helping stakeholders understand what the data means and what actions should be considered.
  • Communicate findings in a straightforward and engaging way to stakeholders with varying levels of technical knowledge.
  • Help improve data quality, governance and analytical processes.
  • Investigate opportunities to introduce more advanced analytics, including machine learning and AI techniques.
  • Contribute ideas and best practices as the organisation continues to develop its data and analytics capabilities.


The successful candidate will have:

  • 5+ years' professional experience working in data analysis, analytics or reporting.
  • A relevant third-level qualification in areas such as Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Information Systems or a similar discipline.
  • Strong hands-on SQL experience and confidence working with large datasets.
  • Experience with data extraction, transformation, manipulation and segmentation.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn raw data into useful business conclusions.
  • 2+ years' experience using Python or R for data analysis.
  • A solid understanding of databases, data models and data structures.
  • Good knowledge of Business Intelligence concepts and reporting practices.
  • Practical experience with at least one major BI platform such as Power BI, Tableau or Qlik.


Nice to Have

Experience in any of the following would be beneficial:

  • Financial services or another highly data-driven sector.
  • Predictive modelling or advanced analytics.
  • Machine learning or AI-related analytical projects.


You'll be comfortable taking ownership of your workload and working through analytical problems with limited supervision. You'll have the curiosity to dig deeper into the data rather than simply producing reports based on predefined requirements.

You'll also need strong stakeholder skills. The role involves working with people across technical and business functions, so being able to explain analytical concepts and recommendations clearly is essential.

Data Analyst



Why Apply?

An opportunity for a hands-on Data Analyst to play a key role in supporting business decision-making through detailed analysis, reporting and insight.

Working closely with the Data Lead, you'll take ownership of analytical requests from senior leadership, third parties and wider business stakeholders. You'll dig into the detail, identify trends and anomalies, and turn complex data into clear, meaningful outputs that help the business better understand its performance and make informed decisions.

You'll also support the ongoing development of the data function, working alongside the Data Lead as they build a new data platform using Microsoft Fabric.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data, is confident using SQL and Excel, and can operate independently to deliver accurate, insightful analysis.

Data Analyst Responsibilities

  • Manage analytical requests from senior stakeholders, delivering detailed investigations and deep dives into key business areas.

  • Use SQL to extract, interrogate and analyse data, identifying trends, patterns and anomalies.

  • Translate analytical findings into clear, concise outputs tailored to different audiences, from executive summaries to detailed data extracts.

  • Prepare, validate and quality-check data outputs for external partners and third parties, ensuring accuracy and consistency.

  • Use Excel and Connected Sheets to manipulate, analyse and present data effectively.

  • Identify opportunities, issues and insights that may not have been immediately apparent to the wider business.

  • Support the Data Lead with smaller development tasks, reporting requirements and dashboarding as required.

Data Analyst Requirements

  • Good working knowledge of SQL and experience using it for data analysis and reporting.

  • Strong Excel skills, with the ability to manipulate, analyse and present data.

  • Experience with Connected Sheets would be advantageous.

  • Confidence producing visual outputs using charts, graphs and other reporting techniques.

  • Ability to interpret complex data and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • A proactive approach, with the ability to work independently, manage analytical requests and take ownership of deliverables.

Desirable experience:

  • Google BigQuery.

  • Power BI and dashboard development.

  • Microsoft Fabric or experience working within a developing data environment.

What's in it for me?

The opportunity to take ownership of meaningful analytical work, engage directly with senior stakeholders and help shape how data is used across the business.

You'll work closely with the Data Lead, playing an important role in supporting day-to-day analytical requirements while contributing to the evolution of the wider data function and its move towards Microsoft Fabric.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all backgrounds. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Introduction

At IBM Consulting UK FutureNow, you’ll build a career at the forefront of hybrid cloud and AI, working with leading clients across the public and private sectors.

You’ll collaborate with top industry professionals, gain hands on experience with cutting edge technologies, and deliver solutions that create real business impact. From day one, you’ll work on meaningful, high profile programmes that stretch your skills and accelerate your growth.

We invest heavily in you—supporting continuous learning, in demand skills development, and long term career progression. You’ll thrive in a flexible, inclusive environment that values curiosity, encourages reinvention, and recognises what makes you unique.

We Offer

  • Tools and policies to support your work-life balance from flexible working approaches, sabbatical programs, paid paternity leave, maternity leave and an innovative maternity returners scheme
  • More traditional benefits, such as 25 days holiday (in addition to public holidays), private medical, dental & optical cover, online shopping discounts, an Employee Assistance Program, life assurance and a group pension plan through salary sacrifice.

Your Role And Responsibilities

We are looking for a Technical Business Analyst to join our delivery team and help shape high quality digital and technology solutions. In this role, you will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, developers, testers, and vendors to gather and document requirements, analyse problems, and ensure that technical solutions meet business needs.

You will translate complex business objectives into clear functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows. You will support all stages of the SDLC, helping teams understand dependencies, evaluate impacts, and deliver high quality outcomes. Your ability to communicate clearly, analyse issues, and facilitate workshops will be essential as you help shape solution design and guide delivery teams.

As a Technical BA, you will also bring a practical understanding of how systems integrate, how APIs and data flows behave, and how non functional requirements influence technology decisions. Depending on your experience, you may lead requirement workstreams, mentor other analysts, or contribute to account level planning and stakeholder management.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, engaging with both business and technical teams, and helping deliver solutions that add real value, we would love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather and document business and functional requirements.
  • Create user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, and use cases.
  • Perform gap analysis, impact analysis, and solution assessments.
  • Work with developers, testers, architects, and vendors to clarify requirements.
  • Support Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning and backlog refinement.
  • Assist with testing activities by validating requirements and reviewing results.
  • Depending on experience, help guide workshops, mentor team members, or support stakeholder engagement.

Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Strong requirement gathering and documentation skills
  • Functional specification writing (user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases)
  • Impact analysis and gap analysis
  • SDLC knowledge (Agile, iterative, and traditional models)
  • Process mapping (BPMN or equivalent)
  • Understanding of APIs, integration patterns, and system interactions
  • Ability to read/interpret technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and data flow diagrams
  • Understanding of non-functional requirement categories
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management
  • Workshop facilitation
  • Problem‑solving, analytical thinking, and structured reasoning
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, testers, architects, and vendors

This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). An additional range of Personal Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NVS) may apply, this could include meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV).

Senior Financial Analyst – FP&A, Fuel

Department: Corporate Finance

Location: On site, Laval, QC (4204 boulevard Industriel, H7L 0E3)

Type of employment: Permanent, full time (40 hours per week)

THE ROLE

As a Senior Financial Analyst – FP&A, Fuel, you will provide financial analysis, reporting, modelling, and decision support across fuel retail, B2B, EV, and related commercial operations. You will support budgeting, forecasting, performance analysis, and business case development, helping stakeholders understand business performance and make informed decisions.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Fuel Finance, you will deliver accurate financial insights, improve reporting, and contribute to the development of planning and performance management capabilities across the business.

What You’ll Do

Here is an overview of the main responsibilities of this position:

  • Prepare and analyze financial reports across fuel retail, B2B, EV, and related commercial activities.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and month-end performance review processes, ensuring data completeness and accuracy.
  • Assist with fuel profitability analyses and provide clear insights into the factors driving business performance.
  • Prepare variance analyses and commentary, identifying key trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Collaborate with finance, commercial, and operational teams to gather data, validate assumptions, and challenge results where appropriate.
  • Support the standardization of KPIs, performance drivers, and reporting methodologies across business areas and regions.
  • Build financial models, review business cases, and perform scenario analyses to support commercial and operational decisions.
  • Support the development and maintenance of forecasting, planning, and performance management models.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, including reporting automation, process improvements, and the adoption of new analytical tools.
  • Work with Centres of Excellence and data teams to incorporate site, channel, and commercial performance drivers into planning models and dashboards.
  • Support ad hoc financial analyses, projects, and management requests.

STRATEGIC ALIGNMENT

Deliver accurate financial insights, reporting, and analysis that support commercial decisions, financial control, and long-term value creation across fuel and related business activities.

What You’ll Need

Here is what we are looking for:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related discipline.
  • A professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent), or active pursuit of one, is an asset.

Experience:

  • 2–3 years of experience in FP&A, commercial finance, financial analysis, accounting, or a related finance role.
  • Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, and performance reporting processes.
  • Experience working with large datasets and translating analysis into business insights.
  • Experience in fuel retail, convenience retail, B2B, EV, logistics, or supply chain environments is an asset but is not required.

Knowledge and skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Excel, including financial modelling and data analysis.
  • Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and management reporting.
  • Ability to interpret complex data and clearly communicate findings to both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Leadership and personal attributes

  • Curious and commercially minded, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Organized, structured, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and adapting to changing business needs.
  • Collaborative team player who builds strong relationships across functions.
  • Committed to continuous improvement, simplifying processes, and enhancing reporting.
  • Eager to learn and develop finance and business partnering capabilities.

Language skills:

  • Advanced proficiency in both French and English, spoken and written, is required. The person in this role will regularly work and communicate in English while performing the responsibilities described above, including collaborating with global teams.

WHY YOU SHOULD WORK HERE

At Couche-Tard/Circle K, our team members are at the heart of our business. When you join us, you become part of a community where your talents are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions make a difference. Here are some of the benefits of working with us:

  • Pension Plan: Plan for your future with our pension plan.
  • Share Purchase Plan: Share in our success through our employee share purchase plan.
  • Paid Time Off: Enjoy paid time off, including vacation, sick days, and personal days, to support work-life balance.

Additional perks:

  • Employee Discounts: Enjoy exclusive discounts on our products and services.
  • Training and Development: Build your skills through ongoing learning opportunities, including workshops, seminars, and online courses.
  • Recognition and Rewards: We celebrate our team’s achievements and milestones through recognition programs, rewards, and incentives.
  • Mentorship Program: Learn from experienced professionals who can offer guidance and support as you develop your career.
  • Scholarship Program: Our scholarship program supports the education of employees and their children.

Join us at Entrust 

At Entrust, we’re shaping the future of identity centric security solutions. From our comprehensive portfolio of solutions to our flexible, global workplace, we empower careers, foster collaboration, and build solutions that help keep the world moving safely.

Get to Know Us 

Headquartered in Minnesota, Entrust is an industry leader in identity-centric security solutions, serving over 150 countries with cutting-edge, scalable technologies. But our secret weapon? Our people. It’s the curiosity, dedication, and innovation that drive our success and help us anticipate the future. 

The Senior Financial Analyst position is a member of the Global Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) team that is responsible for supporting the Traditional Services Team with data, metrics, and insights they need to make strategic, operational, and tactical decisions. You will work closely with the finance team as well as functional VP’s, department directors and team members to analyze and support business activities. You will be responsible for tracking performance against projections, working with department managers to develop budgets, investigating data inconsistencies, and assisting in the preparation, analysis and presentation of the monthly financial and operational reports to the Traditional Services management team. Success will be dependent upon a wide range of skills including excellent communication skills, strong task organization skills, and a get-it-done attitude!

Responsibilities

  • Lead global annual budgeting and monthly forecasting processes
  • Develop analytics around key operating metrics, monthly and quarterly management and segment reporting, organic and acquisition revenue growth measurements and geographic reporting.
  • Support operating groups and Senior Management with in-depth analysis and reporting in an effort to drive growth.
  • Investigate, analyze and explain operational and financial variances to budget, forecast and prior year.
  • Proactively spot and communicate trends and risks within financials.
  • Analyze complex financial information and reports to provide accurate and timely financial recommendations to management for decision making purposes.
  • Develop pro-forma and “what if” scenarios to project financial impact of contemplated changes.
  • Partner with management on various projects, related data requests and financial reports to support strategic initiatives, ad hoc projects and assignments as they develop.
  • Identify and lead process improvement activities and cross functional projects.
  • Work with Business Objects tool and assist in implementing dashboard reporting of key performance indicators.

Basic Qualifications

We seek an individual with a successful track record who must be comfortable with a fast paced and changing environment. The ideal candidate will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field from an accredited university
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in accounting/financial analysis
  • Experience in financial modeling, business analysis, FP&A, business integration, analytics in a corporate (HQ) environment
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications (Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills required)
  • Hands-on experience with financial systems/applications such as Oracle, SAP Business Objects and Planful, Tableau, etc.
  • Must be able to lawfully work within the US and have unrestricted work authorization for the US

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA, CMA, FPAC
  • Experience with Oracle EBS and SAP Business Intelligence
  • Knowledge of the security/software/SaaS industry
  • Strong analytical, quantitative and problem solving skills: able to clearly link financial results to operational performance drivers, generate alternatives and drive positive change.
  • Attention to detail, with high standards of accuracy and review, but must have ability to see the big picture
  • Clear thinking/problem solving: successfully led projects/process improvements within operations/finance functions; able to quickly grasp new ideas
  • Demonstrated influencing skills
  • Both results-oriented and collaborative, able to work as part of a team and independently while managing demands from multiple individuals
  • Excellent organizational and follow up skills
  • Ability to think creatively, highly-driven and self-motivated
  • Enthusiastic team player, productive working independently or as part of a group; ability to interface effectively with all levels of the organization
  • Strong change agent with particular focus on process improvement
  • Experience working in a global, diverse and multicultural environment

At Entrust, we don’t just offer jobs – we offer career journeys. Here is what you can expect when you join our team: 

  • Career Growth: Whether you’re a budding developer or a seasoned expert, we’re invested in your professional journey. With learning-forward initiatives and exciting challenges, your growth is our priority. 
  • Flexibility: Life is all about balance. Whether you’re remote, hybrid, or on-site, we offer flexible options that fit your lifestyle. 
  • Collaboration: Here, your voice matters. Our teams thrive on sharing ideas, brainstorming solutions, and working together to build a better tomorrow. 

We believe in securing identities—but it doesn’t stop there. At Entrust, we’re passionate about valuing all identities. Our culture is built on diversity, inclusion, and respect. From unconscious bias training for our leaders to global affinity groups that connect colleagues across the globe, we’re creating a community where everyone is encouraged to be themselves. 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

If you’re excited by the prospect of innovating, growing your career, and collaborating in a dynamic environment, Entrust is the place for you. Join us in making a difference. Let’s build a more secure world—together. 

  

Apply today! 

For more information, visit www.entrust.com.  Follow us on, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube

Compensation Range

The anticipated starting base pay for this position is: $100,423-$147,287 per year (in the primary posting location). Actual compensation will be determined based on geographic location, education, skills and experience. This position is also eligible for the company’s discretionary annual incentive plan. In addition to your pay, Entrust offers eligible colleagues and their dependents comprehensive health and well-being programs which include medical, vision, dental, a generous 401(k) matching contribution, life and disability insurance, mental health coaching, virtual fitness programs, paid personal time off plus 12 paid holidays, parental leave and education reimbursement. Financial Analyst, Finance & Strategy


About FGI


FGI is a global leader in the commercial finance industry, equipping small and medium-sized enterprises with the tools they need to grow their businesses. FGI’s three principal business units, FGI Finance, FGI Risk, and FGI Tech provide clients with flexible and customized lending along with risk mitigation and credit insurance solutions designed to support international and domestic growth. Headquartered in New York City, FGI maintains a presence on 6 continents with clients in over 60 countries around the world.


About the Role


FGI is seeking an analytical, detail-oriented Financial Analyst to support management reporting, financial planning, and strategic initiatives. Reporting to the Director, Finance & Strategy, the analyst will contribute to financial modeling, budgeting and forecasting, business and strategic analysis across the company’s business units. The analyst will work closely with the Director on a range of activities including financial modeling, budgeting and forecasting support, management reporting, business analysis, and strategic initiatives.


This role requires strong technical skills in financial analysis and modeling, comfort working with large datasets and spreadsheets, and the ability to translate complex financial data into clear insights. The analyst will work across multiple business units and functions, requiring strong communication and collaboration skills. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is ready to take ownership of defined workstreams and seeking to develop expertise in financial planning and analysis within a growing organization.


Key Responsibilities


Management Reporting & Analytics

  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual management reporting, including quarterly Board materials, by consolidating financial and operational data and analyzing trends and variances.
  • Support and Maintain reporting dashboards and scorecards, and prepare executive summaries and presentation materials.


Budgeting, Forecasting & Modeling

  • Support the annual budget and monthly, quarterly, and annual forecast cycles, including gathering business unit inputs, documenting assumptions, and calculating and explaining variances to budget and forecast.
  • Build and maintain financial models for budgeting, forecasting, and planning, including scenario, sensitivity, and what-if analyses.


Business Unit & Strategic Analysis

  • Partner with business unit leaders to prepare profitability and performance analyses, deep-dive studies, and business cases for strategic initiatives, including ROI and breakeven analyses.
  • Support FGI’s strategic plan and cross-functional projects by tracking workstreams, timelines, and documentation.


M&A & Transaction Support

  • Support M&A evaluation, valuation, and due diligence through financial models and summaries, and help track post-transaction integration.


Systems & Tools

  • Support the development and maintenance of financial planning systems, reporting tools, and data visualization platforms.


Qualifications


Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 3-6 years of experience in financial analysis, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), corporate finance, accounting, management consulting, or a related field.
  • Strong financial modeling skills and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (formulas, pivot tables, data analysis) and PowerPoint, including building and troubleshooting complex models.
  • Demonstrated experience with financial data, variance and trend analysis, and large datasets, while maintaining data integrity.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills; able to present findings to both financial and non-financial audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines in a fast-paced environment, with professional judgment and discretion in handling confidential information.


Preferred

  • Experience in financial services, private credit, insurance, fintech, or with private equity–backed companies.
  • Experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker), SQL, or financial planning, ERP, or accounting systems.
  • Experience with M&A financial modeling or evaluation of strategic opportunities.


Our Values


We hire for values first. These are not aspirational - they describe how we operate.

  • Own It. We take full accountability for outcomes - not just effort.
  • Create the Path.We are resourceful, creative, and resilient - bringing innovative thinking to solve problems for our clients and partners.
  • Win as a Team.Success only happens in teams - we are one and achieve more together.

De plus, vous présenterez régulièrement de l’information financière, ferez des prévisions et de la planification, et participerez aux projets de l’ensemble de l’équipe des partenaires des Finances.

Renseignements sur l’équipe

Relevant du directeur principal ou de la directrice principale des Finances, ce poste englobe tous les aspects de la planification et de l’analyse financières au sein de l’un de nos portefeuilles les plus rentables. Vous travaillerez aux côtés des membres de la direction du Cabinet afin de favoriser l’excellence opérationnelle et d’atteindre un rendement financier exceptionnel en formulant des recommandations éclairées et réalisables concernant, sans s’y limiter, la rentabilité des clients, l’optimisation des ressources et les investissements à rendement maximal.

Assez parlé de nous, parlons de vous

Vous Avez Le Profil Suivant

  • Baccalauréat en comptabilité, en finance, en affaires ou en économie;
  • Avoir obtenu ou être en voie d’obtenir un titre professionnel pertinent (CPA, CA, de CPA, CMA);
  • De quatre à six ans d’expérience progressive dans un rôle financier dans un environnement dynamique;
  • Solide connaissance des principes fondamentaux des affaires, sens des affaires;
  • Maîtrise du logiciel Excel et capacité à gérer efficacement de grands ensembles de données, et à présenter et résumer de façon concise les données pour notre direction;
  • Aptitude à la réflexion stratégique en vue de mener des initiatives d’affaires de bout en bout et de fournir des perspectives.

Les compétences suivantes sont considérées comme des atouts :

  • Maîtrise du français ou de l’espagnol (l’anglais est requis pour ce poste en raison des interactions avec une clientèle nationale et mondiale).

Rémunération totale

L’échelle salariale pour ce poste est de 58,000 $ à 96,000 $. Certaines personnes peuvent être admissibles à notre programme de prime. Sur le plan salarial, Deloitte se concentre sur l’équité et la compétitivité. Nous établissons régulièrement des comparaisons aux données de référence du marché établies pour divers postes, secteurs, cibles et niveaux. Notre approche est fondée sur l’importance de reconnaître les forces et les contributions uniques de chaque personne et de récompenser celle-ci pour la valeur qu’elle apporte.

La rémunération totale offerte par Deloitte s’étend bien au-delà des programmes traditionnels de rémunération et d’avantages sociaux et est conçue pour reconnaître les contributions des employés, favoriser le mieux-être personnel et soutenir la croissance du Cabinet. En plus de nos jours de congé payés réguliers, quelques exemples incluent : 4 000 $ par an pour les avantages de soutien en santé mentale, un compte de dépenses flexibles de 1 300 $, des fermetures à l'échelle de l'entreprise connues sous le nom de "Jours Deloitte", des journées dédiées à l'apprentissage (connues sous le nom de Jours de Développement et d'Innovation), des arrangements de travail flexibles et une structure de travail hybride.

Notre promesse à nos gens : Deloitte est là où vous pouvez propulsez vos ambitions.

Vous, et plus encore.

Évoluez au sein d’une équipe passionnée et déterminée à apprendre et à développer de nouvelles compétences. Bâtissez votre réseau et faites le plein d’expériences qui vous permettront de vous épanouir et vous mèneront vers la prochaine étape de votre carrière.

Vos chemins nous portent plus loin.

La diversité de vos compétences, perspectives et expériences nous rend meilleurs. Nous voulons que vous vous sentiez comme chez vous, qui que vous soyez et d’où que vous veniez. Nous vous oﬀrons des options de travail ﬂexibles et personnalisées pour répondre à vos besoins, peu importe votre mode de vie.

Devenez le leader que vous désirez être.

Certains dirigent des équipes, d’autres sont au cœur d’un changement de culture, d’autres encore bâtissent une expertise de pointe. Nous soutiendrons votre croissance en tant que leader par l’entremise d’expériences, d’occasions et de défis variés et enrichissants.

Ayez autant de carrières que vous le souhaitez.

Nous sommes en mesure de vous offrir de nouveaux rôles et de nouvelles responsabilités, et de vous aider à vous y préparer. Notre objectif est de conjuguer vos aspirations à vos compétences et à l’excellence de votre savoir-faire. Nous sommes l’endroit pour développer un réseau durable d’amis, de pairs et de mentors.

La balle est dans votre camp

Chez Deloitte, nous avons à cœur de faire des affaires de manière inclusive – cela commence par une diversité parmi les collègues de toutes les compétences! Deloitte encourage tous les candidats qualifiés qui représentent la diversité des collectivités partout au Canada à soumettre leur candidature. Cela comprend, sans s’y limiter, les personnes handicapées, les candidats des communautés autochtones et les candidats de la communauté noire qui souhaitent incarner nos valeurs, participer à la création d’une culture de diversité, d’équité et d’inclusion, et contribuer à notre engagement envers notre Plan d’action pour l’accessibilité notre Plan d’action pour la réconciliation et l’initiative BlackNorth

Nos conseillers en recrutement et nos équipes responsables de l’embauche procéderont à un examen humain des candidatures combiné à des technologies d’IA pour déterminer les compétences et les qualités qui comptent le plus pour notre entreprise, tout en protégeant votre vie privée et en utilisant l’IA de manière responsable.

Job Description

Location: London, Hybrid

In this position, you’ll be based in the London office for a minimum of three days a week, with the flexibility to work from home for some of your working week. Find out more about our flexible work culture at computershare.com/flex .

We give you a world of potential

Computershare is currently looking to recruit a Senior Business Analyst reporting to our Technical Delivery Lead. In this role, you will play a key part in delivering customer-facing, enterprise-wide initiatives within our global Investor Engagement team, including product integration, platform consolidation, and the continued evolution of our ingage IR platform.

As an experienced Business Analyst, you will bring deep expertise in eliciting, analysing, documenting, and validating business requirements, helping us build and enhance a new and exciting business line while ensuring alignment between stakeholder needs, product objectives, and technology delivery.

This position sits within a cross-functional Agile delivery team focused on creating customer-oriented solutions. Working closely with business leaders, clients, product managers, designers, and engineers, you will act as a communicator, facilitator, and problem solver, driving collaboration, process improvement, and the successful delivery of business value.

Role

Why would you choose this role when there are other Senior Business Analyst roles in the market? Well, there are a few things that make this role stand out:

  • A unique opportunity to help integrate multiple entities, products, and data streams to support the growth of a new and strategically important business line.
  • We offer continuous learning and education opportunities and put emphasis on continued improvement and growth.

Like what you have read so far? Then please read on to discover what the role entails.

A role you will love

You will work closely with Product Managers, key stakeholders, Customer Experience Designers, and Engineering teams to shape solutions that improve user experiences and deliver measurable business outcomes. Acting as the bridge between business and technology teams, you will facilitate collaboration, support solution design, testing, and implementation activities, and provide leadership through clear communication and stakeholder engagement. This is an exciting opportunity for a driven individual to join a dynamic team and make a meaningful impact in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

Other Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with other Business Analysts, Architects, and UI/UX experts to identify requirements and propose solutions.
  • Evaluate and document existing processes and suggest potential improvements.
  • Prepare high-level requirements for further refinement, including high quality, clear user stories.
  • Accurately capture information in a format that stakeholders can understand, review, and approve.
  • Run effective stakeholder workshops – always looking to keep things interactive and fun!
  • Liaise with off-site stakeholders using remote communication tools such as teleconferencing and email.
  • Work closely with our Engineers to meet our business and customer requirements while building it right.

What will you bring to the role?

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will use your analysis skills to thoroughly examine any business problem and provide innovative solutions that can help the organization achieve its objectives.

Other Key Skills Required For The Role Include

  • A commitment to learning and development in the field of business analysis, solution development and product design.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
  • Experience working in a team-oriented and collaborative environment.
  • Experience with software development methodologies, life cycles and Senior processes.
  • Strong problem solving, analytical thinking and teamwork skills.
  • Continuous improvement and learning mindset.

Desired Skills

  • Understanding of Agile delivery (Scrum and/or Kanban) is preferable.
  • Experience in IT or the Finance industry desirable but not essential.
  • Tertiary qualifications in Computing, Business, Information Systems, or equivalent qualifications (such as IIBA) are desirable but not essential

Rewards designed for you

Flexible work to help you find the best balance between work and lifestyle

Health and wellbeing rewards that can be tailored to support you and your family

Invest in our business by setting aside salary to purchase shares in our company, and you’ll receive a company contribution as well.

Extra rewards ranging from recognition awards and team get togethers to helping you invest in your future

And more. Ours is a welcoming and close-knit community, with experienced colleagues ready to help you grow. Our careers hub will help you find out more about our rewards and life at Computershare, visit computershare.com/careershub

Does this sound like the role for you? Then feel free to apply or reach out for a chat!

About Us

 A company to be proud of

We're a global leader in financial administration with over 11,000 employees across more than 22 different countries. At Computershare, it’s more than just a job, our open and inclusive culture means that we will help you to grow, to move forward and make the most of our world of opportunities.

Fairness and culture

We want to provide you with the opportunity to succeed on your own merits, starting from the application process and continuing throughout your career with us. Our goal is to create an environment where everyone feels valued, to remove barriers and obstacles and ensure equal opportunities for all. For support with accommodations or adjustments during our recruitment process please visit computershare.com/access for further information.

Our Technology Services team is a place where new ideas and approaches are welcomed, and every individual is equipped and empowered to create change. We're a rapidly evolving and diverse global business and there is always something to learn, opportunities to explore and a broad range of career paths to progress along.

Job Summary

  • Define scope and manage business requirements for assigned projects from high level user journeys to detailed functional requirements for system development/enhancement or process improvement throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, prepare and conduct/facilitate sessions for business requirements gathering and ensure requirements specifications/project deliverables are produced with quality on timely basis.
  • Prepare and present/propose to stakeholders as-is and to-be models relevant to project scope, including modeling process flow/system flow, defining functional requirements & data specifications and system integrations logics, as part of the requirements specifications documentation/user story preparation process with consideration to optimize user journey and enhance user experience where feasible.
  • Identify functional improvement & technical development areas and ideate & define to-be model / solution design with technical teams.
  • Develop and maintain requirement traceability matrix and prioritize requirements with stakeholders with alignment to project objectives and timeline.
  • Collaborate with project manager and technology team to define project scope, develop high-level project plan and perform risk assessment.
  • Perform quality review checks on project deliverables from project teams where required.
  • Design test scope & develop test plans, manage/perform and support testing, and conduct training/change management activities.
  • Manage post implementation activities including incident resolution/problem solving with root cause analysis, stakeholder engagement activities, lessons learnt for improvement, etc.
  • Adapt and apply appropriate delivery methodologies such as SCRUM or Waterfall, where assessed to be best suited for the specific project.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business IT, Business Information Systems, IT Management, Computing, Business Administration or related fields.
  • Minimum 8-10 or more years’ experience in a Business Analyst / System Analyst / Product Owner role in system development/delivery or process improvement projects.
  • Experience in General and/or Life insurance with in-depth understanding of insurance products and processes.
  • Experience in Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
  • Good understanding of project management, requirements analysis & solution design, system testing, implementation/change management, stakeholder management best practices, techniques and approaches.
  • Proficiency with Ms Visio or other process modeling tools, JIRA, Confluence and other tools for project/system delivery.

Preferred

  • Strong process modeling, analytical/numeracy, problem-solving and system design skills.
  • Experience in digital transformation or system/platform modernization projects in General and/or Life insurance.

You are the heart & soul of Zurich!

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We highly value the experience and know-how of our employees and offer a wide range of opportunities across business areas to encourage you to apply for new opportunities within Zurich when you are ready for your next career step.

Let’s continue to grow together!

The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals.

Support of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close activities, including consolidation, analysis, and reporting is required.

The candidate must have demonstrated strong processional judgement as the role is accountable for maintaining strong compliance discipline. Financial priorities include market share and gross profit improvement, lowering the cost to serve, and improved utilization of investments in inventory and instruments.

The Senior Financial Analyst will serve as a key member of the Global Distribution & Customer Logistics (GDCL) Finance leadership team, and the position offers high visibility across senior leadership teams.

This position can be based in any DePuy Synthes office in the US and requires approximately 10% travel.

Financial Analyst


Minimum 2+ Years’ experience in budgeting, forecasting & financial modeling


Venteon is currently seeking a Financial Analyst to fill an opening with an Industry Leader and Employer of Choice with headquarters in the Metro Detroit area. The ideal candidate will be a critical contributor to the company’s overall financial success.


The position supports the company’s business objectives and leadership decision making by preparing financial analysis and financial models and providing timely, accurate, transparent and relevant financial information to key internal and external stakeholders.


Requirements of the Senior Financial Analyst

  • Bachelor's degree with major in relevant business field (Accounting, Finance, Economics)
  • Minimum of two (2)+ years of related analytical experience preferably in budget development, financial modeling and project analysis.
  • Ability to analyze and interpret complex financial models/information.
  • Advanced problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing with superiors and individuals inside and outside the company.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word.
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision in a team environment.
  • Ability to multi-task and manage competing deadlines.

Benefits of the Senior Financial Analyst

  • Salary
  • Bonus Eligible Position
  • Full time position
  • Hybrid work arrangement
  • Paid time off
  • Medical / Dental / Vision
  • 401k
  • Life Insurance
  • Company perks

Responsibilities of the Senior Financial Analyst

  • Supports budgeting, forecasting and financial planning processes for operating subsidiaries and consolidated holding companies.
  • Responsible for the collection, organization, and analysis of quantitative data used to develop financial projections.
  • Supports the maintenance and ongoing assessment of financial models including supporting model modifications and upgrades to improve accuracy of financial projections.
  • Builds strong partnerships with leadership across the organization to make informed business decisions and provide end-to-end Finance support, including budgeting and forecasting, variance analysis, driving strategic initiatives, among other things.
  • Supports the development of complex financial scenarios, sensitivities and analyses related to special projects and ad hoc requests.
  • Assists in keeping a pulse on financial health and outlook of the business by measuring and monitoring actual performance against budgets, forecasts, and internal goals.
  • Provide timely and meaningful analytical insights that drive financial results and support key decision making and corporate objectives.
  • Supports the development of various financial reports and presentations for key internal and external stakeholders, including Senior Leadership Team and Board of Directors.
  • Collaborates with other members of the Finance & Treasury teams to implement best practices and develop new frameworks for analyzing the business.
  • Participate in cross-functional initiatives to improve processes, systems, and automation
  • Assists in the presentations and communicates financial forecasts and/or other financial results/analysis to peers and leadership.
  • Assists and supports various capital investment forecasts processes, treasury activities associated with cash operations and debt capital markets, and actual and projected revenue requirements calculations.


If you are a high performer and would like to work for an equally high performing company and you think the above opportunity is appropriate for you, we invite you to apply to this job and email your resume to kroehrig@venteon.com


We treat all resumes with strict confidentiality. We will always contact you first before submitting your resume to our client(s) for review. If you do not receive correspondence, you are not a fit for this position.


At Venteon, our talent acquisition team is proud to provide our clients with the most qualified Accounting & Finance, Engineering, and IT talent in the industry today.
