job_description_raw_html:
Company Description

At QIMA, we are on a mission to help our clients make products consumers can trust. We have developed compliance solutions for testing, inspection and certification (TIC) that enable supply chain agility, sustainability and product innovation. Our services are used by 30,000 businesses globally in the consumer products, agri-food and life sciences industries. Backed by 6,000+ dedicated Qimates worldwide, we bring local expertise and tailored support to every client. Our passion for service has made QIMA an industry leader for customer satisfaction, as highlighted by our exceptional Net Promoter Score (NPS).

Through our Life Sciences activities, we develop and deliver scientific testing and research services for our clients.

We are now launching a new programme to develop virtual pharmacology models. These models will use the data generated through years of laboratory work to help assess the efficacy of molecules and support future screening activities.

Job Description

We are looking for a Lead Data Scientist – Virtual Models to take ownership of this programme from the start.

This is a hands-on role for an experienced data scientist who wants to build something new. You will assess existing datasets across QIMA’s Business Units, identify the most promising opportunities, develop proof-of-concept models and prepare them for use by internal teams and, ultimately, by clients.

Initial Applications May Include Models Related To

  • skin;
  • hair follicles;
  • longevity;
  • prostate cancer;
  • immunology.

You will work closely with Managing Directors, laboratory scientists and QIMA’s IT and AI experts. Scientific validation will be carried out in collaboration with independent laboratory teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and assess proposals from QIMA’s Business Units.
  • Examine the underlying data in detail, including its quality, structure, consistency, depth and breadth.
  • Recommend one or two models with the strongest potential for development, subject to approval by the CEO of QIMA Life Sciences.
  • Build and manage the required data pipelines.
  • Clean, structure, integrate and analyse complex biological datasets.
  • Develop machine learning models and proof of concepts.
  • Identify data gaps and recommend additional experiments where needed. Work with laboratory scientists to help define these experiments, including the required data, measurements and quality criteria.
  • Establish clear validation criteria and prepare models for independent scientific validation.
  • Improve the models through repeated testing and iteration.
  • Ensure that code, data and models are reproducible, traceable and properly documented.
  • Present results clearly to scientific, technical, commercial and non-specialist audiences.
  • Support the preparation of a model for future commercialisation, either as a SaaS product or as a service supporting, replacing or complementing wet-lab assays.
  • Contribute to the documentation and protection of intellectual property related to the models, pipelines and methods.

This role will initially be an individual contributor position. As the programme grows, you may help build and lead a team of additional data scientists.

First objectives

Within the first six months, you will be expected to:

  • assess the main model proposals and their underlying datasets;
  • recommend the one or two strongest projects;
  • establish a proof of concept for one or two models.

Within 12 to 15 months, the objective will be to prepare at least one model for potential commercialisation. This should include sufficient scientific validation, an interface usable internally, and complete documentation or detailed operator training.

Qualifications

You have:

  • a PhD in data science, biostatistics, bioinformatics, machine learning or a related field;
  • 8–10 years of experience in data science, biostatistics and machine learning;
  • a proven track record of delivering complex machine learning projects using complex biological datasets;
  • strong experience building data pipelines, assessing data quality, identifying limitations and defining what additional data is needed;
  • experience working with scientists and translating scientific questions into data and modelling approaches;
  • excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to non-specialists;
  • ideally, experience presenting work to clients, partners or other external stakeholders;
  • a practical, entrepreneurial and hands-on approach;
  • the ability to work independently and take ownership of an ambiguous, new project.

Experience in a specific therapeutic area is not essential. The most important requirements are strong technical expertise, experience with biological data and the ability to turn complex datasets into useful, validated models.

Strong Python or R skills, including production-quality, version-controlled code. Experience with cloud data platforms (we use Snowflake) and MLOps practices.

Why join QIMA?

This is an opportunity to build a new capability from the ground up and shape how QIMA uses its biological data. You will have direct access to senior leadership, laboratory experts and technical teams, with the autonomy to define the approach and deliver tangible results.

The role will be based in Europe and will require travel, depending on project needs, to QIMA laboratories in France, Northern Ireland and Germany.

Additional Information

Does this describe you? Then we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Apply now with your CV in English and we can write the next chapter of the QIMA story together!

About AJIC

American Jereh International Corporation (AJIC) supports Jereh's expanding energy and industrial business across oil and natural gas, data center and power, and new energy markets. The organization operates across equipment, engineering, technology, and integrated energy applications serving complex industrial and energy requirements.


About the Role

The strongest financial analysis does more than explain what happened. It helps the business understand what is changing, what is driving performance, and what decisions should come next.

American Jereh International Corporation (AJIC) is seeking a Senior Financial Planning & Analysis Analyst to provide forward-looking financial analysis, forecasting, management reporting, and business performance insights across a growing energy and industrial organization.

This position will partner with Finance and business leadership to translate financial and operational data into actionable analysis that supports planning, resource allocation, performance management, and executive decision-making.

The Senior FP&A Analyst will have direct responsibility for financial models, forecasts, variance analysis, management reporting, KPI development, scenario analysis, and other financial tools used to evaluate business performance and future outcomes.

The position will also work with China-based Finance, leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders. Professional fluency in both Mandarin Chinese and English is required to support ongoing financial communication, planning, reporting, and coordination across the organization.

This role is well suited for an experienced finance professional who is comfortable moving beyond historical reporting to understand business drivers, challenge assumptions, identify risks and opportunities, and provide leadership with clear financial insight.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain annual budgets, periodic forecasts, and long-range financial plans.
  • Prepare financial forecasts covering revenue, operating expenses, profitability, cash flow, capital expenditures, and other key business drivers.
  • Analyze actual financial performance against budget, forecast, prior periods, and established operating targets.
  • Identify, investigate, and clearly explain significant financial and operational variances.
  • Develop and maintain financial models supporting business planning, investment decisions, scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis, and management decision-making.
  • Prepare recurring monthly, quarterly, and annual management reporting packages.
  • Develop executive-level financial presentations, dashboards, schedules, and performance reporting.
  • Partner with Accounting and other Finance functions to ensure information used in planning, forecasting, and reporting is accurate and consistent.
  • Work directly with operating and functional leaders to understand business drivers and incorporate operational assumptions into financial forecasts.
  • Collaborate with China-based Finance and leadership teams on financial planning, reporting, analysis, and related business requirements.
  • Communicate financial information effectively in both Mandarin Chinese and English as required for cross-border collaboration.
  • Analyze revenue, margins, operating expenses, capital expenditures, working capital, cash flow, and other key financial performance indicators.
  • Translate financial and operational results into clear insights, risks, opportunities, and recommendations for management.
  • Lead financial analysis supporting month-end and quarter-end business performance reviews.
  • Develop and maintain cash-flow forecasts and financial outlooks.
  • Perform scenario, sensitivity, trend, and what-if analyses to evaluate potential business outcomes.
  • Develop, monitor, and analyze financial and operational KPIs.
  • Identify emerging risks and opportunities that may affect current forecasts, profitability, cash flow, or business performance.
  • Improve forecasting models, financial reporting processes, planning templates, and analytical tools.
  • Support automation of financial reporting and increased utilization of business intelligence and data visualization tools.
  • Prepare ad hoc financial analysis for Finance, business, and executive leadership.
  • Maintain financial models and reporting tools with a high degree of accuracy, consistency, and data integrity.
  • Support long-range strategic planning and other Finance initiatives as business requirements evolve.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • Five or more years of progressively responsible experience in financial planning and analysis, corporate finance, business finance, financial analysis, or a closely related discipline.
  • Professional fluency in Mandarin Chinese and English is required.
  • Ability to communicate financial information, business results, and analytical findings effectively with both U.S.-based and China-based stakeholders.
  • Direct hands-on experience with budgeting and forecasting.
  • Experience performing financial variance analysis and explaining the underlying business drivers behind financial results.
  • Experience developing, maintaining, and analyzing financial models.
  • Strong understanding of income statements, balance sheets, cash-flow statements, and the relationships between the three financial statements.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including the ability to build and analyze complex financial models.
  • Experience working with large financial datasets and converting financial and operational information into meaningful business analysis.
  • Experience preparing management-level financial reporting and presentations.
  • Ability to communicate financial findings clearly to both Finance and non-Finance stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical capability with a high degree of financial accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, reporting deadlines, forecasting cycles, and ad hoc analytical requests.
  • Ability to work effectively across Finance, Accounting, Operations, Sales, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other business functions.
  • Ability to work full-time onsite in the Greater Houston area.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in energy, oil and gas, power generation, manufacturing, industrial equipment, engineering, construction, or another capital-intensive industry.
  • Experience supporting business units with significant revenue, operating expense, inventory, capital expenditure, project-based, or equipment-related financial activity.
  • Experience with Power BI or another business intelligence and data visualization platform.
  • Experience with ERP systems and enterprise financial reporting platforms.
  • Experience developing dashboards, automated reports, or standardized financial planning tools.
  • Experience presenting financial analysis and recommendations to senior or executive leadership.
  • Experience supporting long-range strategic planning, investment analysis, or business-case development.
  • Experience working within a multinational, multi-entity, or rapidly growing organization.
  • CPA, CMA, CFA, MBA, or another relevant advanced degree or professional certification.


What This Role Will Influence

The Senior FP&A Analyst will have visibility across financial and operational performance and will contribute directly to forecasting, planning, performance management, and business decisions across AJIC.

The role will also serve as an important financial connection between U.S.-based operations and China-based stakeholders, requiring the ability to move comfortably between detailed financial analysis, operational business discussions, and bilingual cross-border communication.

El equipo de Global Incentives Service (GIS) funciona como un Centro de Excelencia con una misión clara: revolucionar la forma en que interactuamos con nuestros millones de usuarios, partners y riders a través de incentivos inteligentes, personalizados y eficientes. Diseñamos, desarrollamos y escalamos estas soluciones de Data para todas las marcas del grupo Delivery Hero a nivel mundial. Formarás parte de un equipo que no solo impacta en la región, sino que define la estrategia de incentivos en más de 70 países.

Como Data Scientist en GIS , tu misión es desarrollar productos de datos y modelos de Machine Learning (ML) para optimizar la toma de decisiones respecto a la asignacion de incentivos. Serás el/la responsable de la evolución y el rendimiento de los sistemas de ML e Inteligencia Artificial (IA), asegurando decisiones basadas en datos robustos.   • Desarrollar, implementar y mantener modelos de Machine Learning (ML) y soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial (IA) end-to-end, aplicando buenas prácticas.

  • Garantizar el alto rendimiento, escalabilidad y la robustez de los productos de datos implementados en distintos mercados.
  • Colaborar con equipos multifuncionales (Producto, Ingeniería, UX y Analistas) para definir KPIs, realizar A/B testing, y asegurar la alineación técnica con el resto de los Data Scientists.
  • Monitorear el rendimiento de los modelos en producción, resolviendo incidencias y promoviendo el conocimiento técnico dentro del equipo.

Requisitos

  • Dominio experto de Python (incluyendo librerías clave como pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) y manejo avanzado de SQL.
  • Sólidos fundamentos en estadística, probabilidad y algoritmos de ML .

Are you Robert Walters?

Function

We are looking for a proactive Business Analyst to work closely with the Product Owner, development teams, and business stakeholders to deliver enhancements and new capabilities for our Digital Integration Platform as well as analysis across the wider business functions.

This role is hands-on and outcome-driven — the BA will own the analysis end-to-end, from discovery through delivery, ensuring that requirements are clear, technically feasible, and aligned with product goals.

You’ll be expected to connect the dots between business needs, user experience, and technical delivery — translating complex requirements into actionable user stories and process flows that help the team deliver value efficiently and accurately.

This is a highly collaborative role that requires both strategic thinking and execution excellence — working with senior stakeholders across countries, while engaging daily with engineers, testers, and product peers to ensure smooth delivery. You will map processes, define data requirements, and translate complex challenges into practical solutions that drive business value.

Core Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with the Product Owner and business stakeholders to understand the product vision, goals, and priorities, translating them into well-defined user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Own the business analysis process end-to-end – from discovery and stakeholder workshops through to delivery support and testing.
  • Facilitate workshops, interviews, and stakeholder sessions to gather and validate requirements.
  • Collaborate with developers and QA during sprints to clarify requirements, resolve ambiguities, and ensure accurate delivery.
  • Create and maintain clear, visual artefacts — process maps, data flows, wireframes, and documentation — that communicate both the big picture and technical details.
  • Perform impact assessments on proposed changes across processes, systems, and people.
  • Elicit and document requirements using techniques such as interviews, workshops, document analysis, and process reviews.
  • Analyse current (“As-Is”) and target (“To-Be”) business processes to identify opportunities for improvement and automation.
  • Translate business requirements into functional and non-functional specifications suitable for development.
  • Support backlog refinement, ensuring stories are prioritised, estimated, and ready for sprint planning.
  • Partner with QA and Product to validate that delivered functionality meets requirements and user expectations.
  • Build trusted relationships with cross-functional stakeholders across multiple geographies.
  • Present analysis, recommendations, and solution options to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and blockers, working with the Scrum team to resolve them.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement within the team by bringing best practices in business analysis, process improvement, and agile delivery

Who You Are

  • A hands-on Business Analyst with a strong understanding of both business and technical domains.
  • Experienced in working within Agile/Scrum environments, collaborating daily with product and development teams.
  • Skilled in writing clear, testable user stories and maintaining an organised backlog.
  • Strong communicator and facilitator who can simplify complexity, challenge assumptions, and build stakeholder confidence — from developers to C-level executives.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, able to zoom out to the big picture while managing detailed requirements.
  • Analytical and structured thinker with a focus on outcomes, not just outputs.
  • Confident in process mapping, workflow design and data mapping and solid knowledge in using Atlassian products (Jira and Confluence) and Lucidchart
  • Competency with MS Office 365 suit of application (Word, PowerPoint, Excel etc)
  • Technically literate — able to discuss APIs, data flows, and integrations with developers and understand system behaviours.
  • Experienced in working on global or multi-country product initiatives.
  • Organised, proactive, and able to own deliverables without heavy oversight.

Preferred Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst in digital product or technology-led environments.
  • Proven experience working in Agile product teams (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experience delivering business process or system transformations across multiple markets.
  • Familiarity with API-based integrations, data mapping, and system workflows.
  • Strong documentation and visualisation skills.
  • Business analysis or process improvement certifications (e.g., CBAP, BCS, Lean Six Sigma) are a plus.

Job Description

Job Summary**

We are seeking a highly motivated Technical Business Analyst to bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions, driving the successful delivery of software projects. This role involves analyzing business requirements, translating them into technical specifications, and supporting development and testing efforts.

Job Responsibilities**

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document detailed business requirements, user stories, and use cases.
  • Translate business requirements into clear, concise, and comprehensive technical specifications, functional specifications, and design documents.
  • Conduct gap analysis, feasibility studies, and impact assessments for new features and system enhancements.
  • Work closely with development teams to ensure technical solutions align with business objectives and architectural guidelines.
  • Facilitate communication and understanding between business users, technical teams, and project management.
  • Participate in the design, development, and execution of test plans, ensuring solutions meet quality standards and user expectations.
  • Provide support during the testing phases, including UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and assist in resolving identified defects.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of business analysis processes and methodologies.
  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the company's products, services, and industry trends.

Job Qualifications**

Experience: 3+ years of experience as an IT Business Analyst (experience in railway, transportation, or industrial systems is a plus).

Communication: Fluent English, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and domain stakeholders.

Technical Expertise

  • Strong skills in functional analysis and documentation (SRS, flows, use cases)
  • Good understanding of system integration and interface concepts (no need to design ICD, but able to interpret and assess impact)
  • Experience working in multi-system and migration environments is a plus

About Us

We're a global, team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion to co-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data-driven leaders that can make a positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can bring a better tomorrow closer to today, this is the place for you.

Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives

Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.

We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.

How we look after you

We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.

We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic. Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

  • Support traceability matrices to ensure alignment between business needs, system capabilities, and test plans.

  • Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, and system automation opportunities
  • Collaborate with process owners to validate workflows and ensure alignment with strategic objectives and functional requirements



System Testing And Validation


  • Develop system and user acceptance test plans, test cases, and acceptance criteria
  • Coordinate and execute functional, regression, and integration testing efforts
  • Assist in defect triage and resolution with development teams



Programmatic Status Reporting


  • Assisting in preparing and delivering regular reports, dashboards, and presentations to project stakeholders, highlighting progress, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans
  • Track deliverables, milestones, and resource allocation using project management tools

Stakeholder Collaboration & Support:

About Laidon

Laidon, a Certified SAP Partner, operates globally with offices in the US, Japan, and Vietnam, and sales presence in Australia, Germany, England, and Singapore.

Laidon developed SimpleMDG (simplemdg.com), a powerful master data governance solution on SAP BTP that fortifies master data foundations, enhances operational excellence, ensures compliance, and drives innovation at scale. With over 100 out-of-the-box S/4HANA data objects and workflows, SimpleMDG supports powerful governance while eliminating the need for slow, complex, and expensive customizations. SimpleMDG is the master data governance and management platform for enterprises running SAP.


Role Description

As an IT Business Analyst, you will be the vital link between our customers and internal teams. You’ll work directly with clients to understand their requirements, run workshops, lead user training, and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Internally, you'll contribute to shaping product features, streamlining business processes, and helping us deliver maximum value through SimpleMDG.

 

Responsibilities

Customer Engagement:

  • Lead requirement-gathering sessions and discovery workshops with customers.
  • Analyze customer pain points and translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements.
  • Conduct user training and onboarding sessions.
  • Support UAT planning, coordination, and issue resolution.
  • Act as a key point of contact for customers during implementation phases.

Product & Delivery Support:

  • Write and maintain functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Work closely with the Product Development Team to clarify requirements and prioritize enhancements.
  • Collaborate with QA to ensure test coverage aligns with business expectations.
  • Identify areas of improvement in product usability and recommend enhancements based on customer feedback.
  • Act as advanced support agent to support Customer Support team to resolve escalated technical issues.

Internal Process Improvement: 

  • Help design and optimize internal business processes related to project delivery and support.
  • Contribute to improving delivery templates, documentation standards, and knowledge sharing.
  • Support internal initiatives for better cross-functional collaboration.


Your Skills and Experience

  • The ability to work in the evening or early morning based on the project.
  • Fluency in English is a must.
  • 3+ years of experience as an IT Business Analyst or Functional Consultant, preferably in a SaaS or enterprise software environment.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills will allow you to dissect complex customer needs and translate them into actionable roadmaps for successful product development.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential for conveying complex information clearly and concisely to diverse audiences.
  • Proven ability to influence stakeholders through clear communication, data-driven insights, and persuasive presentations.
  • Experience with user story creation is highly desirable, allowing you to translate customer needs into actionable steps for the development team.
  • Proficiency in Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence) is a plus, but your eagerness to learn and adapt is paramount.
  • Bachelor's Degree in business administration, information technology, or equivalent experience


Why You'll Love Working Here

  • 15 days of annual leaves
  • Competitive salary (+13-month salary include) 
  • Health insurance, social insurance according to the government regulations 
  • Bao Viet Healthcare Insurance 
  • Have a chance to work in an international, friendly, open environment 
  • Annual Travel opportunity

job_description: Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.Team DescriptionThe US Card Data Science organization at Capital One leverages our massive wealth of customer data to drive business strategy and deliver world-class customer experiences. Our team builds and deploys sophisticated data science and machine learning models across the entire credit card lifecycle—including marketing, acquisitions, underwriting, and fraud prevention. In this role, you will turn complex insights into real-world impact, shaping financial products that serve and protect millions of cardholders daily.Role DescriptionIn this role, you will:Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goalsThis role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location. The Ideal Candidate is:Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers. Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You're passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

The US Card Data Science organization at Capital One leverages our massive wealth of customer data to drive business strategy and deliver world-class customer experiences. Our team builds and deploys sophisticated data science and machine learning models across the entire credit card lifecycle—including marketing, acquisitions, underwriting, and fraud prevention. In this role, you will turn complex insights into real-world impact, shaping financial products that serve and protect millions of cardholders daily.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love
  • Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data
  • Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation
  • Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals
  • This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.

The Ideal Candidate is:

  • Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers.
  • Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them.
  • Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.
  • A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You're passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond.
  • Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms.
  • Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning.
  • A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:
    • A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 5 years of experience performing data analytics
    • A Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 3 years of experience performing data analytics
    • A PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field)
Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) plus 3 years of experience in data analytics, or PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics)
  • At least 1 year of experience working with AWS
  • At least 3 years’ experience in Python, Scala, or R
  • At least 3 years’ experience with machine learning
  • At least 3 years’ experience with SQL

Job Requirements

About the Role

As a Senior Data Scientist in the Data & Analytics function at IDFC FIRST Bank, you will play a pivotal role in leveraging advanced machine learning and statistical techniques to extract actionable insights from complex datasets. You will lead Gen AI initiatives, build predictive models, and collaborate with ML engineers to ensure seamless deployment and performance of data science solutions. This role is ideal for professionals with deep expertise in text analytics, NLP, and model development.

Key Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead Generative AI projects within cross-functional teams, driving innovation and business impact.
  • Develop and deploy predictive models using Python or R and libraries such as pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Keras.
  • Apply advanced machine learning algorithms and statistical modeling techniques to solve business problems.
  • Work extensively with Natural Language Processing (NLP) frameworks like NLTK, SpaCy, Gensim, and transformer models (e.g., BERT, GPT).
  • Implement text analytics techniques including topic modeling, sentiment analysis, and text classification.
  • Utilize SQL and NoSQL databases for data extraction and management.
  • Create compelling data visualizations using tools like Matplotlib, Seaborn, or Tableau.

Secondary Responsibilities

  • Contribute to multiple data analysis projects, with a strong focus on text-based data.
  • Build, validate, and deploy predictive models tailored to unstructured text datasets.
  • Handle large-scale text data, including cleaning, preprocessing, and feature engineering.
  • Collaborate with BI analysts and engineers to prototype and present data science solutions.

What We Are Looking For

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degreein:
  • Computer Science
  • Statistics
  • Mathematics
  • Engineering
  • Data Science
  • Postgraduate Degree(preferred) in:
  • Data Science
  • Machine Learning
  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Applied Statistics

Experience

  • 5-8years of relevant experiencein data science, with a strong focus on NLP, machine learning, and model deployment.

Skills and Attributes

  • Proficiency in Python or R and associated data science libraries.
  • Strong understanding of NLP techniques and transformer-based models.
  • Experience with big data tools and handling large unstructured datasets.
  • Ability to translate business problems into data science solutions.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Experience working in collaborative, agile environments.

Key Success Metrics

  • Timely and error-free delivery of data science projects.
  • Effective deployment and performance of predictive models.
  • Resolution of infrastructure and model training issues.
  • Technical leadership and innovation in Gen AI and NLP initiatives.

This is an opportunity for you to join our beautiful Barcelona office as an Associate Data/Product Analyst. You will be working together with other product analysts and data scientists embedded in our games team. You will have a key role in defining, extracting and actioning product data from big datasets. Thus, covering the full scope of data mining to reporting. In addition, you will also be responsible to show the impact of product data via dashboards and/or other means of visualisations to team members throughout the company.

Why this role?

Responsibilities

This role is intended to strengthen the craft of analytics in Product Madness and to ensure product teams are making informed decisions based on actionable insights. Your key responsibilities will be:

  • Working closely with various teams to implement tracking in games to gather player data and build reports that give further insight into player behaviour and product performance.
  • Form new insights and perspectives that advise decisions and help us continue to delight the people playing our games.
  • Produce reports and deliver insights that have an impact on the strategic direction of our games and the game roadmap.
  • Work with game teams and DWH to produce end to end data pipelines that empower end users.
  • Work closely with product and game teams to develop reports and monitoring of daily targets.
  • Investigating issues in the Production environment, analysing and optimising existing product features and A/B tests.
  • Apply creative thinking towards crafting, testing, verifying, and implementing solutions.

What We're Looking For

  • Previous experience in a product or data analyst role
  • Strong SQL and Excel skills
  • Experience of standard reporting tools such as Looker/QlikView/Tableau/Power BI etc.
  • Working experience setting up and analyzing A/B-tests would be desirable
  • Strong in mathematics and quantitative analysis
  • Interested in gaming and the mobile game industry, any experience in these industries would be highly desirable
  • Proficient in English
  • Experience with Python and/or R would be ideal but not crucial

This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Your Moneris Career - The Opportunity

As the Senior Data Scientist, you will lead impactful data science initiatives that move strategic decision-making and product innovation. You will focus on developing and deploying advanced analytical models, conducting experimentation, and uncovering applicable insights from complex datasets.

You are a curious and collaborative problem-solver who excels in a fast-paced environment. You will work closely with cross-functional teams—including engineering, product, and analytics—to design and implement scalable machine learning solutions, support business strategy with data-driven insights, and help shape the future of data science at our organization.

You will emphasize data science and AI, focusing on developing, validating, and deploying models to solve complex business problems. A strong foundation in working with data is important, but the primary focus is on analytical rigor, experimentation, and delivering actionable insights.

Location: You will be based in our Toronto office, balancing in-office collaboration with remote flexibility.

Reporting Relationship: You will report to the Manager, Data Science.

Posting Type: Replacement Position.

Salary Range: The expected base salary range for this role is $128,000 - $154,000.

Total compensation may also include variable or discretionary incentive components, including but not limited to bonuses and commissions. Individual job offers are determined by various factors, including experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs.

Your Moneris Career - What You'll Do

  • Develop and deploy machine learning models to solve complex business problems, ensuring scalability, performance, and alignment with strategic goals.
  • Apply statistical and machine learning techniques to extract insights, forecast outcomes, and support decision-making across the organization.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to uphold best practices in code quality, documentation, testing, and reproducibility.
  • Explore and implement the latest AI approaches, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs), to address new challenges.
  • Work with platform such as Databricks and Snowflake, using Python, PySpark and SQL to conduct advanced data analysis and support model development and deployment.
  • Evaluate new methodologies and technologies to enhance modeling capabilities and stay ahead of industry trends.
  • Partner with developers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to embed insights into enterprise workflows and lead data-informed decisions.
  • Demonstrate intellectual curiosity and a desire to understand the data, uncover patterns, and identify opportunities for innovation.
  • Learn new tools, techniques, and business domains to adapt to evolving priorities and bring high-impact solutions.

Your Moneris Career - What You Bring

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience in a technology or business environment.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in data science and machine learning; advanced analytics experience is a PLUS.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, with demonstrated experience building and deploying models in production environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake and Databricks for data exploration, feature engineering, and model deployment.
  • Proficient in multiple programming languages and comfortable writing clean, maintainable, and well-documented code. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience working with complex datasets to uncover insights and drive decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead data science projects, communicate findings effectively to technical and non-technical audiences, and influence results.
  • Experience with data governance practices and maintaining high standards of documentation for reproducibility and collaboration.
  • Fast learner with a deep curiosity about data, eager to explore new techniques and technologies to improve model performance and growth.
  • Experience in the payments or financial industry is preferred.
  • Familiar with version control (e.g. Git), CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing (unit, functional, performance) a PLUS.

Your Moneris Career - What You Get

At Moneris, we believe in empowering you to succeed—personally and professionally. As part of our team, you'll have access to resources, opportunities, and an inclusive environment that supports your development and career.

  • Comprehensive Total Rewards Program, including performance-based bonuses, flexible benefits starting from day one, and your choice of a health spending account (HSA) or personal spending account (PSA).
  • Retirement planning support, with profit-sharing programs including company match and a defined contribution pension plan.
  • Growth & development opportunities, including unlimited access to Coursera, mentorship programs, and an internal gig marketplace.
  • Holistic wellness support, with an Employee & Family Assistance Program, 24/7 virtual healthcare, and workplace wellness initiatives.
  • Flexibility that works for you, including hybrid work arrangements, a Work from Abroad program, and paid time off programs.
  • Recognition and rewards, with company-wide recognition programs, exclusive banking perks from RBC & BMO, and access to great employee discounts.

Find out more about the work perks and benefits you get as a Moneris employee at Moneris.com/careers.

Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

About Wise Platform

Wise Platform takes all of the world-class payments products Wise has built over the last 15 years and enables hundreds of millions of consumers and businesses to access them in the places where they already move and manage their money - with banks and large tech platforms.

Today, we’re already powering payments for some of the world’s top neobanks like Monzo, N26, and Nubank, alongside a growing list of leading global banks such as UniCredit, Morgan Stanley and Standard Chartered, to name a few. In the tech platforms space, we’re powering payments for partners across a whole range of industry verticals and use cases. Whether that’s leading marketplaces like Google, Agoda, or Upwork, workforce management tools like Deel, or investment platforms like Interactive Brokers - we’re bringing the power, simplicity, and transparency of Wise to even more people and places.

And, we’re just getting started! Wise Platform is one of the newest and fastest growing products at Wise. We’re a global and highly cross-functional team, spearheading Wise next phase of growth!

THE ROLE

As the Senior Product Analyst in Send for Partners, you’ll sit at the centre of one of Wise Platform’s biggest products: helping the world’s largest banks and platforms send money across borders. You’ll work with the Send for Partner’s team to uncover opportunities that shape the product roadmap, measure success of initiatives and performance against KPIs, and work cross functionality to support product features from ideation to scale. This is a highly autonomous role in a fast-scaling “start-up within a scale-up” environment. You’ll turn ambiguous partner problems into crisp insights, compelling narratives and clear product bets, working closely with Product, Engineering, Commercial and Finance to ship improvements that unlock volume, reduce friction, and increase margin.

Qualifications

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

  • You will deliver high-impact, scalable data solutions such as building and maintaining robust models and data products that directly support the team's efficiency, effectiveness and risk appetite.
  • You will proactively manage team KPIs, ensuring clear measurement and understanding of product performance, undertaking deep-dives and providing actionable recommendations to drive product objectives and roadmap.
  • You will be leveraging advanced analytics, crafting dashboards and visualisations that bring product performance data to life, tell a clear story, and offer diagnostic power.
  • You will conduct opportunity sizing for product initiatives to understand short-term and long-term impacts against key performance indicators and our long term vision.
  • You will support product discovery through initiatives such as market sizing, research, and scenario modelling to inform the product roadmap.

What You'll Bring

  • You have experience working in payments and/or banking. A plus if you’re familiar with FX products, and correspondent banking
  • You are proficient with SQL and know your way around data pipeline management tools such as Snowflake, dbt, Git, Airflow, Python, and Lightdash. You're comfortable owning analytics from data transformation through to delivering actionable insights.
  • You are commercially minded. Able to translate your analysis into impact and comfortable with opportunity sizing, prioritisation and scenario modelling.
  • You have experience working in a high-growth B2B tech environment and have worked closely with product teams before.
  • You are solution-oriented and able to own projects from start to finish. You are comfortable motivating stakeholders across Wise and negotiating timelines to unblock yourself and make things happen!
  • You are an excellent communicator, able to form your own opinions and effectively articulate them to influence key stakeholders. You should also be comfortable writing and maintaining clear and concise documentation and analysis.

Nice To Have But Not Essential

  • Proficient in python’s various data transformation, visualisation and statistics libraries i.e. pandas, numpy , scipy and plotly
  • Experience leading a team or owning a whole product domain

Additional Information

Benefits

Base salary of £60k - £85k (based on experience)

  • RSU's in a growing and publicly listed company

Work from (almost) anywhere in the world for up to 90 days a year

Flexible working - you’re trusted to do the right thing and be responsible

Private Medical Insurance + Life Insurance

️ Discounted gym memberships and cycle to work scheme

job_description_raw_html:
About Labhouse

Labhouse is a fast-growing startup that builds, launches, and scales its own AI & Productivity Apps under a subscription-based business model. We are based in Barcelona and were founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos (Co-Founders of SocialPoint).

We operate at the intersection of mobile technology, AI, and product-driven growth, with a strong focus on experimentation and performance. Want to help build mobile apps used by millions of people worldwide? We're now looking for our first Product Data Analyst to turn data into the decisions behind our next releases.

About The Role

As our first Product Analyst, you will be the data partner of our product team, helping us decide what to build, what to fix, and what to stop. You will dig into user behavior and experiments across our app portfolio, turn the findings into clear recommendations, and make sure every product decision is backed by evidence.

This role suits someone curious, autonomous, and hands-on: you define the KPIs, build the dashboards, run the analyses, and follow your insights through to what ships.

You'll be responsible for

  • Defining, tracking, and owning the metrics that matter across our apps: activation, retention, monetization, and LTV
  • Building and maintaining dashboards and reports that product, marketing, and leadership actually use
  • Analyzing the performance of onboarding flows, paywalls, and pricing, and measuring the impact of product changes
  • Analyzing user behavior and funnels to spot drop-offs, opportunities, and root causes
  • Translating raw data into clear hypotheses and prioritized recommendations for the product roadmap
  • Supporting the launch of new apps with early-signal analysis and validation
  • Collaborating with product, engineering, design, and marketing to ship fast and iterate faster
  • Using AI tools to speed up analysis, research, and reporting

About You

Academic background

  • Degree in a quantitative or technical field: Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Economics, or similar

What We're Looking For

  • 1–3 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Product Analyst, ideally in a consumer app or subscription business.
  • Strong SQL and a solid grounding in statistics and experimentation.
  • Fluency with product metrics such as retention, conversion, ARPU, LTV, and CAC.
  • Experience with analytics and BI tools (for example Amplitude, Mixpanel, Looker, or Tableau).
  • A product mindset: you don't just report the numbers, you ask why and suggest what to do next.
  • High ownership, curiosity, and a bias for action.
  • Comfort working with founders and product teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong use of AI tools to speed up your workflow.
  • An eye for good UI/UX and well-crafted product experiences.

Communication

  • Clear, structured communicator who can turn complex data into simple stories and recommendations.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in mobile apps, subscription products, or growth teams.
  • Experience supporting 0-to-1 product launches.
  • Experience working closely with founders or in startup environments.

What we offer

  • The chance to work close to serial entrepreneurs who have built and exited at the highest level.
  • Real ownership and visibility: your analysis directly shapes products used by millions.
  • A growth path toward senior analytics or product roles.
  • An attractive compensation package, above market average.
  • Hybrid work model from our Barcelona office.
  • A fast-moving, AI-native environment where shipping beats talking.

Hiring Process

  • TA Interview: an initial conversation to get to know each other and understand your background.
  • Technical Case: a practical exercise to assess your analytical and product thinking.
  • Product Team Interview: a deep dive into your experience, how you approach data, and fit with the team.
  • Final Interview: a last conversation to align on expectations, culture, and role fit.

You Should Know

Labhouse is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. However you identify or whatever your journey to this point, we welcome all candidates to apply for the position that inspires them. Come join us and help us build a company that everyone is proud to be part of.

CITECH recrute ! 👌

CITECH est une ESN à taille humaine spécialisée dans l'expertise IT et l'accompagnement de projets technologiques stratégiques.

Nous intervenons auprès de grands comptes sur des environnements exigeants, notamment dans la Data, le développement logiciel, le Cloud et la transformation digitale.

Nos consultants participent à des projets à forte valeur ajoutée, associant innovation technologique, performance et amélioration continue.

Nous privilégions la proximité, la qualité des missions et l'accompagnement individuel de nos collaborateurs.

Le partage d'expertise et le développement des compétences sont au cœur de notre démarche.

Description Du Poste

Vous êtes expert(e) en Digital Product Analytics et souhaitez mettre la donnée au service de la valeur client et des décisions produit ?

Nous recherchons un(e) Digital Product Analyst Senior – Piano Analytics (H/F) pour intervenir sur une plateforme digitale transactionnelle à forte audience, accessible sur web et mobile, dans l'univers des jeux et services numériques.

Vous rejoindrez une organisation orientée Product, Data et Design, au sein de laquelle les analyses comportementales et l'expérimentation constituent des leviers majeurs de performance.

Votre principal enjeu sera de contribuer au développement de la valeur client, notamment à l'amélioration de la mise moyenne des joueurs sans risque identifié, en accompagnant les équipes Product dans leurs décisions grâce à des analyses pertinentes et des expérimentations mesurables.

Vous interviendrez sur des parcours transactionnels couvrant différentes gammes de produits, les opérations de rechargement ainsi que les mécanismes d'engagement et de récurrence d'usage, dans le respect des principes de jeu responsable.

Vos principales missions

  • Pilotage de la valeur client et de la performance produit
  • Analyser les comportements et les usages des clients pour identifier les leviers de développement de la valeur client.
  • Étudier les indicateurs de mise moyenne, de fréquence d'utilisation, de récurrence et de fidélisation.
  • Identifier les opportunités d'amélioration de l'engagement et de la performance des différentes gammes de produits.
  • Réaliser des analyses de segmentation, de cohortes et de comportements pour mieux comprendre les dynamiques de consommation.
  • Mesurer les impacts business des évolutions produit sur les indicateurs de performance.
  • Intégrer les contraintes de jeu responsable et les critères d'éligibilité des populations ciblées dans les analyses et recommandations.
  • Expérimentation produit et A/B Testing
  • Accompagner les Product Owners dans la formulation d'hypothèses d'amélioration de la valeur client.
  • Définir les indicateurs de succès et les protocoles de mesure des expérimentations.
  • Concevoir, suivre et analyser les campagnes d'A/B Testing, notamment avec Kameleoon.
  • Évaluer la significativité statistique et les impacts business des résultats obtenus.
  • Identifier les expérimentations les plus prometteuses et formuler des recommandations de déploiement.
  • Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des produits à partir des enseignements des tests.
  • Analyse comportementale et connaissance client
  • Exploiter Piano Analytics et Contentsquare pour comprendre les parcours et les comportements des utilisateurs.
  • Analyser les interactions entre les différentes gammes de produits et les mécanismes de récurrence.
  • Identifier les facteurs favorisant l'engagement, la fidélisation et la valeur client.
  • Réaliser des analyses exploratoires permettant de détecter de nouvelles opportunités d'amélioration.
  • Croiser les données comportementales, transactionnelles et produit pour enrichir la connaissance client.
  • Data Analytics, reporting et qualité des données
  • Concevoir et maintenir des tableaux de bord de suivi des KPIs produit et business sous Piano Analytics et Power BI.
  • Exploiter SQL, Excel et les API pour extraire, croiser et analyser les données.
  • Participer à la définition et à l'évolution des plans de marquage.
  • Garantir la fiabilité et la cohérence des données Analytics en collaboration avec les équipes Tracking, Data et BI.
  • Documenter les méthodes de calcul, les analyses et les indicateurs de performance.
  • Accompagnement des équipes Product et aide à la décision
  • Collaborer quotidiennement avec les Product Owners, Product Managers, équipes Design et métiers.
  • Traduire les problématiques business en hypothèses d'analyse et en indicateurs mesurables.
  • Présenter des recommandations concrètes, argumentées et priorisées.
  • Challenger les décisions produit à partir de données factuelles.
  • Accompagner les équipes dans l'appropriation des outils Analytics et le développement d'une culture Data-driven.
  • Explorer les possibilités offertes par l'intelligence artificielle pour accélérer les analyses et faciliter l'accès aux données.

Environnement technique

  • Web & Product Analytics : Piano Analytics (indispensable), Contentsquare
  • Data & BI : Power BI, SQL, Excel, API
  • Expérimentation : Kameleoon, A/B Testing, analyse statistique
  • Product Analytics : segmentation, cohortes, rétention, valeur client, KPIs business
  • Collaboration : Jira Cloud, Confluence Cloud
  • Restitution : PowerPoint, Data Storytelling
  • Méthodologies : Agile, Scrum, démarche Data-driven
  • Innovation : IA et solutions agentiques appliquées à l'Analytics

Qualifications

Formation

Formation supérieure Bac+5 en Data, statistiques, informatique, marketing digital, Business Analytics ou domaine équivalent.

Expérience

Vous justifiez d'une expérience confirmée en Digital Product Analytics, idéalement sur des plateformes transactionnelles web et mobile à forte audience.

Vous avez déjà accompagné des équipes Product dans l'amélioration de la performance business et participé à des démarches d'expérimentation produit.

Une expérience dans les secteurs du e-commerce, des services digitaux transactionnels, des plateformes d'abonnement ou des jeux en ligne constitue un atout.

Compétences techniques indispensables

  • Expertise opérationnelle de Piano Analytics.
  • Solide maîtrise des analyses comportementales et de la mesure de la performance produit.
  • Expérience concrète dans la conception et l'analyse d'A/B Tests.
  • Capacité à définir, suivre et interpréter des KPIs business.
  • Maîtrise de SQL, Excel et des méthodes d'analyse de données.
  • Bonne compréhension des plans de marquage et de la qualité des données.
  • Connaissance des principes statistiques appliqués à l'expérimentation.

Compétences appréciées

  • Pratique de Contentsquare et de Power BI.
  • Connaissance de Kameleoon.
  • Expérience des analyses de cohortes, de segmentation et de valeur client.
  • Compréhension des mécanismes de fidélisation, de récurrence et de cross-sell.
  • Expérience des environnements Product Management et Agile.
  • Sensibilité aux enjeux de protection des utilisateurs et de jeu responsable.
  • Intérêt pour les applications de l'IA à la Product Analytics.

Compétences fonctionnelles

  • Forte orientation business et création de valeur client.
  • Capacité à relier les comportements utilisateurs aux indicateurs de performance.
  • Aptitude à transformer des analyses complexes en décisions produit concrètes.
  • Compréhension des mécanismes d'engagement, de rétention et de fidélisation.
  • Capacité à construire et défendre des recommandations fondées sur les données.
  • Maîtrise de la démarche expérimentale et de la mesure d'impact.

Qualités personnelles

  • Autonomie, curiosité et proactivité.
  • Esprit analytique et rigueur statistique.
  • Sens du résultat et compréhension des enjeux métier.
  • Excellent relationnel avec les équipes Product et Data.
  • Capacité à challenger les hypothèses et à argumenter les recommandations.
  • Communication claire, pédagogie et esprit de synthèse.

Les + du poste

✔ Un rôle stratégique au cœur du pilotage de la valeur client et de la performance produit.

✔ Une collaboration quotidienne avec les équipes Product, Design et Data.

✔ Des analyses ayant un impact direct et mesurable sur les décisions business.

✔ Une forte dimension d'expérimentation produit et d'A/B Testing.

✔ Un environnement Analytics complet : Piano Analytics, Contentsquare, Power BI et Kameleoon.

✔ Une plateforme digitale à forte audience et des problématiques comportementales complexes.

✔ Une mission de longue durée permettant de développer une véritable expertise métier.

Informations supplémentaires

Pourquoi rejoindre Citech ? 🤔

Chez CITECH, nous accordons une importance particulière à la qualité des missions proposées et à l'accompagnement de nos consultants.

Vous bénéficiez d'une relation de proximité avec nos équipes et d'un suivi individualisé tout au long de votre parcours.

Salaire : 45 K€ - 68 K€ Brut/an selon expérience et expertise

data.

needed.

stakeholders.

audiences.

job_description_raw_html:
About ZAVA

We believe healthcare should be accessible, dependable and affordable for everyone. Now part of Hims & Hers Health, Inc., one of the fastest-growing digital health companies in the world, we’re entering an exciting new chapter as we expand our reach and accelerate our impact.

Our team of Doctors, Engineers, Patient Care Advisors, Pharmacists, Marketers, Product Managers, UX Designers, Commercial, and Operations Specialists work together to build digital healthcare that truly fits around our patients’ lives.

The pandemic changed how people access care, and we’ve led the way by providing over 14 million consultations across the UK, Germany, France, Spain, and Ireland. More patients than ever turn to us for help with weight loss and other conditions that can be safely treated online. We’re evolving our service to make care even more personal, supportive and effective.

We’re doing more than providing healthcare. We’re empowering people to take control of their health, and with the support of Hims & Hers, we’re scaling our vision to become a global leader in digital healthcare.

About The Role

The rapidly expanding digital healthcare industry presents a dynamic and highly competitive landscape.

In this role, the Senior Data Analyst will collaborate directly with key business partners to solve complex problems, deliver actionable insights, and champion data-driven strategic planning.

We are seeking a proactive Senior Data Analyst to empower leadership with deeper performance visibility, sharper decision-making, and accelerated learning cycles. Partnering closely with leaders across Growth, Product, Operations, and Finance, you will end-to-end own core commercial opportunities, from framing questions and diagnosing root causes to framing recommendations and tracking business impact.

Beyond traditional reporting, we need a curious problem-solver who uncovers changing trends, determines underlying drivers, and guides organisational action. You will transform ad-hoc inquiries into scalable, repeatable analytical solutions, advancing our transition toward automated diagnosis, real-time monitoring, and dependable self-service analytics. While focusing on UK business priorities, you will also partner with international analytics peers across the Hims & Hers Group.

What you'll own

  • Lead Product Analytics: Evaluate product funnels and the patient journey through a standardised, systematic framework driven by evidence-based insights. Own product and funnel analytics end to end, partnering with product leadership to set quarterly priorities and turn patient journey insight into sized opportunities, tracking standards and clear recommendations.
  • Experimentation. Own the A/B testing framework and programme (standards, prioritisation, SiteSpect management), acting as the business’s go-to authority on experimentation. Lead cross-functional sessions that share results and learnings, and continuously improve the process.
  • Diagnose product performance with commercial impact: Deeply analyse user funnels, feature adoption, and retention cohorts to uncover core drivers of business growth. Translate complex behavioural data into clear commercial insights, identifying high-leverage opportunities to optimise monetisation and user experience.
  • Drive decisions: Work backwards from commercial objectives, challenge assumptions, recommend concrete actions with trade-offs, and follow up to check whether the decision worked.
  • Measure impact: Design and evaluate experiments, launches and operational changes, using cohort analysis and causal methods to make credible claims even when evidence is incomplete.
  • Build repeatable capabilities: Turn frequent investigations into trusted metrics, models, monitoring, automated diagnostic workflows, AI skill writing, and self-service tools, with shared definitions across markets.
  • Work AI-natively: Use AI and modern BI tools to create dashboards, visualisations, and automated workflows that bring key metrics to life, accelerating exploration and repetitive investigation while maintaining full ownership of data accuracy and underlying assumptions.
  • Become a trusted analytical partner to stakeholders, independently owning material commercial questions and improving the reliability and usability of core metrics, models and analytical workflows

What we're looking for

  • Exceptional analytical problem-solving skills, with a proven track record of prioritising effectively and thriving in fast-paced environments.
  • Experimentation and product analytics expertise. Experience with funnels, cohorts, experimentation and statistical inference, including the limits of observational data and how to communicate uncertainty.
  • Intermediate SQL experience. Confidence in writing efficient SQL queries on large-scale datasets in data warehouses (AWS Redshift, MySQL) with practical Python proficiency.
  • Experience in commercial analytics: acquisition, retention and customer lifetime value modeling.
  • Experience utilising AI-driven capabilities within modern BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Lightdash, Power BI) to streamline analytical workflows and extract actionable insights.
  • Understanding of e-commerce funnels & event tracking, event-level data,
  • Prioritise competing requests based on impact and effort, and confidently push back to stakeholders, with evidence and clear trade-offs, when a request isn’t the best use of the team’s time.
  • Ability to structure messy problems, separate drivers from noise, and know when more precision isn’t worth the time.
  • Ownership and influence: Independently lead important analyses, build relationships with senior stakeholders, and challenge the prevailing view when needed.
  • Systems mindset: Spot patterns in repeated requests and create durable solutions, with semantic metrics, BI or data modelling experience valued.
  • A self-learner who is flexible and open to change.
  • Ship and learn quickly: Deliver useful intermediate answers early, make uncertainty visible, seek feedback and iterate rather than wait for a polished one-off analysis.
  • Raise the analytical bar: Review others’ work constructively, share methods openly, and question weak conclusions.
  • Supporting the wider business by helping to define meaningful, relevant and easily understood KPIs around product performance
  • Inspiring others to love and use data through effective storytelling
  • Presenting insights and opportunities in a clear manner such that product design is based on objective evidence wherever possible
  • Demonstrate faster learning cycles through early delivery, iteration and thoughtful use of AI tools

Nice to have, but not at all essential

  • Working with modern data stacks, for example, BigQuery, AWS Redshift, dbt, Looker, Tableau, Lightdash, MCP
  • Working with events/web tracking tools (Segment/Google Analytics)
  • Experience with marketing (AdWords, Paid Search, etc.), product or operational analytics
  • Experience with version control (we use Git)
  • Healthcare or digital healthcare experience

Our Values

  • Humble: You listen and take on feedback. You are kind and caring to those around you.
  • Inquisitive: You question the status quo, dare to do things differently and explore the possibilities.
  • Resilient: You embrace change and face challenges.
  • Macher: You are innovative and rise above the rest to use your initiative to improve, develop and deliver.
  • Collaborative: You actively share ideas and work together to drive goals as a team.

Benefits From The Day You Join

🏖 33 days per annum pro-rata (inclusive of public and bank holidays) + birthday off

🧑‍⚕️ Free access to Wellness Cloud, advice, counselling, and corporate discounts

🩺 Healthcare cashback plan through SimplyHealth

💙 20% off all select ZAVA products & services for you and your friends and family

🏡 Remote, hybrid, and flexible working

💻 MacBook Pro

🌍 Flexible bank holidays - take the ones that matter the most to you.

Additional Benefits After Probation

💰£500 training budget per year

🧑‍⚕️Vitality Private Health Insurance + Vitality discounts & headspace membership

🚼 Workplace Nursery Salary Sacrifice Scheme

🏦 Pension Salary Sacrifice Scheme

✈️ Company sabbatical after 2 years

🗺 Opportunity to work from overseas for 2 months each year

🤑 Gift vouchers after 3, 5, and 10 years of service

Equal Opportunities

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all backgrounds. Reasonable adjustments available on request.
