Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd®, Slideshare®, Everand™, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

Culture at Scribd, Inc.

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

The team. Data & Analytics at Scribd brings together Analytics Engineering, Data Science, and Product Analytics to turn fragmented data and inconsistent definitions into trusted foundations, and to build AI-assisted tools that bring reliable intelligence into how teams make decisions.

The role. This role supports Content Supply & Understanding, the team that owns Scribd’s library of more than 400 million documents, which reaches over 250 million monthly active users. The team’s remit covers who contributes the content, how well we understand it, and how it reaches users. You will report to the Senior Manager, Data Analytics, and work embedded alongside Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, and Analytics Engineering partners. The role is open at the Senior and Lead levels, and we will level based on the experience you bring. At the Senior level you own analytical workstreams within a defined area. At the Lead level you also set the measurement strategy for the area, take on the most open-ended problems, and raise the bar for the analysts around you.

Mandate. Make it possible to say with confidence what is in the corpus, where it falls short of what users look for, and whether enrichment is making content easier to find and use, with numbers that stay comparable as content sources, models, and pipelines change.

Core philosophy. A metric definition is a shared artifact. We care about documentation, versioning, and data quality as much as the readout on top, because a number that quietly breaks upstream is worse than no number at all.

About You

  • You are at your best when the question is not yet well formed. You look at an incomplete picture, work out what matters, and produce an answer a product team can act on, with the limits of the evidence stated plainly.
  • You are equally comfortable as the strategist and the analyst. You can size an opportunity, model its return, write the SQL behind the metric, and defend the number in a room full of product and executive leaders.
  • You are skeptical by default. When a metric moves sharply, your instinct is to find the field or pipeline that changed before you write the narrative.
  • You are pragmatic. You ask what the right next version is, and you use AI where it creates measurable value.
  • You communicate early and plainly, and you write things down. Methodology and metric documentation are part of the deliverable.

You will

  • Build measurement for content understanding. Define how we measure classification and metadata coverage, accuracy, and the effect of enrichment on discovery and engagement.
  • Own analytics for content supply and generate insights on where the corpus falls short: size the gap between user demand and the corpus, estimate the value of closing it, and help prioritize where to invest, using the same market sizing, segmentation, and ROI methods applied in go-to-market analysis.
  • Partner with Product Managers on strategy and roadmap. Translate product bets into success and guardrail metrics, size opportunities, and make trade-offs explicit.
  • Design and read experiments (A/B tests and other methods) for content-related product changes, from hypothesis through analysis and readout.
  • Define and maintain the KPIs, metric definitions, and dashboards for the content domain, and work with Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering on instrumentation and data quality so that metrics stay consistent over time.
  • Investigate discontinuities and anomalies in content data, and separate real changes in user behavior from pipeline, definition, or instrumentation changes.
  • Use AI-assisted workflows to speed up analysis and reporting, document how results are validated, and keep AI tools grounded as definitions change.
  • Present findings and recommendations to product, engineering, and executive audiences, including in regular metrics reviews.
  • At the Lead level: set analytical standards for the area and mentor other analysts.

You have

  • 4+ years of experience in product analytics or a closely related role for Senior, or 7+ years for Lead, with a record of influencing product or business decisions.
  • Experience turning ambiguous, loosely defined questions into analysis that changed a decision, in areas where data is sparse or metrics did not yet exist.
  • Experience with opportunity sizing, segmentation, or business and go-to-market analysis, such as market sizing, pipeline prioritization, or ROI modeling.
  • Advanced SQL, and experience with Python or R for analysis and statistical work.
  • Experience with a modern data warehouse such as Databricks, and with BI tools such as Looker or Tableau.
  • Experience building AI into analytics workflows, such as LLM-assisted querying, analysis, or reporting, to move faster while checking answers against certified metrics or known results. You use AI where it creates measurable value.
  • Working knowledge of experimentation: A/B test design, hypothesis testing, and statistical analysis.
  • A record of defining a metric, defending it under scrutiny, and revising it when its inputs change.
  • Experience partnering with Product Managers and Engineers on strategy, roadmap, and measurement.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Experience with content-heavy platforms such as marketplaces, catalogs, publishing, or user-generated content, including supply or content quality analytics.
  • Experience with classification, taxonomy, or metadata systems, or with search and recommendation, including evaluating ML or LLM outputs against labeled data.
  • Experience with experimentation platforms such as Statsig.
  • For Lead candidates: experience mentoring analysts and setting measurement standards for a product area.

Our pay ranges are based on the local cost of labor benchmarks for each specific role, level, and geographic location. San Francisco is our highest geographic market in the United States.

In the state of California, the reasonably expected salary range is between $153,000 [minimum salary in our lowest geographic market within California] to $216,500 [maximum salary in our highest geographic market within California].

In the United States, outside of California, the reasonably expected salary range is between $127,000 [minimum salary in our lowest US geographic market outside of California] to $205,500 [maximum salary in our highest US geographic market outside of California].

In Canada, the reasonably expected salary range is between $152,000 CAD[minimum salary in our lowest geographic market] to $ 194,000[maximum salary in our highest geographic market].

We carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including but not limited to experience; job-related skill sets; relevant education or training; and other business and organizational needs. The salary range listed is for the level at which this job has been scoped. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for a competitive equity ownership, and a comprehensive and generous benefits package.

About Us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one.

The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.

What You'll Be Doing

Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Own the Domain’s Data - Define, maintain, and evolve the KPI framework for the domain across all pods (activation, adoption, usage, retention, monetisation, risk and cost signals), ensuring the team always has a reliable, shared view of how our products perform.
  • Turn Behaviour into Insight - Run deep dives on user behaviour across funnels and product journeys to identify drop-offs, usage patterns, and unmet needs, then translate them into clear, prioritised recommendations for Product.
  • Drive Experimentation - Partner with PMs and Designers to shape the experimentation roadmap by defining hypotheses, success and guardrail metrics, sample sizes, and test design, then run the readouts and make sure learnings feed back into the roadmap.
  • Support Product Decisions End to End - Size opportunities, build business cases, and measure post-launch impact on new features and releases, closing the loop between what we ship and the outcomes it delivers.
  • Build Monitoring & Self-Service Tools - Develop dashboards and reports (Hex, Looker, or similar) that give Product, Operations, and leadership real-time visibility on launches, performance, and anomalies, without needing to ask for a query.
  • Partner with Key Stakeholders - Work daily with Product, Design, Engineering, and Operations to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations, up to the executive level.
  • Enhance Analytics Through AI-Powered Workflows - Design and implement AI-assisted workflows to automate recurring analyses, anomaly detection, and reporting, and to speed up ad-hoc exploration.

Who We're Looking For

This role needs someone who is a product-minded analyst with a strong analytical mindset, who thrives in a collaborative, fast-moving environment, is detail-oriented, and is ready to take full ownership of a domain’s data.

  • Relevant Experience - 4+ years in product analytics, data analytics, or BI roles, ideally embedded in a product team within a consumer app, fintech, or payments environment, with hands-on experience in high-volume, high-frequency event data.
  • Product Analytics Expertise - Solid command of funnel, cohort, retention, and segmentation analysis, and of consumer lifecycle metrics (Acquisition, Activation, Retention, Monetisation). Experience with Fintech-specific KPIs and sector dynamics is a strong plus.
  • Experimentation - Proven experience designing and analysing A/B tests: hypothesis definition, power and sample size, guardrail metrics, statistical significance, and clear readouts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Proficiency - Strong command of SQL and Python for analysis. Experience with dbt, Git, and notebook-based analytics (e.g. Hex, Databricks, Jupyter) is a plus.
  • Data Visualisation - Experience with Hex, Looker, or similar tools to build clear, self-service dashboards and monitoring.
  • AI Fluency - Comfortable using AI tools day-to-day for analytics, automation, ad-hoc analyses, and executive summaries. Basic to mid-level proficiency with Claude and experience interacting with agents programmatically via APIs is a strong plus.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills - Comfortable with ambiguity, able to break down complex product questions into focused workstreams, taking end-to-end ownership of analytical projects from problem framing to recommendation.
  • Stakeholder Management & Communication - Able to work independently with cross-functional teams and to translate technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.

CareAbout: how we support your impact

About

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:

  • ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.
  • 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.
  • ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.
  • 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.
  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.
  • We embrace two days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday), with the option to request extra remote time.

Salary: €51.000- €58.000 gross per annum.

This range is set using objective, gender-neutral criteria for the role's core requirements. However, we do not believe in putting a ceiling on talent. The final compensation package is tailored according to your unique experience and expertise. If your skills go beyond the standard profile, apply anyway so we can discuss a package that reflects your true value.

Equal opportunity employer

At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin. Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!

job_description_raw_html:
About dunnhumby

dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, helping the world's most ambitious retailers and brands put the customer at the heart of every decision. With nearly 3,000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca-Cola, Meijer, Procter & Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers.

Product

Our Product team owns the vision, strategy and roadmap for the dunnhumby platform — the data, science and software that powers retailers and brands around the world. We work at the intersection of customer data, AI, and commercial impact, building products that turn insight into measurable growth.

The Role

The Senior Product Analyst plays a key role in helping us build better products through data-driven decision making. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers, you'll transform complex product data into actionable insights that shape product strategy, improve user experiences and drive measurable business outcomes.

You'll champion product analytics across our product teams, enabling experimentation, establishing best practices and ensuring decisions are backed by meaningful data.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll combine analytical expertise, product knowledge and stakeholder collaboration to deliver insights that influence product direction and maximise customer value.

  • Own product analytics across a portfolio of products, defining key metrics and ensuring they are measured, reported and understood effectively
  • Partner with Product Managers, Engineering Managers and Product Designers to support product strategy, objectives and key results (OKRs)
  • Identify opportunities to improve product performance through data analysis, experimentation and evidence-based recommendations
  • Work closely with Data Engineers and product squads to ensure the right data is captured, modelled and available for meaningful analysis
  • Deliver end-to-end analytics, from defining requirements and success metrics through to presenting insights and recommendations to stakeholders
  • Build, maintain and continuously improve product performance dashboards that provide clear, actionable visibility into product health
  • Support product discovery, roadmap planning and experimentation by providing data-driven insights and commercial context
  • Leverage multiple data sources to identify trends, answer business questions and uncover new opportunities for product improvement
  • Continuously improve analytics practices, reporting tools, data visualisation and automation to enable faster, more effective decision making
  • Communicate insights clearly through compelling data visualisation and storytelling tailored to technical and non-technical audiences

What We're Looking For

You'll bring strong analytical capability, curiosity and a passion for using data to solve product challenges while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

  • Experience in product analytics, product management, product ownership or a similar analytics-focused role within a software or technology environment
  • Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting complex data and translating findings into actionable business recommendations
  • Experience working with cross-functional product teams, including Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers
  • Knowledge of product metrics, experimentation, performance measurement and product analytics best practices
  • Experience building dashboards and communicating insights through effective data visualisation and storytelling
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence decision making through data
  • Understanding of statistical analysis, product performance measurement and commercial drivers
  • Experience on Heap,Fullstory or Amplitude
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification

What You Can Expect From Us

We won't just meet your expectations. We'll defy them. So you'll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you'd expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.

And we don't just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process — please let your recruiter know what adjustments would help.

India Benefits

  • Healthcare & Family Cover: Group Medical Insurance of INR 500,000 for employees and dependents, plus dental and vision cover up to INR 5,000.
  • Protection: Group Term Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident cover with benefit levels linked to employee grade, including disability benefits.
  • Retirement & Wellbeing: Provident Fund, Gratuity, National Pension Scheme access, Indian Health Organisation membership, and confidential employee assistance support.
  • Lifestyle & Flexibility: Office commute support, internet allowance of INR 2,000 per month for blended working, work-from-home kit support, subsidised food, and wellbeing resources.
  • Recognition & Extras: Long service awards, Talent Scout referral programme, and family milestone support.
  • Time Off & Family Leave: 25 days holiday plus 10 public holidays, paid maternity, paternity and adoption leave, and a day off for your birthday.

Our approach to Flexible Working

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.

We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.

Queensland Academy for Science, Mathematics and Technology is seeking a highly organised, analytical and motivated Data Management and Analysis Officer to join our school team.

This role will play an important part in supporting effective data management, analysis and reporting to inform strategic planning, monitor student outcomes and strengthen school improvement initiatives.

About Us

At Queensland Academy for Science, Mathematics and Technology (QASMT), we understand this responsibility—and that is why we are committed to and passionate about nurturing our students' academic, social and personal development in a caring and safe community.

About The Role

Develop and maintain management information systems to provide accurate and timely data to support business performance analysis and decision-making.

Responsibilities Include

  • Use departmental tools and resources (including Microsoft Access and Excel) to query and retrieve data stored in corporate information systems and database, and to analyse and present this data in various formats for school management teams.
  • Identify and assist the correction of data errors in consultation with management stakeholders across the School.
  • Assist school management through the provision of regular and ad hoc reports and information.


Please refer to the role description for a full list of responsibilities.

Interested? To Apply:

  • Attach a brief resume including contact details for 2 referees (referees should have an understanding of your relevant work history); 
  • Attach a 2-page written statement in response to the attached role description. 
  • Attach evidence of the mandatory requirements outlined in the attached role description.


We welcome all applicants to share any support needed to ensure our recruitment process is inclusive.

Applications remain current for 12 months from the closing date and may be considered for appointment to identical or similar vacancies within the Department.  

Applications from recruitment agencies will not be accepted.

Senior AI Engineer

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 3–7 Years

Department: AI & Machine Learning


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer with expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, LLMs, and RAG architectures, complemented by a solid foundation in traditional machine learning. You will build, evaluate, and deploy production-grade AI solutions with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and code quality.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop Generative AI applications using LLMs, prompt engineering, and structured outputs.
  • Build advanced RAG pipelines using embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, and vector databases.
  • Develop AI agents and workflows using LangGraph, LangChain, tool calling, and MCP where appropriate.
  • Develop and deploy enterprise level applications using Azure AI services.
  • Implement AI evaluation frameworks, automated regression testing, and quality metrics to assess accuracy, relevance, faithfulness, and task completion.
  • Apply traditional ML techniques for classification, regression, predictive analytics, and NLP where required.
  • Build data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, and evaluation pipelines.
  • Write clean, modular, testable, and maintainable Python code following software engineering best practices.
  • Integrate AI solutions into production systems through APIs, with appropriate security, monitoring, and observability.
  • Deploy and optimize AI applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, contribute to architecture decisions, and mentor junior engineers.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field.
  • 4–7 years of experience in AI/ML development and software engineering.
  • Strong Python programming skills and experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn.
  • Understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including classification, regression, model evaluation, and feature engineering.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, Generative AI, RAG, embeddings, and vector databases.
  • Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent LLM orchestration frameworks.
  • Understanding of AI agents, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and failure handling.
  • Familiarity with evaluation frameworks such as RAGAS, DeepEval, or equivalent tools.
  • Experience with APIs, automated testing, Git, CI/CD, databases, and cloud deployments.
  • Knowledge of production monitoring, debugging, security, and performance optimization.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with MCP, GraphRAG, multi-agent systems, and advanced retrieval techniques.
  • Knowledge of LLM fine-tuning, LoRA/PEFT, and model optimization.
  • Familiarity with Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, MLflow, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Exposure to computer vision, multimodal AI, and MLOps/LLMOps practices.

Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate.

By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day

Overview Of The Role

Are you passionate about turning data into meaningful insights that help businesses make better decisions?

We are currently building a strong pool of talented MIS Executives for future opportunities in Dubai

As an MIS Executive, you will support Aftersales business performance through accurate and timely management information, performance reporting, dashboards, and data analytics. You will consolidate and validate operational and financial data, monitor key performance indicators, and identify trends, variances, risks, and opportunities.

This is an exciting opportunity for an analytical and detail-oriented professional who can go beyond preparing reports and translate complex data into clear, actionable business insights.

What You Will Do

  • Prepare and maintain accurate daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports and management dashboards.
  • Monitor operational, financial, and customer-related KPIs and track performance against targets, budgets, forecasts, and historical trends.
  • Identify and highlight significant variances, risks, opportunities, and areas requiring management attention.
  • Consolidate, validate, reconcile, and cleanse data from multiple systems and business functions.
  • Develop and maintain structured reporting for key Aftersales performance measures such as revenue, gross margin, productivity, utilization, vehicle throughput, WIP, and customer retention.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and business review activities through historical data and performance analysis.
  • Develop and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI and Power Query.
  • Provide ad hoc analysis and management information to support business decision-making.
  • Work closely with Service Operations, Parts, Finance, and other stakeholders to ensure consistent and reliable reporting.

Required Skills To Be Successful

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including advanced formulas, data reconciliation, and analytical reporting.
  • Strong working knowledge of Power BI and Power Query.
  • Experience developing and maintaining interactive dashboards and management reports.
  • Strong knowledge of MIS, KPI measurement, and business-performance reporting.
  • Experience with data consolidation, cleansing, reconciliation, and variance analysis.
  • Strong numerical and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to identify trends and translate data into actionable business insights.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple reporting requirements and deadlines.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Knowledge of SAP or an automotive Dealer Management System is an advantage.

About The Team

You will be part of a collaborative Aftersales environment, working closely with Service Operations, Parts, Finance, branch teams, and other support functions.

The team relies on accurate and meaningful data to understand business performance and make informed decisions. As an MIS Executive, you will play an important role in connecting operational and financial data with management insights, ensuring stakeholders have reliable information when they need it.

What Equips You For The Role

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Statistics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • 3 to 4 years of relevant experience in MIS, business reporting, data analytics, business planning, or performance management.
  • Hands-on experience in management reporting, dashboard preparation, and large-data analysis.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel knowledge.
  • Practical experience with Power BI and Power Query.
  • Experience in data cleansing, reconciliation, variance analysis, and trend analysis.
  • Understanding of automotive Aftersales operations is preferred.
  • Previous automotive distributor, OEM, or dealer experience is preferred.
  • UAE or GCC experience is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, organization, and stakeholder management skills.

job_description_raw_html:
Join us!

We’re always happy to hear from people who are eager to learn and grow, and share our values. Read more about the role and apply.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our growing team of data and AI professionals. In this role, you'll help our clients solve real-world problems by designing and building AI-powered solutions that drive meaningful outcomes. You’ll work hands-on with machine learning, generative AI and cloud platforms—developing impactful applications across industries like energy, manufacturing, retail, health, mobility and more.

To get a sense of our work, explore our Neste AI assistant project and our experiment-driven approach to AI delivery. We work across a wide range of challenges, and no two projects look the same. To get a feel for the breadth of what we do, take a look at our Service Lines.

At Futurice, AI is not just about models. It’s about concrete business value. You'll be involved in projects from early exploration and experimentation to scalable, production-grade deployment—bridging the gap between business, technology, and people.

As a senior team member, you'll also mentor others, contribute to our AI strategy and practices, and play a key role in shaping how we work with AI in a responsible and ethical way.

What You'll Do

  • Train, fine-tune or adapt AI models for specific use cases, including scenarios that call for offline, on-device or edge deployment
  • Design, develop and deploy production-grade AI and machine learning solutions, including generative AI applications (leveraging LLMs and multimodal foundation models)
  • Collaborate in cross-functional teams with designers, developers, and domain experts
  • Contribute to client workshops and technical discovery sessions
  • Build, deploy and operate reliable production pipelines for AI solutions, software engineering practices based on the context
  • Leverage cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP
  • Continuously improve how we use and implement AI in a sustainable and ethical way
  • Mentor junior engineers and share best practices and learnings within the team

What We Hope You Bring

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in AI, ML engineering or applied data-intensive systems, including taking solutions from idea to production
  • A relevant university degree (masters in technology, mathematics or computer science)
  • Experience with model training/fine-tuning workflows (e.g. fine-tuning foundation models or training custom models for a specific task); familiarity with optimizing models for offline or edge environments (quantization, distillation, or runtimes like ONNX/TensorRT/Core ML)
  • Strong Python skills, with experience building maintainable, production-quality code and working with APIs, data processing and backend-style systems
  • Experience with modern data, ML and GenAI libraries and tools, such as NumPy, Pandas, Hugging Face, PyTorch, TensorFlow or similar (Deep expertise in any single framework is not required but we value the ability to apply the right tools pragmatically)
  • Understanding of agentic LLM architectures and patterns, including concepts like tool use, orchestration, evaluation and iterative reasoning (Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK or similar is a plus, but not a requirement)
  • Understanding of data engineering pipelines and APIs
  • Experience deploying AI or ML solutions into production environments, including considerations around reliability, monitoring, iteration and lifecycle management
  • Experience working with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • A curiosity-driven approach and a desire to stay current with AI trends and practices
  • Fluent professional English; Finnish skills are a strong advantage, combined with strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and confidence working directly with clients

We don’t expect you to tick every box. If you feel you’d grow into this role and bring complementary strengths, we’d love to hear from you.

Futurice offers you

We support your growth with a wide range of projects, tools, and learning opportunities. Our client portfolio is diverse, offering a variety of challenges and problem spaces that give you room to explore new areas and develop your skills in meaningful ways. You’ll be encouraged and inspired throughout your journey by a community of motivated, multidisciplinary colleagues across development, design, data, AI and strategy.

Perks Include

  • A hybrid work model that supports flexibility and collaboration
  • Free choice of work gear — laptop, phone, tablet, headphones, and more
  • Sports and lunch benefit
  • Comprehensive healthcare and additional health insurance
  • Futurice clubs and free-time activity groups
  • Learning events and internal communities
  • Certification programs to support your continued development

You’ll get a thorough local and global onboarding, plus your very own Futubuddy to support you throughout your journey with us. And to top it off, you’ll have the chance to join our Onboarding Camp.

Compensation

Your complete compensation package will be discussed in detail during the recruitment process. Our salary model is designed to offer a range of levels based on three factors: skills, responsibilities and impact. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive work environment where every employee has the opportunity to thrive and advance in their career and become better versions of themselves.

During the initial interview round, we will discuss the salary range for this position. We offer a fixed salary with the possibility of performance-based bonuses and additional benefits.

Next steps

If this sounds like the opportunity you’re looking for, please submit your application.

Our form is simple: share your contact details and upload your attachments. We’d love to see your CV and a few lines about yourself and why you want to join Futurice. You can also include links to your LinkedIn or any other materials you find relevant.

After we receive your application, we’ll be in touch. If you move forward, the process includes:

  • First conversation (60 min, Google Meet) You will meet two Futurice team members, get to know them, and have the opportunity to introduce yourself while learning more about Futurice, the role, and our ways of working.
  • Skills-based interview (90 min, Live) A deep dive into your skills with two of our data consultants. We’ll review your problem-solving approach and skills.
  • Role, expectations & projects interview (60 min, Live or Google Meet) A conversation focusing on your potential role, expectations, and upcoming projects. This interview is typically with your potential supervisor and a Principal-level team member.

Reference calls are also a standard part of our recruitment process.

What It’s Like To Work Here

Ever since Futurice was founded, we’ve focused on creating a workplace people genuinely enjoy, Mondays included. We’ve built a welcoming culture where trust, kindness, and well-being matter as much as great work. Our atmosphere is open and warm, whether you’re in the office or working remotely. You’ll quickly feel part of the community where coffee chats, virtual fikas, or after-work hangouts happen naturally.

Because our culture is shaped by all of us, every day, you’ll have an opportunity to influence how we work, connect, and evolve as a community. Across countries, teams, and time zones, everyone brings their own character, helping shape how we work, connect, and evolve together.

At Futurice, new joiners aren’t expected to fit into a mold. Come as you are, whatever your background. We believe in the power of different perspectives, and diversity is a key part of our success at delivering customer value when they trust us with some of their most challenging and inspiring challenges. You can read more about our DE&I commitment here.

We help organizations unlock new value by combining data, AI, design, and strategy. Our promise is simple: faster, smarter delivery; AI-powered decisions; and exceptional, data-driven experiences. We deliver clarity, and clarity delivers results.

Our vision is to redefine organizations with data and AI. Large enterprises work with us to build smarter services, accelerate decision-making, and strengthen their competitive edge.

Founded in 2000, Futurice has grown into an 800+ person community across Europe. Our culture is built on trust, transparency, care, and continuous improvement. We offer a collaborative, international environment where ambitious people learn, grow, and make a real impact.

Department: AI Cluster

Location: Kazakhstan

Description

Our AI Customer Support and Safety team is working on many areas including Computer Vision, NLP, RL etc, bringing business value to our products and improving the lives of our customers. Now we are aiming to strengthen several streams and looking for an experienced middle Machine Learning Engineer, who will help us in our journey. The primary focus for this position will be automation of the driver verification process, for which experience in computer vision is essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain machine learning models and systems
  • Conduct in-depth data analysis, preparation, and processing
  • Contribute to the design of ML systems, focusing on data-related aspects like annotation and processing
  • Follow established security guidelines and identify potential risks
  • Collaborate with peers to review and ensure designs are effective, flexible, and reusable
  • Solve issues and provide feedback for engineering design and delivery processes
  • Ensure that features are deployed according to requirements and operate without unintended side effects
  • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for models and processes
  • Monitor and support deployed solutions to ensure they meet performance expectations
  • Actively seek out information and internal solutions to ensure reusability and adoption of common technologies

Our expectations

  • 3+ years of experience in the Field. Previous software engineering experience is preferrable
  • Strong proficiency in Python and its common data processing frameworks (e.g., for streaming, batch, and asynchronous data).
  • Strong foundational knowledge in classical machine learning, deep learning, and advanced mathematics.
  • Familiarity with MLOps principles and experience using MLOps tools for managing the ML model lifecycle.
  • Experience with backend systems and infrastructure, and a willingness to learn new technologies (like Golang) for integration purposes.
  • The ability to design solutions using common design patterns and various design tools.
  • Experience in experiment design and the ability to validate the credibility of information from various sources.
  • A solid understanding of the business value of delivered features.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with an emphasis on using technical facts and reasoning.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including active listening and the ability to build consensus.
  • A strong drive for continuous self-development and a collaborative mindset for contributing to communities.
  • Ability to balance quality and speed depending on the case, and justify your decision
  • Ability to explain the background and consequences of your technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders, including product and business managers
  • English communication skills

Why join us

  • Help us challenge injustice by creating fair choices for millions of people across 47 countries.
  • Develop your professional skills with access to mentoring, career consulting, and learning programs.
  • Collaborate with teams around the world and gain international experience through our Global Talent Exchange Program.
  • Engage in company-wide challenges, awards, sports activities, employee-led social impact and volunteering projects.
  • Work alongside people who take initiative, speak openly, and challenge themselves to grow.
  • Improve your language skills through co-financed courses and internal speaking clubs.
Final benefits may vary depending on the location.

Description

Sadie is building voice AI for hotels. When a guest calls, Sadie answers, day or night: it shares property information, quotes availability and rates, and books reservations in the hotel's own systems.

We're looking for an early-career AI engineer to join our Montreal team and ship product work from your first weeks. The team is lean, so your code reaches real hotels quickly, and you'll be trusted with more as you prove yourself. Use AI to research, draft, test, and automate. You're responsible for the quality of the result.

What you'll do

Improve How The Voice Agent Handles Real Calls

You'll review calls and transcripts to find where Sadie gets a request wrong, write the fix, and test it before it reaches a hotel. When Sadie fumbles a booking, the hotel hears about it from their guest.

Build hotel system integrations

You'll build and maintain the connections that let Sadie check real availability and rates and write reservations back to the hotel. A mistake here means a double booking or a guest quoted the wrong price.

Ship features and measure quality

You'll take features from idea to production and help build the test calls and checks that tell us whether a release made Sadie better or worse. Expect close code review, and to review others' code as you grow.

What you'll bring

  • You're graduating now, or graduated in the last one to two years.
  • Either a FAANG internship, or startup experience or a project you built and shipped yourself.
  • Clear evidence of initiative and strong ambition.
  • Solid programming fundamentals and comfort building with LLMs and APIs.
  • You work independently, ask for help early, and finish what you start.

Useful experience

  • A degree from a top Canadian university
  • Hackathons, standout projects, or strong internships
  • Voice or conversational AI work

Who will enjoy this role

Someone who hears a call that went wrong and can't let it go until it's fixed. The hard part: the team is small and moves quickly, so there's less hand-holding than at a large company, and your mistakes reach real guests.

Why this role matters

Small hotel teams miss calls, and each missed call can be a lost booking. As more hotels rely on Sadie, we need engineers who can own parts of the product. You'll start with well-defined pieces, and your scope will grow as fast as you do.

Sadie développe une IA vocale pour les hôtels. Quand un client appelle, Sadie répond, de jour comme de nuit : elle donne l'information sur l'établissement, indique les disponibilités et les tarifs, et crée les réservations dans les systèmes de l'hôtel.

Nous cherchons un ou une ingénieur·e IA en début de carrière pour se joindre à notre équipe de Montréal et livrer du travail de produit dès vos premières semaines. L'équipe est petite, donc votre code arrive vite chez de vrais hôtels, et on vous en confiera davantage à mesure que vous ferez vos preuves. Utilisez l'IA pour chercher, rédiger, tester et automatiser. Vous êtes responsable de la qualité du résultat.

Ce que vous ferez

Améliorer la façon dont l'agent vocal gère les vrais appels

Vous analyserez des appels et des transcriptions pour trouver où Sadie comprend mal une demande, écrirez le correctif et le testerez avant qu'il n'atteigne un hôtel. Quand Sadie rate une réservation, l'hôtel l'apprend de son client.

Construire les intégrations avec les systèmes hôteliers

Vous construirez et maintiendrez les connexions qui permettent à Sadie de vérifier les vraies disponibilités et les vrais tarifs, et d'inscrire les réservations dans les systèmes de l'hôtel. Une erreur ici, c'est une double réservation ou un mauvais prix annoncé à un client.

Livrer des fonctionnalités et mesurer la qualité

Vous ferez passer des fonctionnalités de l'idée à la production et aiderez à bâtir les appels de test et les vérifications qui nous disent si une version a amélioré Sadie ou l'a dégradée. Attendez-vous à une révision de code serrée, et à réviser le code des autres à mesure que vous progressez.

Ce que vous apportez

  • Vous terminez vos études maintenant, ou avez obtenu votre diplôme dans les un à deux dernières années.
  • Soit un stage dans une entreprise FAANG, soit une expérience en startup ou un projet personnel que vous avez construit et lancé.
  • Des preuves claires d'initiative et une forte ambition.
  • De solides bases en programmation et de l'aisance à construire avec des LLM et des API.
  • Vous travaillez de façon autonome, demandez de l'aide tôt et finissez ce que vous commencez.

Expérience utile

  • Un diplôme d'une grande université canadienne
  • Des hackathons, des projets marquants ou de solides stages
  • De l'expérience en IA vocale ou conversationnelle

Qui aimera ce poste

Une personne qui entend un appel qui a mal tourné et ne peut pas passer à autre chose avant de l'avoir corrigé. Ce qui est difficile : l'équipe est petite et avance vite, il y a donc moins d'encadrement que dans une grande entreprise, et vos erreurs atteignent de vrais clients.

Pourquoi ce poste compte

Les petites équipes hôtelières manquent des appels, et chaque appel manqué peut être une réservation perdue. À mesure que plus d'hôtels comptent sur Sadie, nous avons besoin de personnes capables de prendre en charge des parties du produit. Vous commencerez par des morceaux bien définis, et votre champ d'action grandira aussi vite que vous.

Overview

This role focuses on developing GenAI/LLM solutions such as Chatbots, AI Agents, and Copilots, as well as building RAG systems and integrating LLMs with existing platforms. The role also involves designing production-ready GenAI architectures and deploying AI solutions on cloud platforms.

Responsibilities

GenAI / LLM Development

  • Build GenAI applications based on Large Language Models (LLMs) such as Chatbots, AI Agents, and Copilots.
  • Design and implement RAG pipelines (document ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, re-ranking).
  • Perform prompt engineering, including prompt templates, system prompts, and tool calling.
  • Conduct fine-tuning / instruction tuning (when necessary) or adapter-based tuning (LoRA, PEFT).

AI Architecture & Integration

  • Design GenAI architectures for production environments (API-based, microservice-oriented).
  • Integrate LLMs with existing systems: Web, Mobile, CRM, ERP, CMS, and Data Platforms.
  • Work with vector databases (FAISS, Milvus, Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.).
Requirements

Must-have

  • From 4 years of experience in AI/ML development or Software Engineers transitioning into AI.
  • Strong proficiency in Python.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM / GenAI platforms (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, open-source LLMs).
  • Experience building RAG systems.
  • Solid understanding of tokens, context windows, embeddings, temperature, top-k/top-p.
  • Experience with REST APIs, JSON, and asynchronous processing.
  • Good English communication skills

Preferred

  • Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Dify, or equivalent frameworks.
  • Experience with vector databases (FAISS, Milvus, Pinecone, etc.).
  • Experience deploying AI solutions on AWS / Azure / GCP.
  • Knowledge of Docker and CI/CD.
  • Experience working on client projects (ITO/consulting).
Nice to have
  • Experience with AI Agents (multi-agent systems, tool-based agents).
  • Experience fine-tuning open-source LLMs (LLaMA, Mistral, Qwen, etc.).
  • Knowledge of Knowledge Graphs and Hybrid Search (BM25 + Vector).
  • Experience with traditional NLP techniques.
  • Understanding of data privacy and security in AI systems.

 

Benefits
  • Working in a young and professional environment. 
  • Staying in a friendly and spiritual space (daily tea break, weekly sports time, monthly outdoor activity and annual holiday). 
  • Obtaining guidance and awareness of advanced technologies. 
  • Earning very competitive salary. 
  • Being reviewed to increase salary twice per year. 
  • Receiving social insurance according to Vietnamese Government regulations. 
  • Having opportunity to join Football, Gym, Badminton and Swimming Club. 
  • Working hours: 5 days/week (Monday to Friday).

Description De L'entreprise

S’appuyant sur son savoir-faire des produits complexes de haute technologie, la vocation de CIMPA est de fournir à ses clients un avantage concurrentiel en améliorant l'efficacité opérationnelle tout au long du cycle de vie du produit. Complexité technologique, long cycle de de vie, exigences de sûreté et sécurité, chaine logistique multi-dimensionnelle… : nous nous engageons pour transformer, optimiser et renforcer l’approche de conception et production industrielles et les systèmes d’information associés.

Nos services complets et modulaires autour du Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) couvrent chaque étape du cycle de vie du produit : la conception du produit, sa fabrication, l'entrée en service jusqu’à la maintenance et le support. La connaissance du métier industriel de nos clients conjuguée à notre savoir-faire dans les technologies de l’information fait notre force. Nous intervenons auprès des différentes Directions et Fonctions qui suivent l’évolution du produit.

CIMPA s'adresse à l'industrie manufacturière, ainsi qu'aux fournisseurs des grands donneurs d’ordre, opérateurs, partenaires et clients, dans le secteur de l’aéronautique, de la défense, de l’énergie et du transport.

Description Du Poste

En mission auprès de nos clients majeurs du secteur aéronautique, vous participerez à la réalisation d’analyses de données et à la conception de tableaux de bord. Vous serez également force de proposition pour identifier et mettre en œuvre des axes d’amélioration. Une bonne connaissance de l’environnement aéronautique constitue un atout, car vous serez amené à intervenir sur des plateformes telles que google workspace, Skywise, Qlik Sense ou d’autres outils similaires.

Selon vos appétences et votre évolution, vous pourrez progressivement vous orienter vers des activités de data science, de modélisation de données ou vers des sujets liés au cloud.

Qualifications

Compétences techniques

  • Solide maîtrise d’Excel/Sheet, SQL et d’un outil de visualisation de données (Power BI, Qlik Sense, Skywise, looker ou équivalent).
  • Connaissance des langages d’analyse type Python et des bibliothèques associées.
  • Bonne compréhension des indicateurs de performance (KPI) et des logiques de reporting.
  • Capacité à manipuler, nettoyer et fiabiliser des jeux de données variés.
  • Sens du détail, de la communication et de la pédagogie dans la restitution des analyses.

Qualités humaines

  • Esprit analytique et curiosité intellectuelle.
  • Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement en mouvement, à gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle et à prioriser.
  • Envie de progresser, d’expérimenter et de contribuer à la culture data de l’entreprise.

Poste correspondant à la fiche emploi data analyst P1 de la convention collective de la métallurgie.

Informations supplémentaires

Venir au sein de CIMPA, c’est :

  • S’impliquer dans de nombreux projets dont vous êtes moteur afin de renforcer la notoriété de notre entreprise et l’engagement de nos équipes,
  • Avoir le goût du challenge pour réussir vos missions à temps,
  • Développer votre autonomie et votre sens de l’initiative,
  • Développer une compétence métier,
  • Profiter d’un encadrement bienveillant.

The world is how we shape it.

Employeur inclusif et engagé, notre société œuvre chaque jour pour lutter contre toute forme de discrimination et favoriser un environnement de travail respectueux. C’est pourquoi, attachés à la mixité et à la diversité, nous encourageons toutes les candidatures et tous les profils.

Job Description

Job ID: MJ000208

We are building a brand-new, high-impact AI and algorithm team within our core business units. As a Senior Algorithm Engineer, you will lead the design and implementation of next-generation generative AI capabilities, focusing on core areas such as intelligent customer service chatbots, translation agents, and travel-related conversational assistants.

This is a highly autonomous and impactful role. You will not only participate in the definition and development of AI products from scratch, but also directly drive their large-scale application in real-world business scenarios. Your work will directly impact the service experience, problem-solving efficiency, conversion rates, and operating costs for millions of users.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the design, development, and continuous optimization of intelligent customer service chatbot and AI agent systems, covering key scenarios such as pre-sales consultation, itinerary inquiries, order support, after-sales service, and multilingual translation.
  • Build agent architectures for complex business processes, including task planning, tool invocation, memory management, retrieval enhancement, workflow orchestration, multi-turn dialogue management, and anomaly recovery.
  • Design and optimize natural language understanding and generation capabilities for travel and customer service scenarios, including user intent recognition, context modeling, knowledge-based question answering, response generation, and multilingual interactive experiences.
  • Drive the deployment of large-scale models in vertical businesses, exploring methods such as Prompt Engineering, RAG, SFT, and preference optimization to continuously improve answer quality, task completion rate, and user satisfaction.
  • Establish an evaluation system for intelligent customer service and agents, including offline assessment, automated evaluation, manual quality inspection, online A/B testing, and continuous iteration mechanisms.
  • Collaborate closely with product, engineering, data, and operations teams to promote deep integration of AI capabilities with business systems, ensuring that solutions offer high availability, low latency, scalability, and cost-effective production-grade performance.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) of agents in real-world scenarios, including problem resolution rate, human agent referral rate, first-response latency, average processing time, satisfaction, cost, and stability, and continuously optimize these metrics.

Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in algorithm engineering, machine learning, NLP, or related fields, with successful experience deploying AI or machine learning systems in large-scale production environments.
  • Possesses strong practical experience in generative AI/LLM applications, and is familiar with the core technologies and implementation challenges of intelligent customer service, question-answering systems, dialogue systems, or agent-type products.
  • Proficient in Python and familiar with mainstream machine learning/deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Scikit-Learn.
  • Familiar with the key technology stack for large-scale model applications, including prompt design, RAG, vector retrieval, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, tool usage, and multi-turn dialogue management.
  • Possesses solid engineering capabilities, capable of independently driving the entire closed loop from data analysis, modeling experiments, performance evaluation to online deployment and iterative optimization.
  • Possesses excellent business understanding and cross-team collaboration skills, capable of transforming complex AI capabilities into stable, measurable, and sustainably optimizable business results.
  • Bachelor's degree or above, with preference given to candidates with a background in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related quantitative fields.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with customer service chatbots, enterprise knowledge assistants, translation agents, task-oriented dialogue systems, or AI copilots.
  • Experience with multilingual models, cross-language retrieval, machine translation, or internationalization products, especially in complex travel or service scenarios.
  • Familiarity with LangGraph, LangChain, OpenAI/Anthropic/open-source large model ecosystems, or experience in building agent workflows.
  • Experience in model evaluation, AI security, visual governance, policy control, human-machine collaboration, and the design of mechanisms for transferring data to human intervention.
  • Familiarity with vector databases, retrieval systems, Elasticsearch, Milvus, Redis, and other related infrastructure.
  • Experience in OTA, travel, e-commerce, or high-concurrency online service scenarios is preferred.
  • Experience in search, recommendation, or ranking is a plus, but not mandatory.

job_description: About LawnStarterLawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $150M in annual bookings and two consecutive years of profitability. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for all home services, and we're investing in the next generation of our platform to get there.About The TeamWe're a high-leverage team of Product Data Analysts embedded across the business, owning the semantic layer and the metrics everyone trusts. We turn "I have a hunch" into "here's what actually happened," and we're the reason teams across the company can make calls on evidence instead of instinct. This role brings dedicated analytical firepower to the Pro (supply) side of that work.RequirementsThe RoleAs a Lead Product Data Analyst, you'll directly impact our results through insights and reports. You'll work closely with product managers, researchers, and other business stakeholders, helping with prioritization, assessments, and business recommendations. Alongside the rest of the Analytics team, it's your responsibility to nurture the data-driven culture within the company, making data easier to consume, whether through interactive reports, easy-to-use datasets, documentation, or training.You'll work with the autonomy of a Lead: setting your own standards, working independently, and acting as a trusted thought partner rather than an order-taker. That title isn't about managing people, there's no team attached to it. It's about the bar you hold your own analysis to, and the bar you help everyone around you reach.This role leans toward the Pro (supply) side of our marketplace, though the exact focus flexes with where the business needs the most insight.What You'll OwnModeling & Analysis: A marketplace is a complex system, with many moving parts and often contradicting signals. That creates an exciting pool of opportunities to find gaps, insights, and optimizations. Analyses range from a simple A/B test to a multivariate model on retention or ETA, backed by advanced SQL and intermediate Python or RReporting: A complex system produces a high number of metrics worth tracking. A dashboard is only as good as our trust that it's correct and current. You'll understand the needs of the teams you work with and help create and maintain the reporting system, keeping it organized and easy to act onAnalytics Engineering: Occasionally you'll work in the inner layers of the Data Warehouse to provide clean, documented datasets that power our reports and end users. We use dbt for transformation, so SQL is a mustProblems to SolveMetrics nobody fully trusts. Different teams cite different numbers for the same thing, and no one's quite sure which is current. Untangling that and giving the business one number it can stand behind is core to the job.Analysis that ships but doesn't move anything. A technically correct answer that doesn't change a single decision is still a failure. Getting a stakeholder to actually act on what you found is the hard part, not the SQL.Data that's hard for anyone but an analyst to touch. If every question requires filing a ticket and waiting on you, you haven't built a data-driven culture, you've built a bottleneck.A system with too many moving parts and not enough signal. About LawnStarter

LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $150M in annual bookings and two consecutive years of profitability. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for all home services, and we're investing in the next generation of our platform to get there.

About The Team

We're a high-leverage team of Product Data Analysts embedded across the business, owning the semantic layer and the metrics everyone trusts. We turn "I have a hunch" into "here's what actually happened," and we're the reason teams across the company can make calls on evidence instead of instinct. This role brings dedicated analytical firepower to the Pro (supply) side of that work.

Requirements

The Role

As a Lead Product Data Analyst, you'll directly impact our results through insights and reports. You'll work closely with product managers, researchers, and other business stakeholders, helping with prioritization, assessments, and business recommendations. Alongside the rest of the Analytics team, it's your responsibility to nurture the data-driven culture within the company, making data easier to consume, whether through interactive reports, easy-to-use datasets, documentation, or training.

You'll work with the autonomy of a Lead: setting your own standards, working independently, and acting as a trusted thought partner rather than an order-taker. That title isn't about managing people, there's no team attached to it. It's about the bar you hold your own analysis to, and the bar you help everyone around you reach.

This role leans toward the Pro (supply) side of our marketplace, though the exact focus flexes with where the business needs the most insight.

What You'll Own

  • Modeling & Analysis: A marketplace is a complex system, with many moving parts and often contradicting signals. That creates an exciting pool of opportunities to find gaps, insights, and optimizations. Analyses range from a simple A/B test to a multivariate model on retention or ETA, backed by advanced SQL and intermediate Python or R
  • Reporting: A complex system produces a high number of metrics worth tracking. A dashboard is only as good as our trust that it's correct and current. You'll understand the needs of the teams you work with and help create and maintain the reporting system, keeping it organized and easy to act on
  • Analytics Engineering: Occasionally you'll work in the inner layers of the Data Warehouse to provide clean, documented datasets that power our reports and end users. We use dbt for transformation, so SQL is a must

Problems to Solve

Metrics nobody fully trusts. Different teams cite different numbers for the same thing, and no one's quite sure which is current. Untangling that and giving the business one number it can stand behind is core to the job.

Analysis that ships but doesn't move anything. A technically correct answer that doesn't change a single decision is still a failure. Getting a stakeholder to actually act on what you found is the hard part, not the SQL.

Data that's hard for anyone but an analyst to touch. If every question requires filing a ticket and waiting on you, you haven't built a data-driven culture, you've built a bottleneck.

A system with too many moving parts and not enough signal. Supply, demand, pricing, and service quality all interact. Teasing out what's actually driving a metric versus what's noise is a real analytical problem, not a formality.

What Success Looks Like (Year 1)

  • The metrics teams rely on daily are trusted, documented, and current, no one's quietly keeping a shadow spreadsheet because they don't trust the dashboard
  • Routine questions are self-serve: stakeholders find their own answers in existing reports instead of pinging you for a one-off pull
  • You can name specific decisions your analysis changed, not just analyses you delivered
  • The datasets and models you've built in dbt are clean and documented enough that other analysts build on them without redoing your work

Who You Are

AI-Native: You use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and similar) daily to move faster: drafting and debugging SQL and dbt models, scripting analysis, and shaping reports, and you keep experimenting with new capabilities as they show up. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you're skeptical of AI tools or prefer to do everything by hand.

Learning Mindset: You take pride in understanding problems deeply and asking the right questions before reaching for an answer. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you have a preconceived system of processes and methods and plan on just applying them without first learning all the ways our business is unique.

Sets the Bar: As a Lead, you work autonomously, hold your own analysis to a high standard, and raise the bar for the people around you, whether or not they report to you. Product managers and stakeholders should see you as a trusted thought partner, not an order-taker. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you want a title and a team before you're willing to raise everyone else's standards.

Team Player: You are ready to work alongside exceptional people, helping them achieve great results. You create an environment where people are excited to work with you daily, with intellectual honesty and trust. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you value being right over reaching the right answer together.

Business Focus: You care deeply about understanding business needs and how your analysis connects with our product, customers, and financials. You can envision how metrics drill down from the highest to the lowest level, identifying what needs to be analyzed or reported on at each. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you're happiest doing analysis for its own sake, disconnected from a decision it will drive.

Bias for Action: You understand that despite your careful approach to understanding problems, you actively avoid being a perfectionist or getting tied up in knots. You have a bias for action to make progress, and you enjoy being scrappy, with constraints that enthrall you. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you, by default, like building full solutions from the get-go.

This Role Is NOT

  • A ticket queue. You're not here to pull numbers on demand, you decide what's worth measuring and how to measure it
  • A dashboard-admin seat. Maintaining BI tooling is part of the job, not the point of it. The point is the insight the dashboard delivers
  • A people-management role. This is an individual-contributor seat. "Lead" describes the bar you hold yourself and others to, not a team you manage
  • A role that waits for perfectly clean data. If you need data handed to you pre-cleaned before you can start, this isn't the right seat, you're expected to get your hands into the warehouse

Tools of the Trade

SQL and dbt for transformation and modeling, Python or R for the occasional statistical deep dive, and Lightdash as our primary BI layer for dashboards and self-serve reporting.

Benefits

  • Base salary: $75,000-$100,000 USD annually
  • AI tooling provided: The Claude routines already running pieces of our experimentation process are yours to extend, not a side project you have to justify
  • Fully remote: This is deep-focus analytical work with US-facing partners. We hire the best analyst regardless of city and trust you to manage your environment and overlap hours
  • Flexible PTO: Measured on outcomes, not hours logged

VERY IMPORTANT REMINDER: Please upload your English resume. Applications without it will not be considered.

GS1 Egypt continuously develops its data capabilities to support its products, services and business decisions. We’re looking for a Data Analyst to work with our data, product and business teams to turn data into reliable reporting, actionable insights and better decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Translate business questions into clear metrics, analysis and reporting requirements.
  • Write SQL queries to extract, combine and validate data from multiple systems.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI, Metabase or Apache Superset.
  • Analyze trends, investigate unusual results and communicate findings with clear recommendations.
  • Identify missing, duplicate or conflicting records, reconcile datasets and track data-quality improvements.
  • Define and document KPIs, calculation rules and reporting assumptions.

  • Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, CTEs and window functions.
  • Hands-on experience independently delivering dashboards in at least one BI platform, such as Power BI, Metabase, Superset or Tableau.
  • Strong Excel skills for analysis, reconciliation and validation.
  • Understanding of data modelling, relationships, metric definitions and analytical accuracy.
  • Experience cleaning and reconciling data, investigating discrepancies and validating results.
  • Ability to understand business needs, explain findings clearly and follow work through to delivery.

Nice to have

  • Python and pandas for analysis and automation.
  • Experience with customer, subscription, product or operational analytics.
  • Exposure to cloud data platforms, data governance or regulated product data.

About The Job

We currently have an exciting opportunity for a Data Analyst - eCommerce Analytics to join the Tailored Brands Enterprise Analytics team. As Data Analyst – eCommerce Analytics, your primary responsibility will be to extract actionable insights from data to optimize ecommerce performance with insights from site content, promotions, customer behavioral data, marketing strategies, and market data, just to name a few. The primary goal is providing insights for the ecommerce and marketing teams to guide, monitor and measure their strategies.

  • Data Collection: Partner with operations to track customer actions on the website through Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics.

  • Reporting: Create clear, concise, and insightful dashboards via Power Bi, Looker Studio, and Excel Pivots.
  • Presentations: Present analyses in a clear, interpretable, and applicable way that can be shared widely, communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical partners.
  • Collaborate: Partner with data engineering, ecommerce teams, and across analytics to share learnings, align on methodologies and leverage best practices.

What You’ll Bring | Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in statistics, business, merchandising, or a related field is required.
  • Minimum of 3 years career experience in ecommerce or analytics.
  • Google Analytics: Proficiency in analyzing data in GA is required.
  • SQL: Proficiency in querying databases for data extraction is required.

Work Environment, Physical & Mental Demands

  • Ability to sit and work at a computer keyboard for extended periods of time.
