Somos uma Fundação de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação que cria soluções tecnológicas para empresas, governo e terceiro setor. Valorizamos a colaboração, o trabalho em equipe, a diversidade e o desenvolvimento contínuo, oferecendo oportunidades iguais e buscando pessoas que queiram enfrentar desafios e gerar impacto por meio da inovação.


Tá curioso(a) pra saber o que você vai fazer aqui? Dá uma conferida então:


Você atuará com as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento de Módulos e Subgrafos: Implementar e manter fluxos locais em frameworks agênticos (ex.: LangGraph, CrewAI) com controle de exceções e persistência de estado.
  • Engenharia de Ferramentas com Tipagem Rígida: Criar APIs internas modulares em FastAPI com validação rigorosa via Pydantic para consumo determinístico pelos agentes.
  • Automação de Evals e Controle de Qualidade: Manter a suíte de testes de alucinação e relevância (ex.: Ragas/DeepEval) integrada à esteira de entrega, isolando e diagnosticando regressões.
  • Operação e Diagnóstico em LLMOps: Inspecionar árvores de traces no Langfuse/LangSmith para antecipar gargalos de latência, loops anômalos e desperdício de tokens.
  • Experimentação Guiada em RAG e Fine-Tuning: Executar benchmarks práticos de recuperação (testando chunking e re-ranking) e preparar datasets higienizados para rodar rotinas.


Esperamos que você tenha os seguintes conhecimentos e habilidades:

  • Sólida base em Python e bibliotecas essenciais de IA/ML (ex.: Scikit-Learn, NumPy);
  • Domínio de lógica de programação, boas práticas de engenharia de software e versionamento com Git;
  • Conhecimento prático em SQL e manipulação de dados (ETL básico);
  • Vontade de aprender e alta capacidade de absorção de novos conceitos;
  • Raciocínio lógico e analítico para resolução de problemas;
  • Postura proativa na busca de soluções técnicas;
  • Boa comunicação em equipe.


Será um diferencial se você tiver conhecimento em:

  • Projetos práticos com frameworks de Deep Learning (ex.: PyTorch ou TensorFlow);
  • Conhecimento básico em consumo e construção de APIs REST;
  • Primeiros contatos com MLOps (Docker, MLflow);
  • Participação acadêmica ou profissional em projetos de P&D&I.
  • Autonomia crescente na execução de tarefas com supervisão pontual;
  • Adaptabilidade a mudanças de escopo;
  • Interesse genuíno por inovação e novas tecnologias do ecossistema de IA.


Sua formação deve ser: Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Computação, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Mecatrônica e afins.


Disponibilidade: 40h semanais.

Regime híbrido de trabalho.

Local de trabalho: Florianópolis/SC.

  • Vale alimentação ou vale refeição (você escolhe), no valor de R$31,56 por dia útil de trabalho;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico (sem coparticipação, carência ou mensalidade);

Senior Analyst, Financial Planning & Analysis

Remote, With Occasional Travel

About Diana Health

Diana Health is a network of modern women’s health practices working in partnership with hospitals to reimagine the maternity and women’s healthcare experience. We are restructuring the traditional approach to care to create an experience that is good for patients and good for providers. We do that by combining a tech-enabled, wellness-focused care program that women love with a clinical system that helps us drive continuous quality improvement and ensure work-life balance for our care team. We work with clients across all life stages to empower and support them to live happier, healthier, more fulfilling lives. 

With strong collaborative care teams; passionate administrators and a significant investment in operational support, Diana Health employees are well-supported to bring their very best to the work they love. Come join us!

Role Description

Our FP&A associate will report to our head of FP&A and work with our Finance, Accounting, and Business Development teams to give us insight into where our business is today and where it will be going in the future.  He/she will own the management of our fundamental financial models, both in terms of forecasting future growth and comparing past performance against budgets.

As part of this, he/she will:

  • Own our individual site and corporate-wide financial models, updating them regularly to incorporate actuals and account for changes in our forecast or other updates to our business model
  • Conduct a range of deep-dive analyses into our business operations, identifying bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement
  • Work together with our Corporate Controller on our monthly close process, to ensure that all expenses are properly accounted for and to identify deviations from our budget
  • Preparing reporting packages and materials for presentation to our internal leadership team and board 

Qualifications & Attributes 

  • 3-5 years of experience in FP&A, finance, consulting, banking or transaction services.  
  • Excellent excel skills (and a deep love of building and working with complex excel models)
  • A hypothesis driven problem solver with strong time-management skills and the ability to handle several projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy, with big-picture orientation
  • Capable of interpreting findings, and communicating valuable, useful insights
  • Comfort working in a high-growth, fast based business environment.  Prior start-up experience is a plus.
  • Experience writing computer programs, particularly in python, is a plus.
  • An interest in the evolving role of AI in FP&A processes
  • You are unfazed by the challenges of developing systems and processes from scratch

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation
  • Medical, dental & vision plans, with an HSA/FSA option
  • 401(k)
  • Paid time off
  • Paid parental leave 

Diana Health Culture

  • Having a growth mindset and striving for continuous learning and improvement
  • Positive, can do / how can I help attitude
  • Empathy for our team and our clients
  • Taking ownership and driving to results
  • Being scrappy and resourceful

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities.

We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company.

Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together. AI/ML is significantly transforming how teams come together to plan, track, and deliver work across software and business teams using our products. We are looking for rockstar Machine learning engineers to come help us to further this mission and help make teams more productive leveraging AI across our product portfolio.

Responsibilities

What you'll do

As a Machine Learning engineer, you will work on the development and implementation of the cutting edge machine learning algorithms, training models, collaborating with product, engineering, and analytics teams, to build the AI functionalities into each Atlassian products and services.

Your daily responsibilities will encompass a broad spectrum of tasks such as designing system and model architectures, conducting rigorous experimentation and model evaluations.

You will be responsible for application of AI/ML to various product problems to improve Atlassian products and actively contribute toAtlassian Intelligence features.

Job Description

Job ID: MJ000209

We are building a brand-new, high-impact AI and algorithm team within our core business units. As a Senior Algorithm Engineer, you will lead the design and implementation of next-generation generative AI capabilities, focusing on core areas such as intelligent customer service chatbots, translation agents, and travel-related conversational assistants.

This is a highly autonomous and impactful role. You will not only participate in the definition and development of AI products from scratch, but also directly drive their large-scale application in real-world business scenarios. Your work will directly impact the service experience, problem-solving efficiency, conversion rates, and operating costs for millions of users.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the design, development, and continuous optimization of intelligent customer service chatbot and AI agent systems, covering key scenarios such as pre-sales consultation, itinerary inquiries, order support, after-sales service, and multilingual translation.
  • Build agent architectures for complex business processes, including task planning, tool invocation, memory management, retrieval enhancement, workflow orchestration, multi-turn dialogue management, and anomaly recovery.
  • Design and optimize natural language understanding and generation capabilities for travel and customer service scenarios, including user intent recognition, context modeling, knowledge-based question answering, response generation, and multilingual interactive experiences.
  • Drive the deployment of large-scale models in vertical businesses, exploring methods such as Prompt Engineering, RAG, SFT, and preference optimization to continuously improve answer quality, task completion rate, and user satisfaction.
  • Establish an evaluation system for intelligent customer service and agents, including offline assessment, automated evaluation, manual quality inspection, online A/B testing, and continuous iteration mechanisms.
  • Collaborate closely with product, engineering, data, and operations teams to promote deep integration of AI capabilities with business systems, ensuring that solutions offer high availability, low latency, scalability, and cost-effective production-grade performance.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) of agents in real-world scenarios, including problem resolution rate, human agent referral rate, first-response latency, average processing time, satisfaction, cost, and stability, and continuously optimize these metrics.

Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in algorithm engineering, machine learning, NLP, or related fields, with successful experience deploying AI or machine learning systems in large-scale production environments.
  • Possesses strong practical experience in generative AI/LLM applications, and is familiar with the core technologies and implementation challenges of intelligent customer service, question-answering systems, dialogue systems, or agent-type products.
  • Proficient in Python and familiar with mainstream machine learning/deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Scikit-Learn.
  • Familiar with the key technology stack for large-scale model applications, including prompt design, RAG, vector retrieval, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, tool usage, and multi-turn dialogue management.
  • Possesses solid engineering capabilities, capable of independently driving the entire closed loop from data analysis, modeling experiments, performance evaluation to online deployment and iterative optimization.
  • Possesses excellent business understanding and cross-team collaboration skills, capable of transforming complex AI capabilities into stable, measurable, and sustainably optimizable business results.
  • Bachelor's degree or above, with preference given to candidates with a background in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related quantitative fields.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with customer service chatbots, enterprise knowledge assistants, translation agents, task-oriented dialogue systems, or AI copilots.
  • Experience with multilingual models, cross-language retrieval, machine translation, or internationalization products, especially in complex travel or service scenarios.
  • Familiarity with LangGraph, LangChain, OpenAI/Anthropic/open-source large model ecosystems, or experience in building agent workflows.
  • Experience in model evaluation, AI security, visual governance, policy control, human-machine collaboration, and the design of mechanisms for transferring data to human intervention.
  • Familiarity with vector databases, retrieval systems, Elasticsearch, Milvus, Redis, and other related infrastructure.
  • Experience in OTA, travel, e-commerce, or high-concurrency online service scenarios is preferred.
  • Experience in search, recommendation, or ranking is a plus, but not mandatory.

The Senior Financial Analyst plays a key role in ensuring the accuracy of financial information, enhancing business performance, and supporting the achievement of organizational objectives.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and analyze forecasts, budgets, long-range plans, and financial models to support business performance and strategic decision-making.
  • Prepare, analyze, and present financial reports, business insights, and recommendations to management and key teams.
  • Monitor financial results, evaluate variances and trends, and identify risks and opportunities to improve business performance.
  • Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial planning and reporting processes, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial information.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to provide financial guidance, support strategic initiatives, and influence business decisions.
  • Identify and implement process, reporting, and system improvements to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and financial visibility.

job_description_raw_html:
At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.

Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning.

The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it!

Context

Up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work — and the AI systems that can fix it only matter if they actually run in production, inside real hospitals, on sensitive health data. Building that is the heart of this role.

This is an AI Engineer role: you won't just write models, you'll shape Parallel's core AI architecture, define our machine learning strategy, and embed intelligent systems directly into hospital workflows. You'll work hand in hand with the CTO and the founding team, with very high ownership over everything from agentic LLM workflows to the way AI outputs land in the tools doctors actually use.

Your mission

Design and deploy production-ready AI systems — LLM-powered and agent-based — that automate medical coding and reduce administrative workload in hospitals, owning each feature from prototype to monitoring.

Outcomes

  • Production LLM systems: design and deploy LLM-powered systems that automate medical coding in real clinical environments.
  • Agentic workflows: build and iterate on agent-based workflows tailored to complex clinical operations.
  • Secure data pipelines: work with hospital IT to build secure, scalable data ingestion pipelines that adhere to health-data security standards.
  • Product integration: integrate AI outputs into the apps used by doctors and hospital staff.
  • AI roadmap & full ownership: partner with the CTO to define the AI roadmap, and own the full lifecycle of each AI feature — research, prototyping, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Who you are :

This job is for you if:

  • You have 3+ years working on applied ML/AI problems in production environments — real systems that run, not just POCs.
  • You have strong experience with LLMs and NLP, including prompt engineering and/or fine-tuning.
  • You're proficient in Python or Node.js and have worked with ML libraries (Hugging Face, LangChain, PyTorch, etc.).
  • You have a deep sense of ownership and can move from prototype to product quickly.
  • You're action-oriented and autonomous, and you thrive in a fast-paced startup where you shape the core, not execute tickets.
  • You care about solving user problems over shipping features, and you're comfortable getting close to the product and its users.
  • Bonus: familiarity with backend services (Node.js/TypeScript) and data infrastructure.
  • Bonus: experience working with sensitive or regulated data (healthcare, finance, etc.).

Hiring process

  • Quick chat with Wallerand, our recruiter (30 min)
  • Chat with our CTO, Chris (30 min)
  • AI / technical case study, in person at our Paris office (60 min)
  • Meeting with our CEO, Paul (30 min)

Why should you join us?

  • A rare opportunity: you shape Parallel's core AI architecture and ML strategy from day one, with very high ownership alongside the founders.
  • Real-world impact: your systems directly reduce hospital burnout and free up medical staff to focus on patients, not paperwork.
  • Cutting-edge work that ships: state-of-the-art LLM and agentic systems deployed into real clinical environments — with the engineering rigor (type safety end to end, automated best practices, rapid iteration with tools like Cursor) to make them reliable.
  • Package & perks: competitive salary and meaningful equity, plus our standard benefits (Alan health insurance, Swile meal vouchers, Apple equipment, 50% public-transport coverage).
  • Flexibility: on average one day of remote work per week, and one remote week per year.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

Senior Financial Analyst

Full-Time | Permanent | Hybrid

Location: Toronto, ON


An established and highly regarded national law firm is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to join its Finance and Accounting team in Toronto.


This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced finance professional to join a sophisticated professional services environment in a highly visible role supporting financial analysis, management reporting, financial planning and business decision-making.


Reporting to the Director, Financial Analysis and Business Insights, the successful candidate will play an important role in analysing the firm's financial performance, developing financial models, preparing management reports and providing meaningful insights to support operational and strategic decisions.


The ideal candidate will bring a strong finance and FP&A background, advanced Excel capabilities and experience working with large datasets. They will be comfortable analysing complex financial information, identifying trends, conducting variance analysis and communicating findings to senior stakeholders.


The team is also focused on enhancing its reporting capabilities and improving existing processes through technology. Experience with Power BI and Power Query would be a strong asset, particularly for someone who has been involved in automating reports, developing dashboards or improving data management processes.


Why Join

  • Join a leading Canadian law firm with an established reputation across the legal industry.
  • Work within a collaborative and experienced Finance and Accounting team.
  • Take on a visible role supporting firm-wide financial performance and business decisions.
  • Gain exposure to financial planning, forecasting, operational analysis and management reporting.
  • Contribute to reporting improvements, automation and the development of analytical tools.
  • Work closely with senior management and stakeholders across the business.
  • Opportunity to combine financial expertise with advanced Excel and data analysis capabilities.


Key Responsibilities

Financial Analysis & Management Reporting

  • Lead month-end and quarter-end financial reporting processes, preparing detailed financial packages for senior management.
  • Prepare weekly and monthly management reports, providing meaningful financial commentary and insights.
  • Conduct detailed variance analysis, identifying trends and explaining differences between actual results, budgets and forecasts.
  • Analyse financial performance, costs and expenses to support operational decision-making.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to support business planning and improve overall performance.
  • Present financial findings and analysis to senior stakeholders.


Financial Planning & Modelling

  • Support financial planning, budgeting and forecasting activities across various operational areas.
  • Develop, maintain and enhance financial models and reporting tools.
  • Prepare cash flow forecasts and conduct analysis to support effective cash position management.
  • Consolidate and analyse financial information from multiple sources to identify trends and opportunities.
  • Support strategic planning initiatives through detailed financial and operational analysis.
  • Work with internal stakeholders to understand business drivers, costs and financial performance.


Data Analysis & Reporting Improvements

  • Work with large financial datasets, developing and maintaining analytical tools to support reporting and decision-making.
  • Identify opportunities to improve existing reporting processes, data management and analytical capabilities.
  • Support the development and enhancement of dashboards and reporting tools, including opportunities to transition existing Excel-based reporting into Power BI.
  • Leverage tools such as Power Query to streamline data preparation and automate reporting processes.
  • Collaborate with internal teams on financial system enhancements, implementation testing and process improvements.
  • Contribute to initiatives that improve reporting accuracy, efficiency and the accessibility of financial information.


What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field.
  • CPA, CA or CMA designation.
  • Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in financial analysis, FP&A or a similar finance-focused role.
  • Strong background in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, with the ability to efficiently manage, manipulate and analyse large datasets.
  • Experience developing financial models, management reports and analytical tools.
  • Strong understanding of financial and operational business drivers, with the ability to interpret financial results and provide meaningful insights.
  • Experience working with senior stakeholders and communicating financial information effectively.
  • Power BI and Power Query experience would be considered a strong asset.
  • Familiarity with SQL scripting, Microsoft BI tools such as SSRS, or financial systems such as Aderant would be advantageous.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.

Senior Data Scientist, Recommendations & Personalisation

Amsterdam (Hybrid, 3 Days per Week) | €90,000 - €100,000


This is an exciting opportunity for a Senior Data Scientist to join a growing software company and take ownership of recommendation and personalisation models that directly impact customer outcomes. Working within a small, high-performing data team, you will have end-to-end responsibility for designing, deploying, testing, and optimising machine learning solutions in production.


The Company


They are a fast-growing software business developing intelligent solutions that help customers better understand user behaviour and optimise digital performance. Their products are used by organisations across a wide range of industries, providing actionable insights through advanced data science and machine learning.


Following recent growth, they are investing further in their Data Science function and are looking for an experienced practitioner who can help evolve their recommendation capabilities and influence the future direction of the product.


The Role


As a Senior Data Scientist, you will focus on improving and scaling recommendation systems and classification models that are embedded within core products.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Designing, building, and deploying recommendation engines used in production environments
  • Developing machine learning models focused on personalisation, ranking, and customer behaviour prediction
  • Improving existing multi-classification and recommendation algorithms
  • Taking ownership of the full machine learning lifecycle from experimentation through to production monitoring
  • Designing and analysing A/B tests to measure model performance and business impact
  • Working closely with product and engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable solutions
  • Monitoring model performance and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement
  • Contributing to the growth and technical direction of the Data Science function


Your Skills & Experience


  • Strong commercial experience building recommendation systems, ranking models, or classification models
  • Proven experience deploying machine learning models into production environments
  • Strong expertise in Python and SQL
  • Experience with experimentation frameworks, A/B testing, and statistical modelling
  • Experience owning machine learning projects from design through deployment and monitoring
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms, ideally AWS
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience collaborating closely with engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders
  • Evidence of delivering measurable impact through machine learning solutions


What They Offer


  • Salary of €90,000 - €100,000
  • Hybrid working model with three days per week in their Amsterdam office
  • High level of ownership and autonomy
  • Opportunity to shape recommendation and personalisation capabilities at a growing business
  • Exposure to a variety of machine learning challenges across multiple industries
  • Career progression as the Data Science team expands


How to Apply


Apply today to discuss this Senior Data Scientist opportunity and learn more about the team, product, and long-term growth plans.

Ready for a challenge?

Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online food delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.

Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.

About This Role

Join our Courier Pay Data Science team to help us lead, deliver, and care for our couriers and customers by building high-impact, real-time pricing solutions.

In this role, you will develop algorithmic pay models that balance courier earnings fairness with marketplace efficiency, collaborating across product and engineering teams to deliver world-class dynamic pricing systems.

Location: Manitoba ( Remote)

Reporting to: Lead Data Scientist

These are some of the key ingredients to the role:

  • Design and deploy real-time courier pay and boost algorithms that balance supply with delivery demand.
  • Build constrained optimization and machine learning models to maximize spend efficiency and earnings fairness.
  • Lead causal inference and experimentation frameworks, such as switchback and geo testing, to measure true incremental impact.
  • Partner closely with Product and Tech to translate marketplace goals into scalable, low-latency production services.
  • Monitor live model health, triage performance drift, and establish robust fail-safes for production systems.
  • Mentor team peers through code reviews and technical guidance, fostering collaboration to help everyone succeed.

What will you bring to the table?

  • Proven hands-on experience developing machine learning models, dynamic pricing algorithms, or constrained optimization systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience shipping reliable models into production environments.
  • Practical knowledge of causal inference and marketplace experimentation, including A/B and switchback test designs.
  • Commitment to acting responsibly by designing fair, transparent algorithmic incentives that build courier trust.
  • Collaborative mindset with excellent communication skills, passionate about partnering cross-functionally and helping teammates excel.
  • Enthusiasm for agentic AI development, with a proven ability to leverage AI agents to accelerate data analysis, coding, code reviews, and technical workflows.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice To Have)

  • Real-Time ML Systems: Experience deploying and maintaining models in low-latency, real-time streaming architectures (e.g., sub-second feature retrieval and serving).
  • Domain Experience: Background in on-demand logistics, ride-hailing, food delivery marketplaces, or algorithmic revenue management.
  • Big Data & Cloud Tooling: Familiarity with modern data stack tooling such as Kafka, Google BigQuery, AWS data stores (S3, DynamoDB, Kinesis), or modern ML tracking platforms.
  • Spatial-Temporal Analytics: Hands-on experience working with GPS traces, spatial indexing (e.g., H3, S2), and time-series forecasting at fine geographic grains.

At JET, This Is On The Menu

Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.

Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth and about celebrating every aspect of our JETers. Thanks to them we stay one step ahead of the competition.

Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colorful selves to work every day.

What else is cooking?

Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET morsels.

Are you ready to take your seat? Apply now!

What We Offer

Team Vibes: Thrive in a collaborative culture where your ideas matter.

Tasty Perk: Enjoy a monthly Skip spend allowance – treat yourself!

More Time Off: Generous PTO with a buy and sell program with up to 5 extra days!

Family First: Up to 20 weeks top up for parental leave.

Premium Benefits: Flexible medical & dental insurance for you and your family.

Keep Learning: Access world-class training resources to power your success.

Perks Galore: Exclusive offers from Workperks from hundreds of top brands.

Future Funded: RRSP contributions with diverse investment portfolios.

We’ve Got You: We’ve got you covered. Access paid sick time to care for yourself or your family when life happens & access to our well-being support programs.

Digital Nomads: Family abroad or just want a change of scenery? Enjoy the freedom to work from almost anywhere in the world for 4 weeks a year.

Career Growth: Fuel your personal and professional evolution through our dedicated mentorship, global mobility pathways, and a wellness-first culture rooted in true diversity and inclusion.

Note

All employees will be asked to sign a Consent for Disclosure of Personal Information in order to complete a background check. Job offers will be conditional upon results that the Company determines to be satisfactory.

Prima could be the place for you.

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Excited to make an impact? Here are the details.

What You’ll Do

  • Leverage data to identify risks, opportunities and key pricing drivers, turning complex information into actionable insights that influence strategic decision making;
  • Leverage Machine Learning and advanced analytics to develop risk and pricing models that power real-time insurance pricing for millions of customers;
  • Contribute directly to the company’s growth and long-term success through innovative modelling, experimentation and commercially impactful insights.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong academic background in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering (Maths, Physics and Computer Science specialisations), Data Science, Computer Science or Statistics;
  • Strong quantitative, logical and analytical abilities, a solid foundation in statistics, probability and advanced analytics, and a curious, proactive and innovative mindset focused on solving complex problems;
  • Fluency in English, both spoken and written.

Nice-to-Have

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions, and drive new ideas;
  • Possess a solid foundation in code development and machine learning, ideally in Python;
  • Know how to create, manipulate and analyse large datasets.

€50,000 - €100,000 a year

Why you'll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.

💵Competitive compensation: Benefit from competitive salaries, starting from €50k up to €100k, with clear opportunities to grow as you do.

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year.

🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

Description

About Intermedia

Are you looking for a company where YOUR VOICE is heard? Where can you MAKE A DIFFERENCE? Do you

THRIVE in a FAST-PACED work environment? Do you wake every morning EXCITED to work with GREAT

PEOPLE and create SUCCESS TOGETHER? Then Intermedia is the place for you.

Intermedia has established itself as a leading provider of cloud communications and collaboration tech that allows

companies to connect better. We have a strong track record of growth, profitability, and creating an environment

where everyone matters. Everyone. While we are fast-paced and admittedly a bit intense, we promise that you won’t

be bored. You will find Intermedia is a place where you can indulge your passion for creating and supporting great

cloud technology. What’s more, we always look to promote from within and have many employees who have been

with us 10, 15, and 20+ years!

Culture at Intermedia is built on teamwork and transparency. We hold each other accountable and always have each other’s back!

While primarily remote, this role requires occasional visits to the office in Coimbra or in Aveiro. We plan to open an office in Porto in the future. This approach gives team members the flexibility to work remotely while also coming together in the office for collaboration and teamwork.

About The Role

Intermedia is looking for a Data Scientist to join our AI Data Science team.

In this role, you will develop and apply advanced machine learning, generative AI, and statistical techniques to improve the intelligence, effectiveness, and reliability of Intermedia's digital agents. You will work on challenging problems involving large language models, retrieval, agent behavior, experimentation, evaluation, and optimization to help create digital agents that can understand customer needs, access relevant knowledge, and successfully complete complex tasks.

You will work closely with AI/ML engineers, software engineers, product managers, and other data scientists to take ideas from experimentation through production. You will have significant ownership of data science solutions while helping establish strong practices for measuring and continuously improving the quality of our AI-powered experiences.

What You Will Be Doing

Machine Learning & Agent Intelligence

  • Develop, evaluate, and improve machine learning and generative AI solutions that power Intermedia's Digital Agent Platform.
  • Apply large language models (LLMs), natural language processing, retrieval, and other advanced AI techniques to improve agent understanding and performance.
  • Develop approaches that improve agent reasoning, tool selection, knowledge retrieval, context management, personalization, and task completion.
  • Experiment with model, prompt, retrieval, and agent configuration strategies to identify approaches that deliver the best customer and business outcomes.
  • Evaluate commercial and open-source models and recommend appropriate approaches based on quality, latency, scalability, and cost.

Generative AI & RAG

  • Design, develop, and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions that ground digital agents in relevant enterprise and customer information.
  • Develop and evaluate embeddings, retrieval strategies, ranking approaches, semantic search, and other knowledge-retrieval techniques.
  • Build and refine end-to-end pipelines that combine LLMs with retrieval systems, enterprise knowledge sources, and agent workflows.
  • Develop approaches to improve the relevance, accuracy, and consistency of AI-generated responses.
  • Identify and mitigate issues such as hallucinations, poor retrieval, inappropriate responses, and other failure modes in generative AI applications.

Evaluation & Experimentation

  • Develop rigorous evaluation frameworks for measuring digital agent quality, including accuracy, relevance, task completion, reliability, safety, and customer experience.
  • Design offline and online experiments to compare models, prompts, retrieval strategies, agent configurations, and other AI approaches.
  • Apply statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, segmentation, and other quantitative methods to evaluate AI performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Define appropriate metrics and benchmarks that connect model and agent performance to customer and business outcomes.
  • Analyze production behavior and feedback to identify patterns, failure modes, and opportunities to continuously improve digital agents.
  • Ensure data and model quality through comprehensive testing, validation, and performance evaluation.

Data & Solution Development

  • Gather, preprocess, analyze, and model large volumes of structured and unstructured data from multiple sources.
  • Use Python, SQL, Spark, and other relevant technologies to build scalable analytical and machine learning solutions.
  • Develop features, datasets, and analytical approaches that support model development, experimentation, and evaluation.
  • Partner with data and engineering teams to build and maintain reliable pipelines for model training, evaluation, and production use.
  • Contribute to scalable ML/AI pipelines that support experimentation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure solutions are reproducible, maintainable, and designed to operate effectively at production scale.

Collaboration

  • Partner with Product, AI/ML Engineering, Software Engineering, and other Data Science team members to translate customer and business problems into effective AI solutions.
  • Communicate analytical findings, model performance, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Participate in technical and design reviews and help establish strong practices for AI experimentation, evaluation, and model development.
  • Mentor and support less experienced data scientists and contribute to knowledge sharing across the team.

What You Will Bring To The Role

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Machine Learning, Analytics, or a related quantitative field; Master's degree preferred.
  • 4+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, applied AI, or a related analytical field.
  • Strong experience developing and applying supervised and unsupervised machine learning models to real-world problems.
  • Hands-on experience with generative AI, large language models, NLP, or other modern AI technologies.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and experience with SQL and large-scale data processing technologies.
  • Experience with modern machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, or equivalent technologies.
  • Strong understanding of statistical analysis, experimentation, hypothesis testing, model evaluation, and performance measurement.
  • Experience working with large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently frame ambiguous problems, develop analytical approaches, evaluate alternatives, and deliver actionable solutions.
  • Experience taking machine learning or AI solutions beyond experimentation and contributing to their deployment and operation in production environments.
  • Understanding of model quality, data quality, bias, reliability, and other considerations associated with production AI systems.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to connect technical results to customer and business outcomes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex analytical and AI concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across Data Science, AI/ML Engineering, Software Engineering, Product, and business teams.

Diversity, Inclusion, and Equal Opportunity

We hire, promote, and compensate employees based on their ability to perform their job responsibilities, without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender, marital status, national origin, ancestry, age, citizenship, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by applicable law (collectively referred to in our Code of Conduct as “Protected Classes”). We do not tolerate employment discrimination in the workplace, and we are committed to making reasonable accommodations for identified disabilities or other limitations as required by all applicable laws. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or

Company Description

About Grab and Our Workplace

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Job Description

Get to Know the Team

The Business & Transaction Platform (BTP) Data Science team develops scalable machine learning algorithms and intelligent platforms that power transaction efficiency and platform reliability across Grab. We solve core challenges across prediction, forecasting, classification, and generative AI—building foundational data products that support downstream applications across the Grab ecosystem in Southeast Asia.

Get to Know the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to help construct in-house machine learning platforms and deploying production-grade ML and LLM solutions to solve complex business problems at scale. You will apply cutting-edge technologies to drive real-world impact for millions of consumers and merchant partners.Reporting to the Senior Data Science Manager, this is a full-time individual contributor role based onsite at our One North office in Singapore.Ready to shape intelligent platform systems at regional scale? Join us and apply today.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • Architect Scalable ML Solutions: Design, develop, and benchmark efficient deep learning and machine learning algorithms for large-scale prediction, classification, and forecasting problems.
  • Deploy Production LLMs and Pipelines: Build, fine-tune, and deploy state-of-the-art LLMs and ML pipelines into production platforms in collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Process & Feature Engineering: Analyse massive, multi-modal datasets and build data processing pipelines using distributed computing frameworks.
  • Measure Business Impact: Design and execute offline evaluations and online A/B experiments to validate model accuracy, latency, and business performance metrics.
  • Drive Platform Innovation: Stay at the forefront of machine learning and GenAI research, contributing to technical IP, prototypes, and team best practices.
  • Cross-Functional Integration: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Operations stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable ML features.
  • Leverage AI for Productivity: Utilize GenAI tools and modern development workflows to accelerate code delivery, pipeline testing, and technical documentation.

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • Education & Domain Expertise: A Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Operations Research, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Relevant Track Record: At least 2 years of hands-on industry experience building, deploying, and monitoring machine learning or deep learning models in production environments.
  • Technical & Coding Proficiency: Programming skills in Python and PyTorch, alongside practical experience with SQL and Spark for distributed data processing.
  • End-to-End Pipeline Knowledge: Understanding of data extraction, transformation, and pipeline engineering (ETL) within large-scale data platform architectures.
  • LLM & Deep Learning Experience: Hands-on experience developing or fine-tuning transformer models, NLP architectures, or modern LLM frameworks.
  • Stakeholder & Analytical Translation: Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business and transaction challenges into concrete, measurable ML formulations.
  • Mandatory AI Productivity: Experience engaging with AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, improve workflows, and contribute new ideas.

Qualifications

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • Education & Domain Expertise: A Master's Degree in Computer Science, Operations Research, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Relevant Track Record: At least 2 years of hands-on industry experience building, deploying, and monitoring machine learning or deep learning models in production environments.
  • Technical & Coding Proficiency: Programming skills in Python and PyTorch, alongside practical experience with SQL and Spark for distributed data processing.
  • End-to-End Pipeline Knowledge: Understanding of data extraction, transformation, and pipeline engineering (ETL) within large-scale data platform architectures.
  • LLM & Deep Learning Experience: Hands-on experience developing or fine-tuning transformer models, NLP architectures, or modern LLM frameworks.
  • Stakeholder & Analytical Translation: Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business and transaction challenges into concrete, measurable ML formulations.
  • Mandatory AI Productivity: Experience engaging with AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, improve workflows, and contribute new ideas.

Additional Information

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
  • Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
  • Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

The Engineering & Data team builds innovative tech products and platforms to support the growth of their gaming and consumer apps which allow Voodoo to stay at the forefront of the mobile industry. The team plays a key role in Voodoo’s long-term strategy by accelerating product diversification and providing a state of the art growth-engine to distribute and scale our games.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who thrives on transforming data into actionable insights, supporting strategic decisions, and collaborating closely with stakeholders to fuel growth. By joining this team, you will directly shape Voodoo’s marketing and monetization strategies, helping our apps reach and engage hundreds of millions of users worldwide.

Role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Engineering & Data team.

The objective of this team is to accelerate the growth of the company by serving as the on-demand prediction provider for all Voodoo BUs. This involves addressing critical needs such as predicting campaign LTV for User Acquisition optimization, determining optimal monetization offers for millions of players or constructing confidence intervals for time series data prediction.

We want to onboard a passionate data analyst with significant experience in a similar environment to allow us to go one step further. This is an opportunity to have a strategic and critical impact on Voodoo’s success.

This position is hybrid and requires 3 days per week in the office based in Paris.

  • Design, build and monitor data models & dashboards to track business metrics
  • Work with cross-functional teams to identify key business needs and solve them using adequate statistical models
  • Thoroughly document your results and offer onboarding and continuous training to help teams effectively utilize data and insights.
  • Establish data quality processes to ensure the reliability and accuracy of our machine learning models.
  • Promote data literacy within the organization and serve as the primary point of contact for all data-related inquiries and support.
  • Demonstrate excellent communication skills to efficiently manage senior stakeholders within a fast-paced scale-up environment.
  • Work closely with the central data team to source additional data and enhance data management practices

Profile

  • At least 4 years' experience in Data Analysis
  • Proficient with SQL and/or Python, with a proven experience working with large and complex data sets.
  • Autonomous person with a strong analytical mindset, problem-solving skills and strong attention to detail.
  • Experience with statistical modeling & predictive analytics
  • Excellent verbal & written communication abilities
  • Experience building dashboards with Tableau.
  • Experience in gaming industry or mobile marketing is a plus
  • Any personal or professional experience with machine learning will be valued

Our Stack

SQL; Python; DBT; AWS; Tableau

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Swile Lunch voucher
  • Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)
  • Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family
  • Wellness activities in our Paris office
  • Remote Fridays

Official Internal Title: Data Specialist

About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Singapore, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

Who Thrives Here?

We hire sprinters, not coasters—people who:

  • Choose growth over comfort
  • Lead through challenges
  • Are energized by high expectations

It’s not for everyone, and that’s intentional. If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

About The Role

You’ll join one of our sector teams, covering industries such as consumer goods, software, or financial services. These teams build and maintain the analytical data products our clients rely on to understand companies and markets.

As a Data Analyst (Internal Official Title: Data Specialist), you’ll learn how to turn large, complex datasets into accurate and useful insights. You’ll help maintain recurring analyses, investigate changes in the data, and improve the workflows behind our products.

You’ll work closely with a Data Lead and experienced teammates to learn our datasets, methodologies, and quality standards. You’ll begin by owning specific analyses and recurring tasks, with support and feedback as you build confidence. Over time, you’ll take on broader responsibility for products and workflows.

This role is well suited to someone early in their analytics career who enjoys solving problems, pays close attention to detail, and wants to understand how data informs investment decisions. You don’t need to arrive with deep knowledge of financial markets or alternative data—we’re looking for a strong analytical foundation, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.

What You’ll Do:

  • Help deliver accurate, reliable data products. Run and maintain recurring analyses, complete quality checks, and investigate unexpected results. Build toward ownership of defined products and workflows as your expertise grows.
  • Work with large datasets to answer client questions. Use SQL and Python to explore data, identify trends, and understand what the results tell us about the companies and industries we cover.
  • Investigate data problems. Work with teammates to trace discrepancies, test assumptions, and evaluate possible explanations. Learn when to investigate further and when to ask for guidance.
  • Use AI and automation to improve your work. Identify repetitive tasks, contribute to reusable workflows, and learn to use AI tools effectively while validating their outputs.
  • Collaborate across teams. Partner with Research, Engineering, Product, and other teams to resolve issues and deliver high-quality products. Communicate your findings clearly and document your work so others can build on it.
  • Suggest improvements. Bring questions and ideas that help the team strengthen quality checks, improve documentation, refine a methodology, or simplify a process.

Over your first year, you might:

  • Take responsibility for a recurring analytical workflow, including quality checks and delivery.
  • Investigate a change in a dataset and help determine whether it reflects a business trend or a data issue.
  • Evaluate a new alternative dataset with support from an experienced teammate.
  • Build a reusable script or AI-assisted workflow that reduces manual work.
  • Contribute an analysis or visualization to a new research product or client dashboard.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You’re early in your analytics career, typically with 1-3 years of relevant professional experience. We welcome recent graduates and career changers who can demonstrate their skills through internships, academic research, work experience, or substantive projects.
  • You have a working foundation in SQL and can use it to join, aggregate, and explore data. You have some experience using Python for data analysis and are interested in building more reliable, reusable workflows. Familiarity with PySpark is a plus.
  • You enjoy working through analytical questions and care about accuracy. You can explain your approach, test assumptions, and check your results. You notice inconsistencies and follow through to understand what caused them.
  • You’re eager to learn unfamiliar datasets and industries. You ask thoughtful questions and use feedback to improve your work.
  • You follow through on your responsibilities. You keep teammates informed, flag obstacles early, and ask for help when needed.
  • You communicate clearly. You can explain findings and uncertainties to others and are willing to develop your ability to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • You are curious about industries, competitive dynamics, and the factors that drive company performance.
  • You’re interested in AI tools and willing to experiment with them while checking their work carefully.

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits. The annual base compensation for this position is anticipated to be from SGD 72,000 to SGD 96,000. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal team benchmarks.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities.
  • We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, parental leave, team events, a wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary Facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Working at Moffitt is both a career and a mission: to contribute to the prevention and cure of cancer.

As the only National Cancer Institute-designated Comprehensive Cancer Center based in Florida, Moffitt employs some of the best and brightest minds from around the world. Join a dedicated team of nearly 11,000 who are shaping the future we envision. Moffitt has been recognized as a Best and Brightest Company to Work For in the Nation and is continually named one of the Tampa Bay Times’ Top Workplaces.

Summary

The Data Scientist III (DS) will work directly with key stakeholders throughout Moffitt to document data-related needs and identify novel approaches, including advanced data science and analytics techniques, for addressing those needs. The DS will incorporate these novel approaches into the larger Health Data Services and Digital Innovation strategies. The DS will liaise directly with both clinical and research faculty whose work is focused on genomics, radiomics, immuno-oncology, evolutionary therapy, patient-reported outcomes, and other areas to ensure Moffitt’s analytics methods are best positioned to accelerate discovery using Moffitt’s vast data assets.

Optimizing the use of Moffitt’s data assets requires careful considerations of data formatting, lineage, quality, linkages, and visualizations. As Moffitt continues to incorporate new data types into its cloud-based analytics platform, modern strategies for data provenance, ingestion, linkage, and dissemination will become even more critical for the ultimate realization of the value of these data across the Center. Innovative data types include, but are not limited to, medical record text, radiology and pathology images, molecular data, and patient-generated data (wearables).

The DS will implement Moffitt’s data and analytics strategy through the creation of predictive models and algorithms, manipulation of datasets to identify trends and extract meaningful knowledge, development of data mining solutions using natural language processing and machine learning to extract structured data, and more. Such work will not only have an immediate and high impact on clinical use cases, such as tumor boards, but also on cutting-edge research such as automation of tumor segmentation.

The Ideal Candidate Will Have

  • PhD or Master's degree in Biostatistics, Epidemiology, Statistics, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Advanced expertise in statistical modeling, survival analysis, predictive analytics, machine learning, and analysis of large clinical or registry datasets.
  • Advanced proficiency in R programming and experience using Python, SQL, and modern data visualization tools.
  • Experience leading complex analyses for peer-reviewed publications, scientific abstracts, and presentations.
  • Experience serving as a scientific collaborator with investigators and multidisciplinary research teams.
  • Experience supporting competitive grant applications through development of statistical analysis plans, study design, sample size calculations, methodology sections, tables, figures, and interpretation of results.
  • Demonstrated experience contributing to or leading manuscript preparation for publication in peer-reviewed journals.
  • Experience working with large multi-institutional, registry-based, or real-world healthcare datasets.

Hiring Requirements

  • Minimum Education Level: Bachelor's Degree in data science, mathematics, statistics, computer science, or related quantitative field
  • Preferred Education Level: Master's Degree
  • Minimum Experience Required: Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field and more than 5 years of experience in quantitative analytics and applied data science OR Master’s or Doctorate degree in a quantitative field and more than 3 years of experience in quantitative analytics and applied data science.
  • Training Required: Strong programming skills in development of AI/ML, Natural Language Processing (NLP) and statistical modeling applications
  • Strong proficiency programming in R, Python, or adjacent languages
  • Experience writing SQL queries, mining large datasets (pandas/dplyr), and using data visualization tools (matplotlib/ggplot2/plotly)

Job Title: Data Analyst – Power BI & Microsoft Fabric

Location: Birmingham

Salary: £50,000 + Benefits

Contract: Permanent | Full-Time


About the Role:


We’re recruiting on behalf of a well-established professional services organisation seeking an experienced Data Analyst to join its Information Systems team in Birmingham.


This is an opportunity for a data professional who enjoys turning complex information into meaningful insights that support business decisions.


You’ll play a key role in developing and improving reporting capabilities across the organisation, creating engaging Power BI dashboards, improving data accuracy and supporting the transition of existing reporting processes into Microsoft Fabric.


Working closely with stakeholders across different business functions, you’ll help shape how data is accessed, understood and used, encouraging greater self-service reporting and identifying opportunities to improve existing processes.


This role would suit someone who combines strong technical reporting skills with commercial awareness, enjoys solving problems and is confident challenging existing approaches to deliver more effective data solutions.


Key Responsibilities:


• Design, develop and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards that provide meaningful insights into business performance

• Support the consolidation and migration of existing reports and reporting processes into Microsoft Fabric

• Work closely with stakeholders across the organisation to understand reporting requirements and translate these into effective solutions

• Challenge existing reporting methods and encourage greater adoption of self-service reporting

• Take a proactive approach to identifying opportunities to improve business reporting and analytical capabilities

• Monitor and review reporting metrics to ensure they remain aligned with business processes and objectives

• Perform data profiling and analysis to identify anomalies, inconsistencies and opportunities for improvement

• Ensure the accuracy, completeness and reliability of data used across reporting platforms

• Support the development of streamlined, consistent reporting processes across the organisation

• Communicate complex data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Collaborate with wider technology and business teams to support ongoing reporting improvements


Candidate Profile:


• Proven experience in a Data Analyst, Reporting Analyst, BI Analyst or similar position

• Strong experience developing reports and interactive dashboards using Microsoft Power BI

• Good working knowledge of SQL and relational databases

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, with the ability to analyse and interpret complex datasets

• Experience working with business performance metrics, KPIs and management reporting

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail

• Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into practical reporting solutions

• Confident communicating data insights to stakeholders at different levels of an organisation

• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

• Proactive, self-motivated and comfortable taking ownership of reporting requirements

• Collaborative approach with the ability to build effective relationships across different departments


Experience with Microsoft Fabric, reporting migrations or developing self-service business intelligence solutions would be particularly advantageous.


Previous experience within professional services or another complex business environment would also be beneficial.


We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and are committed to inclusive and fair recruitment practices.


What Our Client Offers:


• Competitive salary and benefits package

• Permanent, full-time position based in Birmingham

• Opportunity to support the development of modern reporting and business intelligence capabilities

• Exposure to Microsoft Fabric and evolving data technologies

• Opportunity to work with stakeholders across multiple business functions

• Collaborative working environment within an established Information Systems team

• Scope to contribute ideas, challenge existing processes and influence how reporting is delivered across the organisation

• Opportunities for ongoing professional development


How to Apply:


If you’re an experienced Data Analyst with strong Power BI and SQL skills who enjoys using data to improve business performance, we’d love to hear from you.


About Us:


We are a recruitment agency specialising in mid to senior-level roles. Our expertise and industry knowledge allow us to connect talented professionals with outstanding career opportunities, supporting both clients and candidates in achieving their long-term success.

| QUI SOMMES-NOUS ?


TMC est une société internationale de conseil en haute technologie qui apporte son expertise à ses clients afin de les aider à relever leurs défis. Depuis 25 ans, avec une présence mondiale dans 16 pays, nous avons bâti une réputation d'excellence et de fiabilité grâce à l'Employeneurship dans divers domaines : Technology & Engineering/ Energy & Renewables/ Life sciences & Pharma/ Digital & IT.


| VOTRE CHALLENGE ?


Dans le cadre de la modernisation de son environnement Data, TMC recherche un Data Analyst spécialisé en SQL, PL/SQL et Power BI.

Vous intégrerez une équipe dédiée à l'exploitation, l'analyse et la transformation des données issues de bases Oracle et d'environnements Cloud. Vous interviendrez sur la compréhension des traitements existants, la fiabilisation des données et la production d'indicateurs et de tableaux de bord à destination des équipes métiers.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement technique comprenant Oracle, Databricks et Power BI, avec une possible intervention sur des outils ETL tels qu'Informatica.


Missions principales:


  • Analyser et exploiter les données issues des bases Oracle et de Databricks.
  • Développer, maintenir et optimiser des requêtes SQL et PL/SQL.
  • Analyser les flux de données et comprendre les traitements existants.
  • Contrôler la qualité, la cohérence et la fiabilité des données.
  • Concevoir, développer et faire évoluer des rapports et tableaux de bord Power BI.
  • Utiliser Power Query et DAX pour la préparation et l'analyse des données.
  • Définir et suivre des indicateurs de performance (KPI) avec les équipes métiers.
  • Identifier les anomalies et contribuer à leur résolution avec les équipes techniques.
  • Participer à la migration des données et des traitements vers des environnements Cloud.
  • Assurer la documentation des sources, des flux de données et des règles de gestion.


| QU'ATTENDONS-NOUS DE VOUS ?


  • Formation Bac+3 à Bac+5 en informatique, Data ou systèmes d'information.
  • Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en Data Analysis ou Business Intelligence.
  • Maîtrise indispensable de SQL, PL/SQL et Power BI.
  • Bonne connaissance d'Oracle, Power Query et DAX.
  • Expérience avec Databricks SQL ou un environnement Cloud équivalent.
  • Capacité à analyser des flux de données et à contrôler leur qualité.
  • La connaissance d'Informatica, Spark/PySpark et des environnements Azure, AWS ou GCP est un plus.

Qualités attendues:

  • Esprit d'analyse et rigueur.
  • Autonomie et sens de l'organisation.
  • Bon relationnel et capacité à échanger avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques.
  • Esprit d'équipe et capacité de synthèse.
  • Sens de la qualité et de la fiabilité des données.



| QU'EST CE-QUE L'EMPLOYENEURSHIP ?


Il s'articule autour de 5 piliers principaux :

  • Bénéficiez un contrat de travail permanent, offrant stabilité et sécurité ;
  • Une transparence totale, c'est connaître sa valeur financière et bénéficier individuellement d'une part des profits générés ;
  • Être soutenu par un coaching individuel conçue pour développer ses compétences entrepreneuriales ;
  • La structure des cellules de compétence permettant de disposer d'un réseau solide, significatif et pertinent ;
  • Le laboratoire entrepreneurial : un terrain de jeu pour les nouvelles idées et un lieu de lancement potentiel pour les start-ups.

We are Walker & Dunlop. We are committed to creating meaningful social, environmental, and economic change in our communities.

Department Overview

WDTech is W&D’s in-house technology team – a group of collaborative and highly skilled technology professionals, all of whom are leading experts in real estate data, data science, and technology.

WDTech Engineering builds solutions that impact not only our products but also the people and processes across our organization. A commitment to innovation and a passion for disrupting the old-fashioned real estate industry are our highest priorities.

The Impact You Will Have

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in delivering trusted data insights and analytics that support business and product decision-making across the organization. This role is responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing reporting solutions and dashboards, and translating data into actionable insights that improve operational effectiveness and support strategic initiatives.

Working closely with Data Analysts, BI Analysts, Data Engineers, Data QA Engineers, Data Scientists, and Product Managers, you will help ensure data products are accurate, scalable, and aligned with evolving business needs as Walker & Dunlop continues to grow as a data-driven organization.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Analyze and curate data sources to support business and product stakeholders in making informed decisions.
  • Lead key components of the analytical lifecycle, including data exploration, analysis, reporting, and insight delivery.
  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions.
  • Perform data wrangling, transformation, and analysis using SQL and enterprise analytical databases.
  • Define and document datasets, business logic, and reporting definitions to support consistent data usage.
  • Partner with data and product teams to support data governance, data quality, and data management processes.
  • Analyze user engagement, operational, and product data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
  • Mentor junior analysts and promote best practices in analytics, visualization, and stakeholder collaboration.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, preferably in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics roles with demonstrated ownership of end-to-end analytical projects.
  • Strong experience working with enterprise analytical databases such as Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or similar technologies.
  • Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization tools.
  • Experience with SQL, data transformation, and analytical reporting workflows.
  • Experience with Python and geospatial analysis preferred.
  • Real estate, financial services, or related industry experience preferred.

  • Deep expertise in SQL and data analysis techniques.
  • Strong proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.

  • Courtesy, respect, and thoughtfulness in teaming with colleagues and other stakeholders
