Vill du vara med och forma framtidens internationella betalningar? Vi söker en Business Analyst som vill arbeta i gränslandet mellan verksamhet och IT och bidra till utvecklingen av några av Handelsbankens mest affärskritiska tjänster inom utlandsbetalningar och SEPA.

Ditt team

Du blir en del av ett team med cirka tio medarbetare bestående av Agile Product Owner, Team Coach, Javautvecklare, testare och andra specialister. Majoriteten av teamet sitter i Malmö och arbetar nära både produktverksamheten och andra utvecklingsteam inom banken.

Teamet ansvarar för lösningar inom utlandsbetalningar och SEPA, områden som är centrala för bankens internationella betalningserbjudande. Området genomgår en omfattande utveckling kopplad till nya regulatoriska krav, förändrade betalningsflöden och införandet av standarder som ISO20022, vilka formar framtidens internationella betalningsinfrastruktur.

Tjänsten tillhör en enhet med drygt 20 medarbetare som ansvarar för utveckling och förvaltning av dessa tjänster. Enheten är en del av en större organisation som hanterar bankens betalningar, konton, kort och bedrägerihantering.

Vi arbetar enligt en agil utvecklingsmodell med nära samarbete mellan verksamhet och IT samt mellan olika team och organisatoriska enheter. Rollen innebär många kontaktytor och ett nära samarbete med såväl interna som externa intressenter.

Din roll

Som Business Analyst har du en central roll i utvecklingen och förvaltningen av bankens lösningar för utlandsbetalningar. Du bidrar med förståelse för hur systemen stödjer produkter, processer och betalningsflöden samt hjälper teamet att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till tydliga och genomförbara lösningar.

Du fungerar som länken mellan verksamhet och IT och bidrar med både helhetsperspektiv och detaljförståelse. Genom att förstå både verksamhetens behov och de tekniska lösningarna bidrar du till att säkerställa att bankens betalningstjänster utvecklas i rätt riktning och möter såväl kundernas som regulatoriska krav.

Du kommer att arbeta i en verksamhet där internationella betalningsflöden, regulatoriska krav och branschstandarder ständigt utvecklas. En viktig del av rollen är att förstå hur förändringar inom exempelvis ISO20022 påverkar produkter, processer och system samt bidra till att omsätta dessa krav till hållbara verksamhets- och IT-lösningar.

Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat att:

  • Analysera och omsätta verksamhetskrav till underlag för utveckling
  • Delta i system-, integrations- och acceptanstester
  • Bidra till förvaltning av system genom arbete med exempelvis SLA, riskanalyser, kontinuitetsplaner och informationsklassning
  • Delta i incidenthantering och uppföljning för teamets system och komponenter
  • Stötta verksamheten i löpande frågor samt bidra till utveckling av produkter, processer och tjänster

Rollen ger dig möjlighet att bygga djup specialistkompetens inom internationella betalningar samtidigt som du får en bred förståelse för bankens verksamhet, IT-landskap och utvecklingsprocesser. Du arbetar nära både verksamhet och utvecklingsteam och får en central roll i att säkerställa att framtidens betalningstjänster möter kundernas behov, regulatoriska krav och bankens höga krav på kvalitet och stabilitet.

Din profil

Vi söker dig som trivs i gränslandet mellan verksamhet och IT och som motiveras av att förstå komplexa flöden, skapa struktur och driva förbättringar. Du har lätt för att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till konkreta krav och tycker om att samarbeta med olika intressenter för att nå gemensamma mål.

Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av:

  • Business Analysis, kravanalys eller liknande roll
  • Att omsätta verksamhetskrav till underlag för IT-utveckling
  • Arbete i gränslandet mellan verksamhet och IT
  • Betalningsområdet, exempelvis utlandsbetalningar eller SEPA
  • Större organisationer med etablerade processer och styrmodeller
  • Relevant högskole- eller universitetsutbildning, alternativt motsvarande erfarenhet

Det är ett plus om du även har erfarenhet av:

  • Internationella betalningsstandarder såsom ISO20022
  • API:er och integrationslösningar
  • Systemförvaltning och incidenthantering

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du arbetar strukturerat och har förmåga att planera, organisera och driva ditt arbete framåt. Du trivs med att sätta dig in i komplexa sammanhang och har förmågan att växla mellan detaljer och helhetsperspektiv. När nya frågeställningar uppstår är du nyfiken, initiativtagande och fokuserad på att hitta lösningar som skapar långsiktigt värde.

Du är också samarbetsorienterad och bidrar till ett prestigelöst arbetsklimat där olika perspektiv tas tillvara. Med en god kommunikativ förmåga kan du anpassa ditt budskap till olika målgrupper och förklara komplexa frågeställningar på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt. Du trivs med att bygga relationer och samarbeta med produktägare, utvecklare, testare, verksamhetsspecialister och externa intressenter för att skapa lösningar som fungerar i praktiken.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Som ett steg i Handelsbankens rekryteringsprocess krävs en godkänd bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat, utförd av en extern part, innan anställning kan ske.

Handelsbanken är en del av Sveriges totalförsvar och som bank fyller vi en samhällsviktig funktion tillsammans med den finansiella sektorn. Rollen kan därför komma att omfattas av krigsplacering inom Handelsbanken.

  • Agir à titre de partenaire d'affaires financier auprès des opérations et de la direction, en développant des relations de confiance avec les gestionnaires et en soutenant la prise de décision par des recommandations financières pertinentes.

  • Détenir un baccalauréat en comptabilité, en finance ou dans un domaine connexe. Détenir le titre de CPA ou être en voie de l'obtenir (atout)

  • Faire preuve d'un fort esprit analytique, de rigueur et d'une grande curiosité d'affaires
  • Posséder d'excellentes habiletés de collaboration, être orienté vers les résultats, autonome et capable de gérer efficacement les priorités
  • Avoir participé à des projets d'amélioration continue
  • Maîtriser le français et l'anglais, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit, afin de communiquer efficacement avec nos partenaires au Canada et aux États-Unis

Et si en plus tu mets autant de cœur dans ton savoir-être que dans ton savoir-faire, on a hâte de te rencontrer!

Postule dès maintenant et rejoins notre équipe de Cascadeurs et Cascadeuses au poste d'Analyste financier(ère) senior(e) à Saint-Hubert.

À titre d’Analyste principal(e), Planification et analyse financières, carburant, vous produirez des analyses financières, des rapports et des modèles qui appuieront les décisions relatives à la vente au détail de carburant, aux activités interentreprises (B2B), aux véhicules électriques et aux activités commerciales connexes. Vous participerez à la préparation des budgets et des prévisions, à l’analyse des résultats et à l’évaluation de projets afin d’aider les équipes à prendre des décisions éclairées.

Relevant du gestionnaire principal, finance du carburant, vous fournirez des analyses financières fiables, améliorerez les rapports et contribuerez au développement des outils de planification et de suivi du rendement dans l’ensemble de l’entreprise.

VOS RESPONSABILITÉS

Voici les principales responsabilités du poste :

  • Préparer et analyser les rapports financiers relatifs à la vente au détail de carburant, aux activités interentreprises (B2B), aux véhicules électriques et aux activités commerciales connexes.
  • Participer à la préparation des budgets et des prévisions ainsi qu’à l’analyse des résultats mensuels, en veillant à l’exhaustivité et à l’exactitude des données.
  • Analyser la rentabilité des activités liées au carburant et expliquer les facteurs qui influencent les résultats.
  • Analyser les écarts et présenter les principales tendances, les risques et les possibilités d’amélioration.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes des finances, des activités commerciales et des opérations pour recueillir les données, valider les hypothèses et remettre en question les résultats, au besoin.
  • Contribuer à l’uniformisation des indicateurs clés, des facteurs de rendement et des méthodes de production de rapports entre les secteurs et les régions.
  • Élaborer des modèles financiers, évaluer des projets et réaliser des analyses de scénarios pour appuyer les décisions commerciales et opérationnelles.
  • Contribuer à l’élaboration et à la mise à jour des modèles de prévision, de planification et de suivi du rendement.
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue, notamment à l’automatisation des rapports, à l’optimisation des processus et à l’adoption de nouveaux outils d’analyse.
  • Collaborer avec les centres d’excellence et les équipes de données pour intégrer les facteurs de rendement des magasins, des canaux de vente et des activités commerciales aux modèles de planification et aux tableaux de bord.
  • Réaliser des analyses financières ponctuelles et contribuer aux projets et aux demandes de la direction.

CONTRIBUTION STRATÉGIQUE

Fournir des analyses et des rapports financiers fiables qui appuient les décisions commerciales, le contrôle financier et la création de valeur à long terme dans les activités liées au carburant et les activités connexes.

Voici le profil recherché :

Formation :

  • Baccalauréat en finance, en comptabilité, en économie, en administration des affaires ou dans une discipline connexe.
  • Un titre comptable professionnel (ACA, ACCA, CIMA ou équivalent), ou des démarches en cours pour l’obtenir, constitue un atout.

Expérience :

  • De 2 à 3 ans d’expérience en planification et analyse financières (FP&A), en finance des activités commerciales, en analyse financière, en comptabilité ou dans une fonction connexe.
  • Expérience des processus de budgétisation, de prévision et de production de rapports sur le rendement.
  • Expérience de l’analyse de grands ensembles de données et capacité à dégager des constats utiles à la prise de décision.
  • Une expérience dans la vente au détail de carburant, le commerce de proximité, les activités interentreprises (B2B), les véhicules électriques, la logistique ou la chaîne d’approvisionnement constitue un atout.

Connaissances et compétences :

  • Excellentes aptitudes d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec un grand souci du détail.
  • Maîtrise d’Excel, notamment pour la modélisation financière et l’analyse de données.
  • Bonne compréhension de la budgétisation, des prévisions, de l’analyse des écarts et des rapports de gestion.
  • Capacité d’interpréter des données complexes et de communiquer clairement les résultats à des collègues des finances et d’autres secteurs.
  • Excellentes aptitudes à communiquer à l’oral et à l’écrit.
  • Capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités et de respecter les échéances dans un environnement dynamique.

Qualités professionnelles

  • Curiosité, sens des affaires et approche proactive de la résolution de problèmes.
  • Sens de l’organisation, méthode et souci du détail.
  • Aisance dans les situations ambiguës et capacité de s’adapter à l’évolution des besoins de l’entreprise.
  • Esprit d’équipe et aptitude à établir de solides relations entre les services.
  • Souci de simplifier les processus et d’améliorer les rapports.
  • Désir d’apprendre et de développer ses compétences en finance et en partenariat d’affaires.

Bilinguisme requis (français et anglais de niveau avancé), à l’oral et à l’écrit. La personne devra régulièrement travailler et communiquer en anglais dans le cadre de ses fonctions, notamment pour collaborer avec des équipes à l’échelle mondiale.

Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, our Finance teams are important to our business and functional teams to make educated, sound decisions that drive our Mission and make us a stable and trusted industry leader. From Financial Planning & Analysis, Tax, Treasury, Financial Reporting, Audit, Investor Relations, Strategy & Corporate Development to Accounting, our Finance functions have a diverse and global presence, providing significant opportunities to develop outstanding career experiences and perspectives.

Our Commercial and Operations Finance function is responsible for providing oversight and support for our fast-paced, innovative and global sales teams. By leading activities such as strategic planning, budgeting, forecasting, pricing and close exercises, while leveraging analytics, forecasting and reporting skills, you will help shape the commercial success of our business areas for senior leaders and the sales teams. You will develop a robust skill set as part of this fast-paced function by interacting with a broad number of internal business partners and building organizational capabilities to drive profitability & customer satisfaction. The work of this team is dynamic with high-visibility and impact to our diverse customers, providing you an exciting opportunity to gain valuable regional and global experiences and professional growth.

Seeking a Finance Sr. Analyst to be a key member of the Operations Finance team to support senior leaders in data analytics, financial reporting and forecasting processes to help craft the success of the business. This role would suit an individual with a passion for data analytics and a real desire to develop and succeed within a fast paced, innovative global FP&A function!

This role requires on-site presence at our Pittsburgh, PA, Waltham, MA or Rochester, NY locations and does not provide relocation assistance at this time.

Responsibilities

  • Perform analysis of consolidated financial views, build key summary reports for senior management team
  • Primary Finance Partner for Molecular Services business, acting as finance leader for the product line
  • Reviewing monthly revenue, spending details and HC and identify the key factors driving variances to AOP and Forecast
  • Business case support and analysis, including both top line and bottom line initiatives, as well as Capital requests
  • Support preparing annual operating plan and monthly and quarterly business reviews (MBR/QBR)
  • Drive continuous improvement and standardization of reporting and analytical processes to drive productivity and efficiency
  • Leverage Ai to drive scale for financial reporting and analysis on standard activities
  • Perform special projects and ad-hoc financial analysis

Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree plus 3-5 years of experience in financial planning & analysis or related field

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Prior experience within FP&A or Controlling
  • Strong analytical and data gathering skills. Attention to detail and consistently delivering high quality work
  • Ability to balance multiple priorities and tight time demands
  • Excellent skills with MS Excel are required; Oracle, PLN/CMR, SAP are preferred
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong team building skills and the shown ability to work with a diverse group of people even if geographically dispersed
  • Self-motivated, higher level of flexibility and strong work ethic with the goal to get the job done
  • Continuous Improvement approach: Identify process and control gaps and champion improvement initiatives through Practical Process Improvement (PPI)
  • Exhibit leadership, initiative, and the Thermo Fisher Scientific 4-I values of Integrity, Intensity, Innovation, and Involvement.

Compensation And Benefits

The salary range estimated for this position based in Pennsylvania is $93,800.00–$140,675.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

  • A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
  • Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
  • At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
  • Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
  • Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!. 

Job Description

The successful candidate will play a key role in connecting business needs with technology solutions. The position involves analysing business processes, identifying improvement opportunities and applying data-driven insights to support decision-making across the organisation. The role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders, delivery teams and technical specialists.

Responsibilities

  • Engage with stakeholders to gather and document business requirements and objectives.
  • Translate business needs into functional and non-functional requirements, including user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Analyse existing business processes and workflows and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop process maps, use cases and supporting documentation to guide solution design and delivery.
  • Work with technical teams and business stakeholders to maintain alignment on project objectives and deliverables.
  • Support the development of business cases, feasibility assessments and cost-benefit analyses.
  • Support testing activities, including user acceptance testing planning and solution validation.
  • Provide guidance and support on business analysis approaches, tools and standards.
  • Maintain awareness of developments in business analysis, data utilisation and public sector transformation.

Qualifications

Essential Criteria

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Data Science or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrated experience as a Business Analyst on data analytics, digital transformation or technology-enabled projects.
  • Experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
  • Experience producing user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, use cases and functional specifications.
  • Ability to analyse business challenges and translate requirements into practical solutions.
  • Experience communicating effectively with stakeholders at different organisational levels.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes.
  • Experience working independently and within multidisciplinary teams.
  • Experience using DevOps tools and practices.
  • Experience working with Power BI.
  • Experience supporting Agile, Scrum or similar delivery methodologies.

Desirable Criteria

  • Agile or Scrum certification.
  • Master's degree in a relevant discipline.
  • Experience supporting public sector organisations.
  • Experience working on multi-agency or cross-department programmes.
  • Knowledge of housing-related datasets, reporting requirements or government programmes.
  • Experience contributing to data analytics initiatives and reporting projects.

Additional Information

Why Version 1? 

 At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability. 

  • Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits 
  • Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme 
  • Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance 
  • Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme 
  • Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies 
  • Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat 
  • Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & Star Awards.
  • Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes. 

And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

OBJECTIVES/PURPOSE OF JOB

Financial Planning and Analysis

Key Activities/Responsibilities

 Business Partnering & Commercial Support

  • Partner closely with business stakeholders by providing financial analysis, insights, and performance reporting to monitor results against budgets, forecasts, and business objectives.
  • Support key commercial activities, including pricing setup, marketing schemes, monitoring pricing exceptions, and tracking and controlling trade promotions and marketing investments.
  • Review and evaluate promotional activities and customer deals, analyzing actual performance against approved business cases and forecasts.
  • Provide financial guidance and recommendations to support business decision-making and profitability improvement.

Financial Planning, Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare and deliver monthly management reporting, financial analysis, forecasts, annual operating plans, and strategic plans.
  • Support the preparation and consolidation of quarterly forecasts, annual budgets, and long-term strategic planning exercises.
  • Perform variance analysis and provide actionable insights on business performance, key trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Respond to ad hoc financial analysis and reporting requests from the Country Manager, business units, and Regional/Global headquarters.
  • Participate in month-end closing activities, ensuring accurate accounting treatment of revenue recognition, deferred revenue, and other key financial transactions.

Operational & Process Support

  • Support statutory audits, tax filings, and related schedules by coordinating with internal and external stakeholders and resolving audit queries in a timely manner.
  • Proactively identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and control environment of finance processes and procedures.
  • Assist in strengthening financial controls and ensuring compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Support the Finance Director on special projects, business initiatives, and other ad hoc assignments as required.

Qualifications/Training

(e.g. professional qualfications, on-the-job training)

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail and the ability to translate complex financial data into actionable business insights.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to effectively partner with cross-functional teams and influence decision-making.

  • Fast learner with strong organizational and time management skills, able to prioritize multiple tasks and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.

Job Summary

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE ROLE

The Sr. Financial Analyst will be a key member of the Latin America finance team who will take ownership of various responsibilities related to the division’s forecasting and budgeting process. The analyst will collaborate closely with the Finance Manager to consolidate and analyze monthly forecasts, while providing strategic analysis across various business segments. They will work on the implementation of business intelligence tools, leading the way automated financial reporting and advanced metrics analysis. In addition, they will be an integral part of the onboarding on new entities to be compliant with Live Nation policies and procedures.

What This Role Will Do

  • Build and maintain financial models used for both reporting requirements and strategic analysis, with a focus on the rollout of OneStream.
  • Analyze and interpret monthly and quarterly financial results, assisting Finance Manager with financial presentations.
  • Build out and implement executive dashboards utilizing business intelligence tools (including OneStream dashboards) to provide key stakeholders with KPI’s & insights, with drill-down capabilities as needed.
  • Work alongside divisional accounting team to ensure compliance with company & regulatory policies, data integrity, accuracy of variance explanations and adjustments, and alignment on deliverables related to forecasts.
  • Provide timely, accurate, and meaningful financial analysis of variances between actuals and forecast, budget, and prior year.
  • Perform departmental audits of key processes across business lines, while documenting evidence of reviews and key issues affecting the business
  • Assist with due diligence of new JV partners/business units by participating in walkthroughs of new processes, identifying opportunities for seamless data integration, and understanding key drivers for new businesses.
  • Ad-hoc requests as required depending on business needs, including financial information for CFO presentations.

What This Person Will Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance or accounting is required.
  • Knowledge of Finance/Accounting/GAAP principles and strong business acumen.
  • Fluency in English and Spanish is required.
  • Must be flexible with hours to accommodate workload fluctuations.
  • Familiarity with business intelligence tools and implementation of forecasting software.
  • Strong interpersonal skills required to work alongside individual business units and effectively communicate business results to various audiences.
  • Advanced financial modeling and Excel skills.
  • Software Requirements:
    • Advanced Excel
    • Powerpoint
    • Oracle, SAP, or other ERP systems
    • Power BI
Benefits & Perks

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave and baby bonuses, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support
  • CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment
  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation.

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act and consistent with other similar and / or applicable laws in other areas.

We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, Live Nation will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations related to pregnancy in accordance with applicable local, state and / or federal law. As part of its commitment to make reasonable accommodations, Live Nation also wishes to participate in a timely, good faith, interactive process with a disabled applicant to determine effective reasonable accommodations, if any, which can be made in response to a request for accommodations. Applicants are invited to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made to assist them to perform the essential functions of the position they seek. Any applicant who requires an accommodation in order to perform the essential functions of the job should contact a Human Resources Representative to request the opportunity to participate in a timely interactive process. Live Nation will also provide reasonable religious accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

HIRING PRACTICES

It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to support banking transformation initiatives. The role will work closely with business stakeholders and technology teams to gather requirements, analyze processes, and drive solution delivery across key banking domains.

Українська ІТ-компанія UNITY-BARS запрошує талановитого, проактивного, орієнтованого на результат бізнес-аналітика із сильними комунікативними навиками та вміннямпрацювати із зовнішнім замовником в умовах багатозадачності та швидкозмінюваному середовищі. 


Рівень: strong junior - middle 


Необхідні навички та знання: 

  • розуміння роботи в командах розробки ПЗ на позиції бізнес-аналітика або системного аналітика; 
  • розуміння роботи на проєктах із зовнішнім замовником в фінансовій сфері; 
  • розуміння етапів розробки ПЗ та ролі БА в кожному етапі; 
  • розуміння процесу трансформації функціональних та нефункціональних вимог замовника в деталізовані вимоги та задачі для розробників; 
  • навики швидкого самостійного пошуку та використання інформації; 
  • розуміння використання в роботі Jira, Confluencе; 
  • досвід складання технічного завдання, діаграм бізнес-процесів. 


Бажано: 

  • верхньорівневе розуміння клієнт-серверної архітектури; 
  • розуміння ключових процесів UX/UI; 
  • знання основ бухгалтерського обліку в банківських установах; 
  • знання SQL, PL/SQL; 
  • досвід використання BPMN, UML. 


Обов’язки: 

  • збір та уточнення вимог замовника; 
  • формалізація та деталізація вимог, постановка задач розробникам; 
  • підготовка детального технічного завдання та супутньої документації по проекту; 
  • постійна комунікація та взаємодія з замовниками та командою розробки; 
  • пост-релізна підтримка.


Пропонуємо:

  • офіційне працевлаштування; 
  • змішаний графік роботи; 
  • медичне страхування; 
  • корпоративні курси англійської мови; 
  • комфортні умови роботи у сучасному офісі в дружній команді кваліфікованих спеціалістів; 
  • можливість постійного навчання та розвитку.

job_description_raw_html:
💡 Oventi est un cabinet de conseil en Data et IA qui propulse la performance des entreprises. En unissant une maîtrise technique de pointe et une vision stratégique ancrée dans les enjeux métier, nous transformons les données en leviers de croissance concrets.


Issues des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs et de commerce, nos équipes conçoivent des architectures et produits complexes. Entre notre LAB interne, véritable incubateur d'innovation, et notre accompagnement au cœur des organisations, nous convertissons la recherche appliquée en solutions sur mesure et immédiatement opérationnelles.


🧑 💻 Pourquoi ce rôle est clé ?


Intégré(e) à la Squad Assortiment, vous êtes un pilier central du développement des briques analytiques au cœur du moteur de recommandation. Votre rôle est de concevoir des solutions data sophistiquées pour optimiser les choix stratégiques de produits, garantissant ainsi la performance commerciale et la pertinence de l'offre en magasin.


🎯 Vos missions au quotidien :

Développer les briques analytiques du moteur de recommandation :

  • Clustering & Attributs : Développer des algorithmes de clustering pour grouper les magasins par "ADN" et affiner les enveloppes d'assortiment (TACs).
  • Prévision & Cannibalisation : Modéliser le report de ventes lorsqu'un produit est supprimé de l'assortiment pour sécuriser le chiffre d'affaires global.
  • Optimisation : Participer activement à l'implémentation des solveurs d'optimisation sous contraintes.
  • GenAI (Bonus) : Explorer l'utilisation de l'IA Générative pour enrichir les attributs produits manquants (ex: "Goût sucré", "Texture").

Garantir l'excellence opérationnelle et l'amélioration continue :

  • Analyse et Impact : Évaluer la qualité du code et ses impacts métier, tout en remettant en question les solutions existantes pour les optimiser.
  • Respect des standards : Livrer des solutions performantes dans le respect des délais, tout en maintenant des standards de qualité élevés.
  • Collaboration métier : Assurer une communication fluide (écrite et orale) avec les équipes métier pour traduire les besoins en solutions techniques.

Contribuer à la dynamique collective :

  • Esprit d'équipe : Collaborer efficacement avec les membres de la squad pour atteindre les objectifs communs.
  • Prise de recul : Évaluer les problématiques avec objectivité et proposer des axes d'amélioration structurants pour la plateforme.

🧩 Stack technique :

  • Langages : Python (expert Pandas), SQL
  • Machine Learning : Scikit-learn, Algorithmes de Clustering
  • Spécialités : Prévision de ventes (Timeseries), Optimisation sous contraintes
  • Innovation : NLP, GenAI (LLM pour l'enrichissement d'attributs)

🧩 Vous êtes la personne idéale si :

  • Plus de 7 ans d'expérience en tant que Data Scientist, avec un historique solide de projets mis en production.
  • Diplômé(e) d'un Bac+5 en école d'ingénieur ou équivalent universitaire avec une spécialisation en informatique ou data.
  • Expertise Retail : Une expérience dans le secteur du commerce de détail ou de la grande distribution est un atout majeur.
  • Maîtrise analytique : Excellente capacité de modélisation (Clustering, Timeseries) et appétence pour les sujets d'optimisation.
  • Soft Skills : Excellente communication en français, esprit d'analyse aiguisé, capacité de prise de recul et un goût prononcé pour le travail en équipe.


🌟 Pourquoi rejoindre OVENTI ?

Rejoindre Oventi, c’est choisir une aventure professionnelle unique :

✔️ Une structure à taille humaine : favorisant l’échange, l’autonomie et l’innovation, où votre impact est direct et visible.

✔️ Des programmes à forte valeur ajoutée : secteurs et métiers variés, avec une approche « sur mesure » où nos solutions ont des impacts importants chez nos clients.

✔️ Une culture d’excellence technique : avec un réel accompagnement de carrière et un suivi personnalisé.

✔️ Une équipe passionnée et engagée : des ingénieurs des plus grandes écoles recrutés avec soin, formés en continu, et investis sur le long terme.

✔️ L’agilité d’une startup, la rigueur d’un cabinet expert : le meilleur des deux mondes pour une expérience enrichissante.

✔️ Des programmes à impact, visibles et valorisants : où vous aurez un impact réel sur les décisions métiers et la valeur business générée.


📍 Localisation : Paris 2 (75) avec télétravail

💶 Rémunération : selon profil

🗓️ Démarrage : ASAP

WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON​

Gameloft Barcelona is seeking a Data Scientist to join Gameloft Global Data team.

As a Data Scientist, you will be able to deep dive into our massive streams of player data in-game, prototype and deploy machine learning models to increase game revenue. You will help move projects from exploratory analysis to deployed models across live titles, including life-simulation and racing games.


What it means on a daily basis​

  • Analyse large-scale player data with Python and SQL, transforming it into clear, actionable insights.
  • Perform feature engineering on large-scale data from the data warehouse, managing your code with Git.
  • Prototype and improve machine learning models and prediction pipelines, using experimental design, causal inference, and A/B testing to raise performance baselines.
  • Present findings and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders across the game teams.

What success will look like​

In your first months, you will ramp up on our data infrastructure and deliver your first exploratory analyses.By the middle of your onboarding, you will be responsible for features or models end-to-end, framing problems clearly and presenting them to non-technical stakeholders. By the end of your onboarding, you will be conducting experiments and delivering improvements on your own, with your insights adopted across the game teams.

Who you will be working with

As a Data Scientist in our Global Data Science and Analytics team, you will be reporting to our Lead Data Scientist and collaborate very closely with other Data teams (Data Analyst, Data Engineering) and with our local Game teams. Our teams operate across multiple studios worldwide, including Paris, Barcelona, Montreal, Sofia, Bucharest, and others, offering opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and perspectives.


Your recruitment journey​

  • Recruitment screen: An initial discussion to explore how the role aligns with your background and to address your main questions.​
  • Test: You will be given a case study to complete.​
  • First Interview: A technical interview focused on presenting your test and discussing your approach, reasoning, and methodologies in more depth.​
  • Final interview (optional): A conversation to discuss your experience, vision, and how you approach data topics at a broader level.​

​Where this role can take you​

This role can be a stepping stone toward a more senior position, with the possibility of leading increasingly large and complex projects, so that your work shapes game performance and business results more widely over time.


WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED​

  • Experience in game development or the mobile industry.
  • Master's degree in a quantitative field (computer science, applied mathematics, data science, or related).
  • Proficient in Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Matplotlib, seaborn) and in SQL for large-scale data analysis.
  • Skilled in machine learning workflows, including experimental design, causal inference, and A/B testing.
  • Experienced with Git and comfortable working with large-scale data in a data warehouse environment.

WHO YOU ARE​
  • Able to communicate and present to non-technical stakeholders in English, translating analytical work into clear, actionable recommendations.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU​


  • Permanent contract, full-time employment with comprehensive Social Benefits.
  • 25 vacation days per year + Birthday day off.
  • Private medical health insurance.
  • Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card.
  • Free language courses.
  • Work-from-home hybrid model.
  • Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.


Life at Gameloft

Our Barcelona studio offers real career development opportunities and a positive working environment in a centrally located office. We value supportive working conditions and a balanced work-life approach, and our teams work together with a collaborative mindset.


Ready to level up your career? Apply now with your CV in English.

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to :

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of .
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

Abbott Established Pharmaceutical Division (EPD) is looking for a Data Scientist for its Colombia office based in Bogota.

About the Advanced Analytics team :

The central Advanced Analytics team at the Abbott Established Pharma Division’s (EPD) headquarters in Basel helps define and lead the transformation towards becoming a global, data-driven company with the help of data and advanced technologies (e.g., Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, Computer Vision etc.). To us, Advanced Analytics is an important lever to reach our business targets, now and in the future; It helps differentiate ourselves from our competition and ensure sustainable revenue growth at optimal margins. Hence the central AA team is an integral part of the Strategy Management Office at EPD that has a very close link and regular interactions with the EPD Senior Leadership Team.

With the above requirements in mind, EPD is looking to fill a role of a Data Scientist, in Bogota, Colombia reporting to the Senior Manager Data Science Solutions. He/she must be internally driven with high level of ownership, responsible for developing impactful data driven solutions. He/she must be open to work on problems from diverse functions ranging from Optimized Manufacturing (Operations), Time series forecasting (Finance & Supply chain), Optimal route planning (Commercial) etc.

What You'll Do

  • Participate/drive data collection, cleaning, analysis and interpretation (EDA)
  • Collaborate with the business partner and product owners to ideate on solutions to challenging problems
  • Generate insightful visualizations to communicate findings
  • Carry out model selection, validation and possible ways for deployment (in collaboration with the engineering team)
  • Write high quality code with possibility of deployment in mind
  • Understand the existing code base, extend and adapt it for deployment in a different region/use-case
  • Share the learnings and findings with other data scientists contributing to the collaborative environment
  • Collaborate with Sr. Data Scientists and take full responsibility for analysis and modeling tasks
  • Help build and maintain a close contact to key business stakeholders and relevant communities
  • Build effective and efficient AA solutions to business needs, leveraging available market resources as much as possible
  • Keep himself/herself committed to continuous learning about the latest trends and technologies

Required Qualifications

  • B.S. in applied mathematics, computer science, engineering, applied statistics.
  • At least 3 years of relevant working experience, ideally in pharma environment
  • Strong experience in e.g., data mining, statistical modelling, predictive modeling and development of machine learning algorithms
  • Programming experience in Python (preferred) or R
  • Fluency in Spanish and English a must, additional languages a plus

Apply Now

Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.

Connect with us at www.abbott.com, on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott and on Twitter @AbbottNews and @AbbottGlobal.

At Scripps Health, you will experience the pride, support, and respect that has been repeatedly recognized as one of the nation’s Top 100 Places to Work.

Why join Scripps Health?

At Scripps Health, your ambition is empowered and your abilities are appreciated:

  • Nearly a quarter of our employees have been with Scripps Health for over 10 years.
  • Scripps is a Great Place to Work Certified company for 2025.
  • Scripps Health has been consistently ranked as a top employer for women, millennials, diversity, and as an overall workplace by various national publications.

As a Data Scientist, You Will

  • Provide advanced, integrated analytics in support of organizational objectives.
  • Source, manage, and analyze large amounts of unstructured data; synthesize and communicate results to facilitate data-driven decision making.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Experience with different healthcare data sources (medical claims, authorizations, pharmacy, provider, membership).
  • Experience with statistical modeling and interpretations of complex data.

  • Experience in predictive modeling for clinical intelligence.
  • Experience in market intelligence and financial projections.

At Scripps Health, you will experience the pride, support and respect of an organization that has been repeatedly recognized as one of the nation’s Top 100 Places to Work.

You’ll be surrounded by people committed to making a difference in the lives of their patients and their teammates. So if you’re open to change, go ahead and unlock your potential.

job_description_raw_html:
Headquartered in Singapore, Actxa Pte Ltd is a deep tech company founded in 2015 that leverages artificial intelligence to create next generation preventive healthcare solutions.

We create evidence-based, personalized health insights in the domains of physical activities, sleep quality, body composition, stress and recovery, heart health and blood glucose evaluation and monitoring.

To improve population health, Actxa establishes worldwide partnerships and research collaborations to develop critical preventive health models to help people avert chronic diseases such as diabetes and hypertension.

We believe in positively impacting the lives of people around us and the environment we live in through the use of technology. Hence, we are committed to providing a conducive environment for all employees to realize their full potential, who in turn have the opportunity to continuously drive innovation.

We have opportunities for you to grow your career path and are looking for talented professionals to join our team.

What will you do?

The Data Scientist researches, develops and validates the algorithms and AI models behind Actxa's preventive health insights. The role turns wearable sensor data and health datasets into reliable insights on activity, sleep, stress, recovery, heart health, blood glucose and nutrition, and helps build generative AI features such as personalized health insights and conversational coaching.

Working within the R&D team and alongside software engineers and research partners, the role supports Actxa's product roadmap and its research collaborations, with an emphasis on sound methods, careful validation and clear documentation.

  • Research and develop algorithms that turn wearable sensor data (e.g. PPG, accelerometer, heart rate variability) into insights on activity, sleep, stress, recovery and heart health
  • Build and improve models for blood glucose estimation and nutrition, including food recognition and nutrition data pipelines
  • Develop generative AI and LLM-based features such as personalized health insights, conversational coaching and behavioral nudging
  • Help design and run research studies with clinical and academic partners, covering protocol preparation, data collection and data quality checks
  • Clean, organize and analyze health datasets using statistical modelling, machine learning and deep learning methods
  • Test and validate algorithms and AI model outputs against reference data, and document methods and results clearly
  • Work with software engineers to bring models into Actxa's apps and products
  • Use AI-assisted tools (e.g. coding assistants, AI research agents) in day-to-day research and development, while critically validating their outputs
  • Contribute to research publications and invention disclosures

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Statistics or a related discipline
  • 0 to 2 years of relevant experience; fresh graduates with strong internship or project experience are welcome
  • Good working knowledge of Python and SQL, and libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn and PyTorch or TensorFlow
  • Solid foundation in statistics and machine learning
  • Experience with signal processing or time-series data from wearables is a plus
  • Familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, or frameworks such as Hugging Face, LangChain or LLM APIs is a plus
  • Exposure to clinical or health research, or to glucose and nutrition data, is a plus
  • Keen interest in digital health, wellness and preventive healthcare
  • Able to explain findings clearly to non-technical colleagues
  • Positive, adaptable and comfortable in a small team where priorities can shift
  • A natural tenacity, resilience and determination

job_description_raw_html:
Trust is the first of a new breed of banks in Singapore – digitally native and focused on delivering a delightful customer experience.  You will work in a fast-paced and collaborative environment to solve new and interesting challenges each day. Together with our Trust team, you will help shape the future of our bank.

As a Senior Data Scientist you'd be able to work on and solve some of the many interesting challenges we are facing, learn new ways of working, and build delightful high-quality products for our customers.

 

Job Responsibilities

 

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist with deep expertise in statistical modelling, machine learning, and business analytics to drive revenue growth through advanced analytical solutions. In this role, you will design and deploy predictive models including cross-sell, upsell, deep-sell, and look-alike models that directly impact product strategy and customer engagement. You will leverage AWS SageMaker for end-to-end model automation and harness Large Language Models (LLMs) including Claude/Anthropic to enhance productivity, personalisation, and insight generation at scale.

 

You will work closely with product owners, marketing, and business stakeholders to translate complex data patterns into actionable insights at both product and customer levels, ensuring analytical solutions drive measurable business outcomes.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and deploy advanced ML models for cross-sell, upsell, deep-sell, and look-alike use cases to maximise customer lifetime value and revenue per customer.
  • Develop customer segmentation, propensity scoring, next-best-action, and recommendation engines that inform personalised engagement strategies.
  • Automate end-to-end model lifecycle (training, validation, deployment, monitoring) using AWS SageMaker Pipelines and MLOps best practices.
  • Leverage LLMs (Claude/Anthropic) and AWS Bedrock for insight generation, automated commentary, personalised content creation, and agentic workflows that augment human decision-making.
  • Translate model outputs into clear, actionable business recommendations for product managers, marketing leads, and senior leadership.
  • Conduct rigorous A/B testing and champion-challenger frameworks to measure model impact on business KPIs.
  • Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure robust feature pipelines and data quality for model inputs.
  • Mentor junior data scientists and establish best practices for model development, documentation, and reproducibility.

 

In order to be successful at this role, you must have the following:

 

  • Master's or PhD in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a quantitative discipline.
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in data science with a strong focus on business/commercial analytics in banking, financial services, or consumer platforms.
  • Proven track record building and deploying production-grade predictive models (propensity, recommendation, segmentation, LTV).
  • Deep expertise in statistical methods: regression, classification, ensemble methods, Bayesian inference, time-series analysis.
  • Strong proficiency in Python (scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch/TensorFlow) and SQL.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS SageMaker (Training Jobs, Endpoints, Pipelines, Feature Store) for model automation and deployment.
  • Experience with LLM/GenAI tools (Claude, GPT) for prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and AI-assisted analytics workflows.
  • Exceptional business acumen - ability to connect data patterns to revenue, cost, and customer experience outcomes.
  • Strong communication skills to present complex findings to non-technical stakeholders.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS Bedrock for building GenAI-powered applications and agents.
  • Familiarity with causal inference methods and uplift modelling for campaign optimisation.
  • Experience in retail banking products (cards, loans, deposits, wealth) and customer lifecycle analytics.
  • Knowledge of MLOps frameworks, CI/CD for ML, model monitoring, and drift detection.
  • Experience building real-time scoring systems and feature engineering at scale.

 

Role Specific Technical Competencies

  • Strong proficiency in Python (scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch/TensorFlow) and SQL.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS SageMaker (Training Jobs, Endpoints, Pipelines, Feature Store) for model automation and deployment.
  • Experience with LLM/GenAI tools (Claude, GPT) for prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and AI-assisted analytics workflows.
  • Experience with AWS Bedrock for building GenAI-powered applications and agents.
  • Knowledge of MLOps frameworks, CI/CD for ML, model monitoring, and drift detection.

About Position:


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Scientist specializing in LLM Fine-Tuning and Clinical AI to build, optimize, and evaluate enterprise-grade Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, LoRA/PEFT, and Large Language Models (LLMs). You will play a key role in developing healthcare-focused AI solutions by fine-tuning foundation models, implementing robust evaluation frameworks, and ensuring clinically accurate, safe, and reliable AI-generated outcomes.


  • Role: Senior Data Scientist - LLM Fine-Tuning & Clinical AI
  • Location: All Persistent Locations
  • Experience: 6 to 10 Years
  • Job Type: Full-Time Employment


What You'll Do:


  • Design, develop, and optimize Machine Learning and Deep Learning solutions using Python and PyTorch.
  • Train, fine-tune, and evaluate Large Language Models (LLMs) for healthcare and enterprise AI use cases.
  • Utilize Hugging Face libraries and transformer architectures for model development and deployment.
  • Implement parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA and PEFT.
  • Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and LLM-powered applications.
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis on structured and unstructured clinical datasets.
  • Develop data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model validation pipelines.
  • Design evaluation frameworks to assess model accuracy, safety, explainability, and clinical relevance.
  • Perform model benchmarking, experimentation, and performance analysis.
  • Track experiments and manage model lifecycle using MLflow or Weights & Biases.
  • Collaborate with ML Engineers and domain experts to deploy AI models into production.
  • Monitor model performance and continuously improve model quality.
  • Develop scalable AI workflows and support distributed model training environments.
  • Contribute to AI engineering best practices, coding standards, and reusable frameworks.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
  • Stay updated with emerging trends in Machine Learning, Generative AI, NLP, and LLM technologies.


Expertise You'll Bring:


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 6 to 10 years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or related domains.
  • Strong proficiency in Python programming and software engineering best practices.
  • Hands-on experience with PyTorch and modern Deep Learning frameworks.
  • Strong expertise in Hugging Face transformers and model ecosystems.
  • Experience training, evaluating, and optimizing Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • Practical experience implementing LoRA, PEFT, and other parameter-efficient fine-tuning approaches.
  • Strong understanding of NLP concepts, transformer architectures, and language model workflows.
  • Experience developing model evaluation frameworks and benchmarking methodologies.
  • Hands-on experience with MLflow or Weights & Biases for experiment tracking and model management.
  • Experience working with large-scale datasets and distributed training environments.
  • Knowledge of model optimization, hyperparameter tuning, and performance engineering.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working in Agile and cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.
  • Ability to translate business and clinical requirements into scalable AI solutions.


Benefits:


  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
  • Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
  • Annual health check-ups
  • Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents


Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:


Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.


  • We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
  • Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
  • If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

Let us introduce you the job offer by EY GDS Poland – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY.

The opportunity

We are looking for a top-notch technology savvy specialists willing to move our projects on the new track! You will use the most advanced technology stack and have an opportunity to implement new solutions while working with top leaders in their industries. As a part of our global team, you will participate in various international projects.

Your Key Responsibilities

The responsibility for this role is to customize and implement solutions centered around Artificial Intelligence technologies - specifically natural language processing and information extraction. You will support AI solution development tasks, provide feedback to the AI lab researchers.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Understanding business needs and fulfilling them with the right solution. Participation in a cross-functional initiatives and collaboration across various domains. Interacting with data engineers, product/project managers from all over the world.

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • 3+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning or Artificial Intelligence
  • Programming experience in one or more of Python, R or PySpark
  • Machine learning knowledge in one or more of the following areas: classification, regression, clustering, time series, Bayesian methods, computer vision, natural language processing, large language models (LLMs) or Generative AI
  • Experience with AI / ML model evaluation and validation
  • Exposure to Generative AI technologies, Large Language Models (LLMs) or Natural Language Processing solutions
  • Understanding of modern AI solution architectures and deployment considerations
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Good command of English
  • French at B2 level or higher

Ideally, you’ll also have

  • Basic SQL knowledge, data modelling or data visualization skills
  • Experience with MLOps, APIs or software engineering best practices
  • Experience with one of the cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure
  • Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI applications or agentic AI solutions
  • Familiarity with Mistral AI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI or similar AI platforms
  • Experience with document intelligence, information extraction or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • Exposure to open-weight models, Sovereign AI concepts or enterprise AI deployment patterns
  • Experience working with multilingual solutions, European clients or regulated industry environments
  • Experience using Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, etc.)

What We Look For

We are looking for curious and proactive professionals who enjoy combining technology and business understanding to solve complex problems. The ideal candidate is passionate about AI, eager to explore emerging technologies and motivated to contribute to the development of trusted, scalable and business-driven AI solutions.

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across nine locations – Argentina, Hungary, India, the Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
